text: Suno kay Sonza, nagsugod naman sila sang loading kag reenergization sa Megaworld, Diversion, kag Molo Substations.
english: Sonza said they have already started loading and reenergization at Megaworld, Diversion, and Molo Substations.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga mahimo ma-reroute ang flow sa kuryente kon makitaan sang problema sa Sistema.
english: He also pointed out that the flow in electricity can be rerouted if a problem is found in the System.

text: Ginklaro man sang natungdan nga mahimo mahalin sa lain nga substation agud mapadayon ang dalagan sang kuryente halin sa National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP).
english: He also clarified that it can be removed from another substation to continue the flow of electricity from the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP).

text:
“Natapos na bala ang pila?”

Ini subong ang pinakamatunog nga pamangkot matapos nagguwa ang holding-hands-while-walking picture sang heartrob nga si Joshua Garcia kag sang rumored girlfriend sini nga si Bella Racelis.
english:
“Is the queue done?”

This is now the loudest question after a holding-hands-while-walking picture of heartrob Joshua Garcia and his rumored girlfriend Bella Racelis surfaced.

text: Sa amo nga picture, pareho sila nga nakasuksok sang face mask nga puti kag pareho man nga naka-shades.
english: In the picture, they are both wearing white face masks and both are wearing shades.

text: Ginapahayag nga yara sa isa ka luxury mall sanday Joshua kag Bella sang ginkuha ang amo nga picture.
english: Joshua and Bella were reportedly at a luxury mall when the picture was taken.

text: Isa ka content creator si Bella nga may 1.23 million subscribers sa YouTube kag isa man subong sa mga ginakabig nga incredibly exceptional kag authentic nga Filipina lifestyle vloggers!
english: Bella is a content creator with 1.23 million subscribers on YouTube and is also now one of the incredibly exceptional and authentic Filipina lifestyle vloggers!

text: Halin pa sang nagliligad nga bulan sang gina-link ang duha matapos na-obserbaran sang netizens nga masami nga naga-like kag naga-comment si Joshua sa Instagram posts ni Bella.
english: The two have been linked since last month after netizens observed that Joshua often likes and comments on Bella's Instagram posts.

text: Ginbutang pa anay ni Joshua ang picture kag video ni Bella sa iya nga photography Instagram account.
english: Joshua even posted a picture and video of Bella on his photography Instagram account.

text: Kun balikan, ang aktres nga si Julia Barretto ang ulihi nga nakarelasyon ni Joshua.
english: Actress Julia Barretto was the last to have a relationship with Joshua.

text: Madumduman nga 2019 sang gin-anunsyo nga break na sanday Joshua kag Julia matapos ang duha ka tuig nga relasyon.
english: It can be recalled that in 2019, Joshua and Julia announced their break after two years of relationship.

text: Nakapagwa na sang ila tagsa ka Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs) ang 24 ka mga senador sang Pilipinas.
english: The 24 Philippine senators have already released their respective Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs).

text: Base sa mga ginpagwa nga dokumento, nagapakita nga si Senator Mark Villar ang may pinakadako nga net worth nga nagalab-ot sa P1.2 billion, rason nga siya ang ginakabig bilang pinakamanggaranon nga senador.
english: Based on the released documents, Senator Mark Villar has the highest net worth of P1.2 billion, making him the richest senator.

text: Ginsundan ini ni Senator Raffy Tulfo, nga may kabug-usan nga net worth nga masobra sa P1.052 billion, kag siya ang ikaduha sa listahan sang pinakamanggaranon sa Senado.
english: He was followed by Senator Raffy Tulfo, who has a total net worth of more than P1.052 billion, and he is second on the list of the richest in the Senate.

text: Samtang, si Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero naman ang ginakabig bilang pinakaimol nga senador sa 20th Congress matapos nga may yara lang ini sang iya net worth nga P18.8 million.
english: Meanwhile, Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero is considered the poorest senator in the 20th Congress after he has a net worth of P18.8 million.

text: Sunod sa iya si Senator Risa Hontiveros, nga may net worth nga P18.9 million, kag nagapakita nga siya ang ikaduha sa pinakaimol nga senador.
english: She is followed by Senator Risa Hontiveros, who has a net worth of P18.9 million, making her the second poorest senator.

text: Ang pagpagwa sang SALN ang kabahin sang pagduso sang transparency kag accountability sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno, bilang kabahin sang ila obligasyon sa publiko.
english: The release of the SALN is part of the promotion of transparency and accountability of government officials, as part of their obligation to the public.

text: Ano ang ibato sang isa ka bataon kag gamay nga pungsod sa isa ka nasyon nga may superpowers?
english: What would a young and small country throw at a country with superpowers?

text: Nahibaluan na sang South Sudan ang sikreto!
english: South Sudan already knows the secret!

text: Ang South Sudan ang nagapang-62 lamang sa ranking sang FIBA kag amo ang pinakabata nga nasyon sa World Cup nga nahatagan lamang sang kahilwayan 12 ka tuig pa lang ang nakaligad.
english: South Sudan is only 62nd in the FIBA ​​rankings and is the youngest nation in the World Cup having only been granted independence just 12 years ago.

text: Sa bulig sang Chicago bulls star nga si Carlik Jones, ginkibot sini kag ginlutos ang World No.27 nga China, 89-69, sa group match sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: With the help of Chicago bulls star Carlik Jones, it shocked and defeated World No.27 China, 89-69, in the group match at Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text: Yara man sa amo nga African nation si Khaman Maluach, 16, ang youngest player sa 2023 FIBA World Cup kag ikatatlo nga youngest player sa bilog nga maragtas sang FIBA World Cup halin pa sang 1950.
english: Also in that African nation is Khaman Maluach, 16, the youngest player in the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup and the third youngest player in the entire history of the FIBA ​​World Cup dating back to 1950.

text: Buhi ang paglaum sang team para sa round of 16 amo man ang paglaum nga mahatagan sang slot para sa automatic qualifier sang Africa para sa Paris Olympics.
english: The team’s hopes for the round of 16 are alive as is the hope of being awarded a slot for Africa’s automatic qualifier for the Paris Olympics.

text: Nagrekomenda ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa Ombudsman nga pasakaan sang kaso kriminal kag administratibo ang pila ka personalidad nga ginatudlo nga may kahilabtanan sa mga ghost flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) has recommended to the Ombudsman to file criminal and administrative cases against some personalities allegedly involved in ghost flood control projects in the country.

text:

english:
Those named by ICI are:

According to the ICI, irregularities and possibility of corruption were discovered in some flood control projects that were paid for but not implemented.

text: Sa subong padayon pa nga ginahulat ang opisyal nga sabat sang mga ginhingadlan nga opisyal.
english: The official response of the named officials is still awaited.

text: Ginakwestyon ang Barangay Alalasan, Lapuz matapos nga nahibaluan nga isa ka pamilya nga natupok sang kalayo wala nalakip sa 4Ps, bisan pa nga kwalipikado.
english: Barangay Alalasan, Lapuz is being questioned after it was learned that a family that was burned by fire was not included in 4Ps, although they were eligible.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Grace Mandap, ginpahayag niya nga na-stroke ang iya bana sang nagligad nga tuig, kag ang ila pangabuhi nagasandig lang sa pagbaligya sang Penoy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Grace Mandap said her husband suffered a stroke last year, and their livelihood depends on selling Penoy.

text: May apat sila ka kabataan nga lunsay menor de edad kag naga-eskwela.
english: They have four children who are all minors and in school.

text: Wala sang nasalbar ang pamilya, lakip na ang wheelchair sang iya bana.
english: The family did not save anything, including her husband's wheelchair.

text: Gin-athag sang barangay nga ongoing pa ang cleansing sang mga beneficiary kag buligan nga makasulod ang pamilya.
english: The barangay explained that the cleansing of the beneficiaries is still ongoing and the families will be helped to enter.

text: May personal nga bulig nga ginhatag sang pila ka opisyal, kag ginpabutyag nga sila ang maga giya sa Department of Social Welfare and Development para sa inclusion sang pamilya.
english: Some officials provided personal assistance, and expressed that they will guide the Department of Social Welfare and Development for family inclusion.

text: Temporaryo nga naga-istar ang pamilya sa Alalasan Health Center samtang padayon ang koordinasyon sa City Social Welfare and Development Office.
english: The family is temporarily staying at the Alalasan Health Center while coordination with the City Social Welfare and Development Office continues.

text: Kag sa mga gusto magbulig para sa mga pamilya nga nasunugan , mahimo kamo magkadto sa Alalasan Health Center ukon sa ila Barangay Hall.
english: And for those who want to help for the families affected by the fire, you can go to the Alalasan Health Center or their Barangay Hall.

text: Reported by: Bombo Lyka Sandiego Via Bombohanay sa Udto
english: Reported by: Bombo Lyka Sandiego Via Bombohanay sa Udto

text:
Gin-ako nanday Gilas Coach Chot Reyes kag Team Captain Japeth Aguilar nga mabudlayan ang Pilipinas nga bantayan kag punggan ang Minnesota Timberwolves star nga si Karl-Anthony Towns sa pag-atubangay sang Pilipinas kag Dominican Republic karon sa gab-i.

Suno kay Reyes, posible nga bug-os nga team ang kinahanglan agud malutos si Towns nga isa sa best centers sa National Basketball Association (NBA).
english:
Gilas Coach Chot Reyes and Team Captain Japeth Aguilar admitted that the Philippines will have a hard time guarding and containing Minnesota Timberwolves star Karl-Anthony Towns in tonight's clash between the Philippines and the Dominican Republic.

According to Reyes, it may take an entire team to beat Towns, who is one of the best centers in the National Basketball Association (NBA).

text: “I don’t think it’s physically possible for any single person on our team or perhaps in the entire World Cup to stop Karl Anthony Towns 1-on-1 so it’s going to take a village to beat them,” suno kay Reyes.
english: “I don’t think it’s physically possible for any single person on our team or perhaps in the entire World Cup to stop Karl Anthony Towns 1-on-1 so it’s going to take a village to beat them,” according to Reyes.

text: Sang nagligad nga season, dalayawon ang performance ni Towns sa Minnesota nga nagkabig sa iya nga isa sa top-tier centers nga may 20.8 points kag 8.1 rebounds sa kada hampang.
english: Last season, Towns performed admirably in Minnesota, which considered him one of the top-tier centers with 20.8 points and 8.1 rebounds per game.

text: Ika-23 ang Dominican Republic sa ranking sang FIBA nga mas mataas sa Pilipinas nga nagtupa sa pang-40.
english: The Dominican Republic is 23rd in the FIBA ​​ranking, higher than the Philippines which dropped to 40th.

text: Magluwas kay Towns, ang iban pa nga Dominicans nga may eksperyensya sa NBA ukon sa G League amo sanday Lester Quiñones (Golden State Warriors); Angel Delgado (Los Angeles Clippers); LJ Figueroa (Santa Cruz Warriors); kag Eloy Vargas (South Bay Lakers).
english: In addition to Towns, other Dominicans with NBA or G League experience are Lester Quiñones (Golden State Warriors); Angel Delgado (Los Angeles Clippers); LJ Figueroa (Santa Cruz Warriors); and Eloy Vargas (South Bay Lakers).

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Dominican Republic basketball coach Nestor Garcia nga mas daku ang ila pagpang-handa sa hampang batok sa Gilas Pilipinas ipaanggid sa iban nga kasumpong sa Group A nga amo ang Angola kag Italy.
english: Dominican Republic basketball coach Nestor Garcia said they are more prepared for the game against Gilas Pilipinas compared to other opponents in Group A, namely Angola and Italy.

text: Ini bangud magluwas nga imbukada nila nga hampang ang Gilas, pat-od nga mapuno man ang Philippine Arena sang Pinoy basketball fans nga magasuporta sa Gilas.
english: This is because besides the opening game of the Gilas, the Philippine Arena will surely be filled with Filipino basketball fans who will support the Gilas.

text: Balantayan las 8:00 karon sa gab-i ang group play sang Gilas batok sa Dominican Republic, pagkatapos sang Italy kag Angola nga maga-atubangay naman las 4:00 karon sa hapon.
english: Watch the group play of the Gilas against the Dominican Republic at 8:00 pm, followed by Italy and Angola who will face each other at 4:00 pm.

text: Magapanguna sa Pilipinas ang Utah Jazz star nga si Jordan Clarkson nga buligan man sang iban nga Gilas players kaangay nanday Aguilar, Kai Sotto, Scottie Thompson, June Mar Fajardo, AJ Edu, kag Dwight Ramos.
english: The Philippines will be led by Utah Jazz star Jordan Clarkson who will be assisted by other Gilas players such as Aguilar, Kai Sotto, Scottie Thompson, June Mar Fajardo, AJ Edu, and Dwight Ramos.

text: Ginatun-an ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang temporaryo nga pag-lift sang persona non grata status batok kay Iloilo City District Engineering Office Officer-in-Charge Engineer Roy Pacanan.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas is studying the temporary lifting of persona non grata status against Iloilo City District Engineering Office Officer-in-Charge Engineer Roy Pacanan.

text: Suno sa alkalde, ginahimo sang iya opisina ang pag-usisa kun sin-o ang nag-ubra sang orihinal nga deklarasyon.
english: The mayor said his office is investigating who made the original declaration.

text: Ginpanugyan man ni Treñas nga kun luyag ni Pacanan nga maklaruhan ang isyu kag ang iya pangalan, dapat ini magtambong sa Quad Committee hearing sang konseho.
english: Treñas also suggested that if Pacanan wants to clarify the issue and his name, he should attend the Quad Committee hearing of the council.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga bisan wala siya sang direkta nga papel sa deklarasyon, bukas ang oportunidad para kay Pacanan nga magpahayag sang iya sabat, ilabi na sa mga kontrobersyal nga proyekto sa flood control.
english: He said that although he has no direct role in the declaration, the opportunity is open for Pacanan to express his response, especially on the controversial flood control projects.

text: Ginpanindugan sang alkalde nga ang klaro nga ang transparency koordinasyon kag accountability ang kinahanglanon sa tunga sang lokal nga gobyerno kag national agencies.
english: The mayor insisted that transparency, coordination and accountability are needed between local government and national agencies.

text: Madumduman nga mismo si former Mayor Jerry Treñas ang nag-isyu sang executive order nga nagadeklarar kay Pacanan bilang persona non grata.
english: It can be recalled that former Mayor Jerry Treñas himself issued an executive order declaring Pacanan as persona non grata.

text: Nakitaan sang gamay nga improvement ang kondisyon ni Pope Francis sa iya ika-11 nga adlaw sa pagtinir sa ospital bangud sa double pneumonia.
english: Pope Francis' condition improved slightly on his 11th day in hospital with double pneumonia.

text:
Base sa update sang Vatican subong nga kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas, kritikal gihapon ang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa apang may “slight improvement” na sa laboratory tests bangud wala sang natabo nga panibag-o nga “asthma-like respiratory distress.”

Ginbuhinan man ang flow kag percentage sang oxygen nga ginahatag sa iya sa therapy.
english:
According to the Vatican's update this morning Philippine time, the 88-year-old Pope is still in critical condition but has a "slight improvement" in laboratory tests because there has been no new "asthma-like respiratory distress.

The flow and percentage of oxygen given to him in therapy was also reduced.

text: Ginsiling man nga indi dapat pagkabalak-an ang “mild kidney insufficiency” nga una gin-report kahapon sang kaagahon.
english: It also said that there is no need to worry about the “mild kidney insufficiency” that was first reported yesterday morning.

text: Pahayag pa sang Holy See, sang aga, nagbaton ang Pope sang Eucharist, kag sang hapon, nagbalik ini sa trabaho.
english: The Holy See said in the morning, the Pope received the Eucharist, and in the afternoon, he returned to work.

text: Sa gab-i, nagtawag ini sa parish priest sa Gaza.
english: In the evening, he called the parish priest in Gaza.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa tanan nga tumuluo nga nagpangamuyo para sa iya ikaayong lawas.
english: He also thanked all the faithful who prayed for his health.

text: Yari ang kabug-usan nga statement.
english: Here is the full statement.

text: “The Holy Father’s clinical condition, despite its severity, has shown a slight improvement.
english: “The Holy Father’s clinical condition, despite its severity, has shown a slight improvement.

text: No episodes of asthma-like respiratory distress occurred today, and some laboratory tests have shown improvement.
english: No episodes of asthma-like respiratory distress occurred today, and some laboratory tests have shown improvement.

text: The monitoring of his mild kidney insufficiency has not raised any concerns.
english: The monitoring of his mild kidney insufficiency has not raised any concerns.

text: Oxygen therapy continues, although with slightly reduced flow and oxygen levels.
english: Oxygen therapy continues, although with slightly reduced flow and oxygen levels.

text: Given the complexity of the clinical picture, the doctors are prudently maintaining their cautious prognosis.
english: Given the complexity of the clinical picture, the doctors are prudently maintaining their cautious prognosis.

text: In the morning, the Pope received the Eucharist, while in the afternoon, he resumed his work.
english: In the morning, the Pope received the Eucharist, while in the afternoon, he resumed his work.

text: In the evening, he called the parish priest of Gaza to express his paternal closeness.
english: In the evening, he called the parish priest of Gaza to express his paternal closeness.

text:
Pope Francis thanks the entire People of God, who in these days have gathered to pray for his health.”

Ini na ang pang-11 nga adlaw sang Pope sa Gemelli Hospital sa Roma nga amo ang pinakamalawig nga pagtinir sa ospital sa sulod sang halos 12 ka tuig niya nga pagpangalagad bilang Santo Papa.
english:
Pope Francis thanks the entire People of God, who in these days have gathered to pray for his health.”

This is the Pope's 11th day at the Gemelli Hospital in Rome, the longest hospital stay in his nearly 12 years of service as Pope.

text: Base sa nauna nga press release sang Vatican, Sabado sang aga oras sa Roma sang nag-umpisa nga nangin kritikal ang kondisyon sang Pope kag nagkinanglan pa sang pagpatughong sang dugo bangud sa “prolonged asthma-like respiratory crisis”.#
english: According to an earlier press release from the Vatican, the Pope's condition became critical on Saturday morning Rome time and required blood transfusions due to a prolonged asthma-like respiratory crisis.

text: Maga-export ang Vietnam sang duha ka milyon nga doses sang African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccines sa Pilipinas sa Oktubre.
english: Vietnam will export two million doses of African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccines to the Philippines in October.

text: Suno sa Vietnamese government, ang bakuna nga iga-export sang Pilipinas ang para sa commercial use kag himo sang AVAC Vietnam Joint Stock Company.
english: According to the Vietnamese government, the vaccine that the Philippines will export is for commercial use and is produced by the AVAC Vietnam Joint Stock Company.

text: Halin sang naaprubahan ang amo nga bakuna suno sa gobyerno, nakapadala na ini sa Pilipinas sang 300,000 doses.
english: Since the approval of the vaccine, the government said, it has sent 300,000 doses to the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan sang gin-aprubahan sang Vietnam sa domestic commercial use ang duha ka African swine fever vaccines nga amo ang NAVET-ASFVAC kag AVAC ASF LIVE nga gin-develop sang Vietnamese companies kag researchers halin sa United States.
english: Last month, Vietnam approved for domestic commercial use two African swine fever vaccines, NAVET-ASFVAC and AVAC ASF LIVE, developed by Vietnamese companies and researchers from the United States.

text: Nahibaluan nga 650,000 doses na sang vaccines ang na-test sa mga baboy sa 40 ka probinsya sa amo nga pungsod kun sa diin ang efficacy rate ang yara sa 95%.
english: It is known that 650,000 doses of vaccines have been tested on pigs in 40 provinces in the country with an efficacy rate of 95%.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Ex-Officio Board Member Amalia Debuque, Presidente sang Liga sang mga Barangay sa Iloilo Province, nga medyo nagnubo ang numero sang mga barangay nga nakabaton sang Seal of Good Local Governance.
english: Ex-Officio Board Member Amalia Debuque, President of the League of Barangays in Iloilo Province, revealed that the number of barangays that received the Seal of Good Local Governance has decreased slightly.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Debuque nga ang pagnubo sang kwalipikado nga mga barangay nagakahulugan sang pagnubo man sang mga indicators nga ginabasehan sang Department of the Interior and Local Government.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Debuque said the decrease in the number of eligible barangays means a decrease in the indicators based on the Department of the Interior and Local Government.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga iya pa ini usisahn kun ano ang rason sang pagnubo, kag ginpahanumdom nga ang tuig 2024 ang katapusan nga paghiwat sang Seal of Good Local Governance for Barangay ukon SGLGB suno sa mandu ni Secretary Jonvic Remulla bangud sa kabug-at sang workloads.
english: He said he will investigate the reason for the decline, and reminded that 2024 is the last year to hold the Seal of Good Local Governance for Barangay or SGLGB as directed by Secretary Jonvic Remulla due to the heavy workloads.

text: Gintudlo ni Debuque nga dapat tutukan sang mga barangay ang performance indicators agud mapabaskug ang lokal nga pamunoan kag serbisyo sa komunidad.
english: Debuque pointed out that barangays should focus on performance indicators to strengthen local governance and community services.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Alan Zaldivar, chairman of the Committee on Health, Sanitation, and Health Services, said that through the Atipan fair, government services will be brought closer to the ordinary citizens.

text: Ginaplano man sang Iloilo City Government nga dal-on ini nga one-stop shop sa kada distrito.
english: The Iloilo City Government is also planning to bring this one-stop shop to every district.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa weekdays, bukas ang Atipan Center sa ikapito nga panalgan sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: On weekdays, the Atipan Center is open on the seventh floor of Iloilo City Hall.

text: Hugot nga ginadumilian ang mga pulis nga naka-assign sa venues sang FIBA World Cup 2023 nga mag-“selfie” kaupod sa international athletes ilabi na sa mga popular nga mga player nga magahampang sa tournament.
english: Police officers assigned to the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 venues are strictly prohibited from taking selfies with international athletes especially popular players who will play in the tournament.

text: Ginpaguwa sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ini nga direktiba agud mapahanumdom sa mga pulis nga naka-deploy sa sites kun sa diin patigayunon ang hampang halin buwas, Agusto 25, tubtub sa Septyembre 10.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) issued this directive to remind police officers deployed in the sites where the games will be held from tomorrow, August 25, until September 10.

text: Suno kay PNP Spokesperson Colonel Jean Fajardo, fans man ang mga pulis sang mga basketball players, apang sa amo nga petsa, dapat nga tutukan ang trabaho.
english: According to PNP Spokesperson Colonel Jean Fajardo, the police are also fans of the basketball players, but on that date, they should focus on their work.

text: May na-assign naman nga mga pulis sa airports kag billeting areas halin sang nagsugod sa pag-abot ang players kag delegates sang Agusto 17.
english: Police have been assigned to airports and billeting areas since the players and delegates began arriving on August 17.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo sang National Capital Region Police Office (NCPRO) nga 2,225 ka mga personnel nga i-deploy para sa seguridad sang mga magalantaw sa World Cup.
english: Earlier, the National Capital Region Police Office (NCPRO) announced that 2,225 personnel will be deployed for the security of World Cup spectators.

text: Target ni Ombudsman Boying Remulla nga makaasaka sang kaso sa Sandiganbayan tuhoy sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa Nov.
english: Ombudsman Boying Remulla targets to file a case with the Sandiganbayan regarding anomalous flood control projects by Nov.

text: Lakip sa mga sa ipasaka amo ang malversation, bribery, kag falsification angot sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.
english: Among the charges are malversation, bribery, and falsification in connection with anomalous flood control projects in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.

text: Nalakip man diri ang Sunwest Incorporated nga ginapanag-iyahan ni anay Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co kag iban pa nga mga respondents.
english: This also includes Sunwest Incorporated owned by former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co and other respondents.

text: Plano man sini nga kasuhan ang mga may kahilabtanan sa lima ka ghost flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: He also plans to sue those involved in the five ghost flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Ginpa-Bombo ang isa ka drainage project sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) sa Barangay Alalasan, Lapuz, Iloilo City nga isa sa ginatudlo nga nagpabudlay sa Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) sang nagresponde sila sa sunog sa amo nga barangay kagab-i, Agusto 24.
english: A drainage project of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) in Barangay Alalasan, Lapuz, Iloilo City was bombed which is one of the alleged difficulties for the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) when they responded to a fire in the barangay last night, August 24.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa residente nga si Edita Jasmine, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa drainage construction, magutok na ang ila nga dalan kag halos mag-ilinaway na ang mga driver bangud sa pagpug-ok sang trapiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, resident Edita Jasmine said that due to the drainage construction, their road is now crowded and drivers are almost fighting because of the traffic jam.

text: Sa tion sang emerhensya kaangay sang sunog suno sa iya, indi gid makadali-dali sa paglabay ang bumbero bangud sa ila nga sitwasyon, magluwas pa nga may mga naga-park pa nga daan nga mga tricyle sa higad sang dalan.
english: In times of emergency such as fire, he said, firefighters cannot rush to pass because of their situation, besides there are still old tricycles parked on the side of the road.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may existing drainage naman sa ila nga barangay kag indi na kinahanglan ang ginatukod nga isa pa; bangud sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, mas kinahanglan ini sa La Paz nga mas prone sa baha.
english: He also said that there is an existing drainage in their barangay and there is no need to build another one; because in fact, he said, it is more needed in La Paz which is more prone to floods.

text: Pahayag sini, masobra isa ka bulan na nga utay-utay ang pag-obra sa amo nga proyekto.
english: He said the project has been in progress for more than a month.

text: Suno naman kay Barangay Kagawad Jomar Porras, indi tayuyon ang pag-obra sini bangud ginbalabagan man ini sang mga punong barangay sa kaiping nga barangay bangud may existing drainage project na kag ginalantaw nga indi naman kinahanglan ang kaangay nga proyekto.
english: According to Barangay Kagawad Jomar Porras, the construction of the project is not smooth because it was also blocked by the barangay captains in the neighboring barangays because there is an existing drainage project and it is considered that such a project is not needed.

text: Sa nakaplastar nga project billboard sa lugar, blangko ang impormasyon kun san-o nag-umpisa ang proyekto kag kun san-o matapos.
english: On the project billboard in the area, the information about when the project started and when it will be completed is blank.

text: Gintawag ang project nga Repair/Maintenance sang Drainage Structure sang dalan La Paz pa-Lapuz sa Barangay Alalasan.
english: The project is called Repair/Maintenance of Drainage Structure of La Paz-Lapuz Road in Barangay Alalasan.

text: Sa travel advisory naman nga ginbutang sang Mayo 23, 2025, ginpahibalo nga temporaryo nga pagsirado sa tuo nga lane sang apat ka lanes agud nga ma-facilitate ang pagkuha sang existing structures kag obstructions.
english: In the travel advisory issued on May 23, 2025, it was announced that the right lane of the four lanes will be temporarily closed to facilitate the removal of existing structures and obstructions.

text: Ginpahibalo man nga importante ang closure para sa pagtukod sang detention tank sa idalom sang Flood Mitigatikon Structure Project – Section 3.
english: It was also announced that the closure is important for the construction of the detention tank under the Flood Mitigatikon Structure Project – Section 3.

text: Kun ang Gilas team captain nga si Japeth Aguilar ang pahambalon, 50% ang tyansa sang Pilipinas nga makadaog sa una sini nga sambuwa batok sa Dominican Republic buwas sa gab-i sa Philippine Arena sa Bocaue, Bulacan.
english: According to Gilas team captain Japeth Aguilar, the Philippines has a 50% chance of winning its first match against the Dominican Republic tomorrow night at the Philippine Arena in Bocaue, Bulacan.

text: Nagapanguna sa Dominicans ang Minnesota star nga si Karl Anthony-Towns.
english: Leading the Dominicans is Minnesota star Karl Anthony-Towns.

text: Magluwas sa 27-anyos nga three-time All-Star, yara man ang NBA standout kag Warriors swingman nga si Lester Quinones.
english: In addition to the 27-year-old three-time All-Star, there is also NBA standout and Warriors swingman Lester Quinones.

text: Suno kay Aguilar pagkatapos sang ila practice sa Araneta Coliseum, kinahanglan i-execute sang Gilas ang game plan, apang daku gid suno sa iya ang hangkat nga matumba sang Pilipinas nga pang-numero 40 sa world rankings ang Dominican Republic nga World Number 23.
english: Aguilar said after their practice at the Araneta Coliseum, the Gilas need to execute the game plan, but he said the challenge is huge for the Philippines to knock down the Dominican Republic, which is number 40 in the world rankings, and the Dominican Republic, which is number 23.

text: Nagapanguna sa Gilas ang Utah Jazz star nga si Jordan Clarkson, veteran big man nga si June Mar Fajardo, kag young center nga si Kai Sotto.
english: Leading the way for the Gilas are Utah Jazz star Jordan Clarkson, veteran big man June Mar Fajardo, and young center Kai Sotto.

text: Yara man sa Final 12 ang skipper nga si Aguilar, Aj Edu, international players nga sanday Rhenz Abando, Dwight Ramos, kag Kiefer Ravena, PBA stars nga sanday CJ Perez, RR Pogoy Jamie Malonzo kag Scottie Thompson.
english: Also in the Final 12 are skipper Aguilar, Aj Edu, international players Rhenz Abando, Dwight Ramos, and Kiefer Ravena, PBA stars CJ Perez, RR Pogoy Jamie Malonzo and Scottie Thompson.

text: Nahilway na sang Hamas militants ang tanan nga mga bihag nga ginpromisa nila nga ibalik sa Israel sa idalom sang una nga hugnat sang ceasefire agreement.
english: Hamas militants have already released all the hostages they promised to return to Israel under the first phase of the ceasefire agreement.

text: Anum ang gin-release sang militante nga grupo, lakip ang duha nga ginhatag sa Red Cross sa Rafah sa southern Gaza kag ginpasaka pa sa entablado sa pagpanguna sang armado nga Hamas fighters.
english: Six were released by the militant group, including two handed over to the Red Cross in Rafah in southern Gaza and further upstaged by armed Hamas fighters.

text: Ginsunod ang tatlo nga gintugyan man sa Red Cross officials sa Nuseirat sa central Gaza sa separado naman nga seremonya.
english: The three were handed over to Red Cross officials in Nuseirat in central Gaza in a separate ceremony.

text: Ang isa naman kag katapusan nga bihag amo ang 37-anyos nga gin-turn over sa Red Cross.
english: The other and final hostage was a 37-year-old who was turned over to the Red Cross.

text: Ginhimo siya nga hostage sang Hamas sang nagsulod siya sa Gaza sadtong Abril 2015.
english: He was taken hostage by Hamas when he entered Gaza in April 2015.

text: Sila ang anum nga katapusan sa grupo sang 33 hostages nga nalakip sa first stage sang ceasefire nga nagsugod sang Enero 19.
english: They are the last six of a group of 33 hostages included in the first stage of the ceasefire that began on January 19.

text: Bilang kabaylo, paguwaon naman sang Israel ang 602 ka mga Palestinian nga ila ginhunong sa mga presuhan lakip ang 445 nga gin-detain nila sang gin-umpisahan ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: In exchange, Israel will release 602 Palestinians it has held in prisons including 445 it detained when the war in Gaza began.

text: Nalakip man diri ang 151 prisoners nga may life or high sentences.
english: This also includes 151 prisoners with life or high sentences.

text: Ini ang pinakadaku nga grupo nga buy-an sang Israelis sa idalom sang ceasefire agreement.
english: This is the largest group to be released by the Israelis under the ceasefire agreement.

text: Ginpahayag ni Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief sang Public Affairs Office sang Third Infantry Division sang Philippine Army, sa interview sang Bombo Radyo nga may narekober nga lima ka firearm matapos ang tatlo ka engkwentro nga natabo sa Tapaz, Capiz sang kaagahon sang Agosto 22, pasado alas 2:00.
english: Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief of the Public Affairs Office of the Third Infantry Division of the Philippine Army, said five firearms were recovered after three encounters in Tapaz, Capiz on August 22, around 2:00 am.

text: Suno sa iya, ang mga armas nga nakuha amo ang 2 ka M-14 nga may 7.62 milimetre, 1 ka M-16 nga may 5.56 milimetre, 1 ka 18”/47, kag 1 ka M1 Garand.
english: He said the weapons recovered were 2 M-14s with 7.62 millimetres, 1 M-16 with 5.56 millimeters, 1 18”/47, and 1 M1 Garand.

text: Ginpahayag pa niya nga didto mismo sa lugar sang engkwentro nakita ang mga armas.
english: He said the weapons were found at the scene of the encounter.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang militar sa lugar agud masiguro ang seguridad kag matipon pa ang dugang nga impormasyon.
english: The military is conducting an investigation in the area to ensure security and gather more information.

text: Ginlutos sang Mexico ang Gilas Pilipinas, 84-77, sa ulihi nga tune-up game antes ang opisyal nga pagbukas sang FIBA World Cup 2023.
english: Mexico defeated Gilas Pilipinas, 84-77, in the late tune-up game before the official opening of the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023.

text: Sa hampang sa PhilSports Arena, nagmato-mato ang Gilas nga wala ang Utah Jazz star nga si Jordan Clarkson nga amo anay ang nagpanguna sa Pilipinas sa 85-62 nga kadalag-an sa Ivory Coast kag 102-85 nga kalutusan sa kamot sang Montenegro.
english: In the game at the PhilSports Arena, the Gilas struggled without Utah Jazz star Jordan Clarkson, who previously led the Philippines to an 85-62 win over Ivory Coast and a 102-85 defeat at the hands of Montenegro.

text: Nagpanguna sa Gilas si Scottie Thompson nga may 14 points, 6 rebounds, kag 5 assists.
english: Scottie Thompson led the Gilas with 14 points, 6 rebounds, and 5 assists.

text: Wala na sang iban nga Gilas players nga naka-rehistro sang double figures.
english: No other Gilas players registered double figures.

text: Nakatipon si Dwight Ramos sang 9 points, 3 rebounds, 3 assists, kag 2 blocks; si Roger Pogoy ang nagbubo sang 9 points; samtang sanday Kai Sotto kag Jamie Malonzo ang lunsay naghatag sang otso puntos.
english: Dwight Ramos collected 9 points, 3 rebounds, 3 assists, and 2 blocks; Roger Pogoy poured in 9 points; while Kai Sotto and Jamie Malonzo both contributed eight points.

text: Sa group play, nagtupa ang Mexico sa Group D nga magahampang sa Montenegro, Lithuania, kag Egypt sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: In group play, Mexico dropped to Group D to play Montenegro, Lithuania, and Egypt at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Balantayan naman ang Gilas sa Group A kaupod sa Dominican Republic, Angola, kag Italy.
english: The Gilas are in Group A alongside the Dominican Republic, Angola, and Italy.

text: Naglab-ot sa P5-million ang balor sang ginapasuni shabu nga nakumpiskar sa drug buy bust operation nga ginpatigayon sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) sa Barangay Tinocuan, Dingle, Iloilo subong nga adlaw, Agusto 23.
english: P5-million worth of suspected shabu was seized in a drug buy bust operation conducted by the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) in Barangay Tinocuan, Dingle, Iloilo today, August 23.

text: Ang main subject sa operasyon amo si alias Bonbon, 39 anyos, isa ka High-Value Individual (HVI), residente sang amo nga barangay.
english: The main subject of the operation is alias Bonbon, 39 years old, a High-Value Individual (HVI), resident of the said barangay.

text: Dakop man si Alyas Bentot, 55; duha ka mga lookout nga naga-edad 30-anyos kag 31-anyos; kag isa ka lalaki nga taga-Bulacan nga hinablos sang main subject.
english: Also arrested were Bentot, 55; two lookouts aged 30-years-old and 31-year-olds; and a man from Bulacan who is the nephew of the main subject.

text: Nagabug-at sang 740 gramos ang suspected shabu kag may balor nga P5,032,000.
english: The suspected shabu weighed 740 grams and had a value of P5,032,000.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon halin sa PDEU, nagikan ang suplay sang droga sa syudad sang Iloilo kag Antique.
english: According to initial information from the PDEU, the drug supply came from Iloilo City and Antique.

text: Magluwas sa illegal drugs, na-recover man ang isa ka 12 gauge shot gun, isa ka AR 15-9mm rifle, isa ka airsoft rifle, kag isa ka granada.
english: Aside from the illegal drugs, a 12 gauge shot gun, an AR 15-9mm rifle, an airsoft rifle, and a grenade were also recovered.

text: Sa pagpangusisa sang Bombo Radyo, may nauna na nga kaso si alias Bonbon kag alias Bentot.
english: According to Bombo Radyo, alias Bonbon and alias Bentot have previous cases.

text: Yara na ang paghinakop sang mga pulis ang arestado, ipaidalom sa tests, kag natalana nga magpangatubang sang nagakaigo nga mga kaso.#
english: The police concluded that the suspect was arrested, subjected to tests, and is scheduled to face appropriate charges.

text: Determinado si Senate President Juan Miguel Zubiri sa pagduso sang P150 nga wage hike paagi sa paghimo sini nga isa ka layi.
english: Senate President Juan Miguel Zubiri is determined to push the P150 wage hike by making it a law.

text: Ginsaad ni Zubiri ang isa ka survey sang Pulse Asia nga ginpaguwa sang nagligad nga semana kun sa diin nakit-an nga 44% sang mga Pinoy ang nagasiling nga ang wage hike ang ikaduha sa pinakaimportante nga national concern.
english: Zubiri cited a Pulse Asia survey released last week which found that 44% of Filipinos said the wage hike was the second most important national concern.

text: Ini ang nagasunod sa problema sa inflation nga amo ang dapat solbaron suno sa amo nga survey.
english: This is in line with the inflation problem that needs to be solved, according to the survey.

text: Gin-cite man sang senador ang resulta sang separado nga Pulse Asia survey nga nagasiling nga 97% sang Pinoy ang nagasiling nga pabor sila sa P150 wage increase para sa private sector workers.
english: The senator also cited the results of a separate Pulse Asia survey that said 97% of Filipinos said they were in favor of a P150 wage increase for private sector workers.

text: Suno sa senate president, gamiton niya ang resulta sang survey agud nga kumbinsehon ang iya nga mga kaupdanan nga suportahan ang hagna nga magapasaka sang sweldo kun mag-resume na ang deliberasyon sang Senado sa amo nga isyu.
english: The senate president said he will use the results of the survey to convince his colleagues to support the bill that will raise salaries when the Senate resumes deliberation on the issue.

text: “That is what we need to focus on, and that is my promise.
english: “That is what we need to focus on, and that is my promise.

text: The Senate will [take] a stand on this issue.
english: The Senate will [take] a stand on this issue.

text: I know that many businessmen will get angry.
english: I know that many businessmen will get angry.

text: But they also need to share their blessings with our workers,” pahayag ni Zubiri.
english: But they also need to share their blessings with our workers,” stated Zubiri.

text: Marso sang ginduso ni Zubiri ang Senate Bill 2002 ukon ang Across-the-Board Wage Increase Act of 2023 nga nagaduso sang P150 nga wage hike sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: In March, Zubiri introduced the Senate Bill 2002 or the Across-the-Board Wage Increase Act of 2023 which proposes a P150 wage hike nationwide.

text: Samtang, kun madumduman, ang P40 daily minimum wage increase sa National Capital Region sang gin-aprubahan na sang nagligad nga Hunyo.
english: Meanwhile, the P40 daily minimum wage increase in the National Capital Region was approved last June.

text: Isa pa ka call center agent ang ginpulihan kastigo sa San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Another call center agent was beaten in San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jereck Sano.
english: The victim was identified as Jereck Sano.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sano, iya ginpahayag nga nagalakat ini sa area sang may nasumalang ini nga duha ka motorsiklo nga may sakay nga tag-tatlo ka tawo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sano said he was walking in the area when he encountered two motorcycles carrying three people each.

text: Suno kay Sano, hinali lang nga nagpalapit sa iya ang anom ka mga lalaki nga sakay sang mga motorsiklo kag ginpalibutan siya sang mga ini.
english: According to Sano, six men on motorcycles suddenly approached him and surrounded him.

text: Nagdalagan ang biktima apang ginlagas ini kag nalab-ot sang mga lalaki.
english: The victim ran but was chased and overtaken by the men.

text: Isa sa ila ang may ginauyatan pa nga kutsilyo.
english: One of them was still holding a knife.

text: Suno sa iya, magluwas nga ginsakit siya sang mga suspek, ginkuha pa sang mga ini ang dala niya nga grocery items kaangay sang diaper kag gatas nga para sa iya duha ka bulan pa lang nga bata.
english: She said that besides torturing her, the suspects also took her grocery items such as diapers and milk for her two-month-old child.

text: Ginkuha man sang mga suspek ang iya cellphone.
english: The suspects also took his cellphone.

text: Suno sa biktima, may mga tabon sa nawong ang mga lalaki apang sa iya pagbanta, mga menor de edad ang mga ini.
english: According to the victim, the men were wearing masks but he estimated that they were minors.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ginsaskuhan lamang siya kag mangawat gid ang tuyo sang mga suspek bangud wala man ini sang nahibaluan nga may nakaaway ukon kontra sa lugar.
english: He also believes that he was just being harassed and that the suspects intended to steal because he did not know that there was a fight or opponent in the area.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon, nakastiguhan man ang call center agent nga si Junelle Baldon samtang yara ini sa SM Strata kun sa diin indi man niya kilala ang mga suspek kag possible nga gintrippinang amang ini.
english: It can be recalled that yesterday, call center agent Junelle Baldon was also punished while she was in SM Strata where she did not know the suspects and possibly tripped her.

text: Ang duha ka insidente ang halos magkasunod lang nga natabo kahapon sang kaagahon.
english: The two incidents occurred almost simultaneously yesterday morning.

text: Ginklaro sang mga doctor ni Pope Francis nga indi pa gihapon hilway sa katalagman ang Santo Papa apang indi man ini tagumatayon.
english: Pope Francis' doctors clarified that the Pope is still not free of danger but he is not dying.

text: “The question is, is the pope out of danger?
english: “The question is, is the pope out of danger?

text: No, the pope is not out of danger,” suno kay Professor Sergio Alfieri sa ginpatigayon nga press briefing kaangot sa kahimtangan sang 88-anyos nga Pope.
english: No, the pope is not out of danger,” Professor Sergio Alfieri said at a press briefing on the condition of the 88-year-old Pope.

text:
“If you then ask whether he is in danger of dying at this moment, the answer is still no.”

Sa pagkamatuod, ginbuhinan na ang amount sang medication nga ginhatag sa iya, apang gina-require nga magtinir sang isa pa ka semana sa medical facility.
english:
“If you then ask whether he is in danger of dying at this moment, the answer is still no.”

In fact, the amount of medication given to him has been reduced, but he is required to stay another week in the medical facility.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka semana na nga yara sa ospital sa Roma ang Santo Papa.
english: The Pope has been in a hospital in Rome for a week.

text: Una ginsiling nga may bronchitis, apang nag-develop sa double pneumonia ukon apektado gid ang iya duha ka mga baga.
english: Initially said to have bronchitis, but developed into double pneumonia or both lungs were severely affected.

text: Suno kay Alfieri, ang risgo sa sini nga mga kaso amo ang pagresulta sa sepsis nga isa na ka life-threatening condition.
english: According to Alfieri, the risk in these cases is resulting in sepsis, which is already a life-threatening condition.

text: Ginsiling man nga may chronic lung condition subong ang Pope kag makabig nga “fragile patient”.
english: The Pope is also said to have a chronic lung condition and is considered a “fragile patient”.

text: Indi magpasugot ang doctor nga magguwa ini sa ospital bangud pat-od suno sa ila nga kun ibalik ini sa Santa Marta nga amo ang iya ginapuy-an sa Vatican, magabalik naman ini sa trabaho kag makapoy ang lawas.
english: The doctor refused to let him leave the hospital because they said that if he was returned to Santa Marta, where he lives in the Vatican, he would return to work and his body would be tired.

text: Ginatugyan man sa Santo Papa ang pag-desisyon kun pangunahan sini ang Angelus prayer halin sa hospital window sini nga Domingo.
english: It is also left to the Pope to decide whether to lead the Angelus prayer from the hospital window this Sunday.

text: Sa Pilipinas, una na nagpaguwa sang panawagan ang church officials nga nagahingyo sa mga tumuluo nga mag-organisar sang community prayers kag Holy Hour para nga mapangamuyo ang recovery sang lider sang Roman Catholic Church.#
english: In the Philippines, church officials have already issued an appeal urging believers to organize community prayers and Holy Hour to pray for the recovery of the leader of the Roman Catholic Church.

text: Isa ka sundalo ang napilasan sa engkwentro nga natabo sa Tapaz, Capiz pasado alas 2:00 sang kaagahon subong nga adlaw, Agosto 22.
english: One soldier was wounded in an encounter that occurred in Tapaz, Capiz around 2:00 am today, August 22.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Roxas kay Col.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Roxas, Col.

text: Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief sang Public Affairs Office sang 3rd Infantry Division, ginpahayag niya nga ang sundalo naigu sa left shoulder kag yara na sa stable nga kondisyon.
english: Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief of the Public Affairs Office of the 3rd Infantry Division, said the soldier was hit in the left shoulder and is in stable condition.

text: Padayon naman ang pursuit operation batok sa mga nabilin nga miyembro sang Regional Sentro de Gravedad kag Central Front sang Komiteng Rehiyon-Panay.
english: The pursuit operation against the remaining members of the Regional Center of Gravity and Central Front of the Regional Committee-Panay continues.

text: Gintingub nga puwersa sang 301st Brigade, 12th Infantry Battalion, 61st IB, 82nd IB, kaupod ang intel units, artillery, armor kag pila ka elemento sang Philippine Air Force ang nag-atubang sa rebelde.
english: Combined forces of the 301st Brigade, 12th Infantry Battalion, 61st IB, 82nd IB, along with intel units, artillery, armor and several elements of the Philippine Air Force confronted the rebels.

text: Ini ang pahayag ni Mamamayang Liberal Rep.
english: This is the statement of Mamamayang Liberal Rep.

text: Leila de Lima kasunod sang pag-apruba sa gin-propose nga layi nga nagadumili sa operasyon sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operations (POGOs) sa pungsod.
english: Leila de Lima following the approval of the proposed law banning the operation of Philippine Offshore Gaming Operations (POGOs) in the country.

text: Suno kay De Lima, dapat masiguro ang hugot nga pagpatuman sang amo nga layi, ilabi na sa idalom sang mga masunod nga administrasyon.
english: According to De Lima, the strict implementation of the law must be ensured, especially under the next administration.

text: “We have been a vocal critic of the existence of these POGOs — a Duterte administration-sponsored Chinese creeping invasion that catered to the interests of Chinese criminals and pro-China government officials,” pahayag sang kongresista.
english: “We have been a vocal critic of the existence of these POGOs — a Duterte administration-sponsored Chinese creeping invasion that catered to the interests of Chinese criminals and pro-China government officials,” the congressman said.

text: “Napakaraming perwisyo ang idinulot nitong mga POGO… pero kinunsinti at prinotektahan pa ng nakaraang administrasyon,” dugang pa.
english: “These POGOs have caused a lot of damage... but the previous administration condoned and protected them,” he added.

text: Naglawig sa masobra lima ka oras ang engkwentro nga nagluntad sa tunga sang mga rebelde nga grupo kag katapo sang Philippine Army sa boundary sang Barangay Artuz, Barangay Agpalali kag Barangay Tabon, Tapaz, Capiz.
english: The encounter between the rebel groups and members of the Philippine Army at the boundary of Barangay Artuz, Barangay Agpalali and Barangay Tabon, Tapaz, Capiz lasted for more than five hours.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Roxas kay Col.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Roxas, Col.

text: Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief sang Public Affairs Office sang 3rd Infantry Division, iya ginpahayag nga nagluntad ang amo nga engkwentro pasado alas-2:00 sang kaagahon subong nga adlaw.
english: Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Chief of the Public Affairs Office of the 3rd Infantry Division, said the encounter took place around 2:00 am today.

text: Suno kay Lamzon, ginpangunahan sang 301st Brigade, 12th Infantry Battalion, 61st IB, 82nd IB, kaupod ang intelligence units, artillery, armor kag pila ka elemento sang Philippine Air Force ang na-engkwentro sang mga dismantled nga miyembro sang Regional Sentro de Gravedad (RSDG) kag Central Front sang Komiteng Rehiyon-Panay.
english: According to Lamzon, the 301st Brigade, 12th Infantry Battalion, 61st IB, 82nd IB, along with intelligence units, artillery, armor and several elements of the Philippine Air Force encountered the dismantled members of the Regional Center and Central Front (DGG) Regional Committee-Panay.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat pa ang opisyal nga progress report kung pila diri ang casualties sa bahin sang rebelde nga grupo.
english: At present, the official progress report on the number of casualties on the part of the rebel group is still awaited.
