english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: Nakuha sang 18-anyos nga Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala ang panibag-o nga titulo sa International Tennis Federation (ITF) matapos ginlutos ang Australian nga kasumpong, 6-2, 6-3, sa finals sang W25 Roehampton tournament sa London, United Kingdom.
english: 18-year-old Filipina tennis star Alex Eala won the new International Tennis Federation (ITF) title after defeating her Australian opponent, 6-2, 6-3, in the finals of the W25 Roehampton tournament in London, United Kingdom.

text: Nagapang-250 si Eala sa world rankings sa tennis apang wala ini nangin sablag sa iya nga i-dominar ang World No.
english: Eala is ranked 250th in the world tennis rankings but that didn't stop her from dominating the World No.

text: 166 kag No.
english: 166 and No.

text: 2 seed nga si Arina Rodionova sang sila ang nagsambuwa sa National Tennis Centre.
english: 2 seed Arina Rodionova when they played at the National Tennis Centre.

text: Antes ang finals, ginlutos man ni Eala si Arianne Hartono sang Netherlands sa semis kag Australian nga si Priscilla Hon sa quarters.
english: Before the finals, Eala also beat Arianne Hartono of the Netherlands in the semis and Australian Priscilla Hon in the quarters.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga professional title ni Eala sa iya nga karera matapos ang pagdaog sa 2023 W25 Yecla sa Spain; 2022 W25 Chiang Rai sa Thailand; kag 2021 W15 Manacor sa Spanish island of Mallorca.
english: This is Eala's fourth professional title in his career after winning the 2023 W25 Yecla in Spain; 2022 W25 Chiang Rai in Thailand; and 2021 W15 Manacor on the Spanish island of Mallorca.

text: Si Eala amo ang ginakilala nga labing-una nga Filipino nga nakadaog sang Grand Slam singles title, kag isa man siya ka produkto sang Rafael Nadal Academy.
english: Eala is recognized as the first Filipino to win a Grand Slam singles title, and he is also a product of the Rafael Nadal Academy.

text: Ginapaabot ni United States President Donald Trump nga magabisita si Chinese President Xi Jinping sa iya sa Washington D.C. apang wala ini sang ginhatag nga petsa.
english: United States President Donald Trump expects Chinese President Xi Jinping to visit him in Washington D.C. but it gives no date.

text: Suno kay Trump, posible nga may bag-o sila nga mahimo nga kasugtanan kaangot sa negosyo.
english: According to Trump, it is possible that they will have a new trade agreement.

text: “We’ll have, ultimately, President Xi, we will have everybody coming (to the U.S.),” suno sa American leader.
english: “We’ll have, ultimately, President Xi, we will have everyone coming (to the U.S.),” according to the American leader.

text: Madamo ang nagabantay sa sini nga meeting sang duha ka lider bangud amo ini ang ginalantaw nga makapahagan-hagan ukon makapa-atrasar sang ginapatuman nga taripa sa mga imported product.
english: Many are watching the meeting between the two leaders as it is expected to ease or delay the implementation of tariffs on imported products.

text: Nobyembre 2023 sang katapusan nga nagbisita ang Chinese president sa US kun sa diin may meeting ini kaupod kay former President Joe Biden kag nakasugtan ang pagbalik sang military-to-military communications kag pagtapna sang fentanyl production.
english: The Chinese president last visited the US in November 2023 where he held a meeting with former President Joe Biden and agreed to restore military-to-military communications and curb fentanyl production.

text: Antes pormal nga nag-umpisa si Trump sa iya trabaho sa White House sang Enero 20, naka-istoryahanay man sila ni Xi kaangot sa kontrobersyal nga isyu sa TikTok, trade, kag isyu sa tension sa Taiwan nga gina-angkon sang China.
english: Before Trump formally took office at the White House on January 20, he also held talks with Xi on the controversial issue of TikTok, trade, and the issue of Taiwan tensions claimed by China.

text: Nadiskubrehan ang iban pa nga autoimmune diseases ni Kris Aquino sang nagpaidalom ini sa dugang nga medical tests sa Estados Unidos.
english: Kris Aquino's other autoimmune diseases were discovered when she underwent additional medical tests in the United States.

text: Suno sa utod nga si Ballsy Aquino, padayon pa ang paninguha sang medical team ni Kris agud nga makakita sang treatment para sa aktres.
english: According to her sister, Ballsy Aquino, Kris' medical team is still working to find treatment for the actress.

text: Ini bangud dapat gid nga ikonsiderar ang iya nga food, plant, kag medicine allergies.
english: This is because his food, plant, and medicine allergies must be considered.

text: Suno kay Ballsy,“Unfortunately, they are still trying to give her the right, correct treatment.
english: According to Ballsy,“Unfortunately, they are still trying to give her the right, correct treatment.

text:
She has so many allergies that all the medicines they’ve been trying haven’t been working, or maybe they did but then the side effects—they were not too happy about.”

Ginpahayag man sang utod nga determinado ang iya manghod nga mag-ayo sa balatian bangud sa iya mga anak nga sanday Josh kag Bimby.
english:
She has so many allergies that all the medicines they’ve been trying haven’t been working, or maybe they did but then the side effects—they were not too happy about.”

The brother also said that his brother is determined to recover from the disease because of his children Josh and Bimby.

text:
“[But the past few days], she has been in good spirits and she says that there are times—well because there was a time she was really feeling that she was about to give up because she was having such a difficult time… but then, when she looks at the pictures of her sons or when she sees them, then she knows she still has to fight.”

Nagpakigkita man si Kris sa iban pa nga doktor nga amo ang maga-take charge sa iya dugang nga treatments.
english:
“[But the past few days], she has been in good spirits and she says that there are times—well because there was a time she was really feeling that she was about to give up because she was having such a difficult time… but then, when she looks at the pictures of her sons or when she sees them, then she knows she still has to fight.”

Kris also met with another doctor who would take charge of her further treatments.

text: “When she left, she had two autoimmune diseases.
english: “When she left, she had two autoimmune diseases.

text: I think now there are four,” pahayag ni Ballsy.
english: I think now there are four,” Ballsy said.

text: Gindugang man sini nga tuman ang pagniwang ni Kris: “She’s not even 90 pounds now, she’s like 85 or 86.
english: He also added that Kris has lost so much weight: “She’s not even 90 pounds now, she’s like 85 or 86.

text: For the other treatments that they want to try, she has to put on more weight.
english: For the other treatments that they want to try, she has to put on more weight.

text:
She has to get a little bit stronger.”

Kun madumduman, sang Hunyo, naka-update pa si Kris sa iya fans kag nag-share nga nagpositibo siya kag ang iya duha ka anak sa Covid-19.
english:
She has to get a little bit stronger.”

In June, Kris updated her fans and shared that she and her two children tested positive for Covid-19.

text: Sang amo nga tion, may yara siya sang tatlo ka kumpirmado nga autoimmune conditions: autoimmune thyroiditis, chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), kag Churg Strauss syndrome.
english: At that time, he had three confirmed autoimmune conditions: autoimmune thyroiditis, chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), and Churg Strauss syndrome.

text: Makaatubang sang Gilas Pilipinas star nga si Jordan Clarkson ang iya teammate sa Utah Jazz nga si Simone Fontecchio nga amo ang magapanguna sa team sang Italya kun magsambuwa ini sa Pilipinas sa group stage sa FIBA World Cup.
english: Gilas Pilipinas star Jordan Clarkson will face his Utah Jazz teammate Simone Fontecchio, who will lead the Italian team when they face the Philippines in the group stage of the FIBA ​​World Cup.

text: Ang 6-foot-7 nga si Fontecchio ang nagahampang nga forward sang Utah Jazz kag amo ang nagaisahanon nga aktibo nga NBA player nga nakasimpon sa beterano kag mga bataon nga player sang Italya.
english: The 6-foot-7 Fontecchio plays forward for the Utah Jazz and is the only active NBA player to join the veteran and young Italian players.

text: Si Clarkson naman ang nag-abot man sa Pilipinas bilang naturalized player kag magabulig sa Pilipinas sa amo nga tournament.
english: Clarkson also arrived in the Philippines as a naturalized player and will help the Philippines in the tournament.

text: Pareho nga yara ang Pilipinas kag Italya sa Group A kun sa diin yara man ang Dominican Republic kag ang Angola.
english: Both the Philippines and Italy are in Group A with the Dominican Republic and Angola.

text: Una nga makaatubang sang Italya ang Angola sa Agusto 25 sa Philippine Arena sa Bulacan antes sini nga maka-sambuwa ang Gilas Pilipinas sa Agusto 27 sa Araneta Coliseum.
english: Angola will first face Italy on August 25 at the Philippine Arena in Bulacan before playing Gilas Pilipinas on August 27 at the Araneta Coliseum.

text: Nagpanugyan si Councilor Sarabia nga imbes nga i-abolish, dapat pabakuron na lang ang accountability kag oversight sa District Engineering Office.
english: Councilor Sarabia suggested that instead of abolishing, the accountability and oversight of the District Engineering Office should be strengthened.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rex Marcus Sarabia, Iloilo City Councilor, suno sa iya nga komplikado ang isyu kag indi siya makasiling nga pabor siya sa total abolition sang opisina.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rex Marcus Sarabia, Iloilo City Councilor, said the issue is complicated and he cannot say that he is in favor of the total abolition of the office.

text: May mga proyekto man nga maayo ang implementasyon, gani may nabuhat man nga maayo ang District Engineering Office.
english: There are also projects that are well implemented, so the District Engineering Office has done something good.

text: “It’s very complicated actually.
english: “It’s very complicated actually.

text: Indi ako makasiling nga pabor ako sa pag-abolish sang District Engineering Office, because admittedly, they also did quite a lot of good.
english: I can’t say I’m in favor of abolishing the District Engineering Office, because admittedly, they also did quite a lot of good.

text: Let’s give it to them,” pahayag sang konsehal.
english: Let’s give it to them,” the councilor said.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga kun i-centralize ini sa national government, posible mag-delay ang mga proyekto.
english: He said that if it is centralized in the national government, projects may be delayed.

text:
“May mga projects man ya nga maayo ang pag-implement, kun increase naton ang oversight sang national basi mag-delay aton projects, isa na sa mga points to consider, kun icentralise naton sa national, so it’s a matter if ‘accountability’ na lang and ‘scrutiny na lang sa mga projects nga ni para ma determine na lang kun consistent gid man ang mga local projects ni,” suno kay Sarabia

Dugang pa niya, mas importante subong ang pagpabakod sang oversight kag pagsiguro nga accountable ang mga naga-implementar sang proyekto.
english:
“There are projects that are well implemented, if we increase the oversight of the national may delay our projects, one of the points to consider, if we centralize in the national, so it's a matter if accountability and scrutiny of these projects to determine if the local projects are consistent,” said Sarabia.

He added that it is more important now to strengthen oversight and ensure accountability of project implementers.

text: “I’m not entirely into the abolition of the District Engineer as an office,” suno sa iya, “pero I would like to pursue accountability kag strengthened nga oversight.”
english: “I’m not entirely into the abolition of the District Engineer as an office,” he said, “but I would like to pursue accountability and strengthened oversight.”

text: Nagpromisa ang Hamas militants nga ibalik na subong nga adlaw ang bangkay sang apat nga mga taga-Israel lakip na ang duha ka mga bata nga ila ginbihag sadtong Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: Hamas militants have promised to return today the bodies of four Israelis, including two children, whom they kidnapped on October 7, 2023.

text: Ang duha ka kabataan, sanday Kfir kag Ariel, ang nagaedad sang siyam ka bulan kag apat ka tuig sang gin-kidnap halin sa southern Israel.
english: The two children, Kfir and Ariel, were nine months and four years old when kidnapped from southern Israel.

text: Ibalik man ang lawas sang ila nga iloy nga si Shiri Bibas.
english: The body of their mother, Shiri Bibas, will also be returned.

text: Suno sa Hamas, napatay ang mag-iloy sang nag-atake ang Israel sa Gaza kun sa diin ginbihag sang mga militante ang mga Israeli.
english: According to Hamas, the mother and daughter were killed during an Israeli attack on Gaza where militants captured Israelis.

text: Wala ini ginkumpirma sang Israeli army.
english: The Israeli army did not confirm this.

text: Ang amay naman sang mga bata nga si Yarden ang nabuy-an na sang Hamas sini lamang nga bulan.
english: The children's father, Yarden, was released by Hamas this month.

text: Magluwas sa apat ka mga bangkay, hilwayon man subong ang 83-anyos nga journalist nga si Oded Lifshitz.
english: In addition to the four bodies, 83-year-old journalist Oded Lifshitz will now be released.

text: Dugang dira, buy-an sang Hamas sa weekend ang apat ka mga buhi nga hostages.
english: In addition, Hamas will release four living hostages over the weekend.

text: Bilang kabaylo, magapaguwa man ang Israel sang mga babaye nga naaresto halin sang Oktubre.
english: In exchange, Israel will also release women who have been detained since October.

text: Kabahin ini sang una nga hugnat sang pag-release sang hostages kag prisoners/detainees bilang kabahin sang ceasefire agreement sa Gaza war.
english: This is part of the first phase of the release of hostages and prisoners/detainees as part of the ceasefire agreement on the Gaza war.

text: Nakabalik na si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is back.

text: sa Pilipinas kaina sang kaagahon matapos nagtambong sa 47th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit sa Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
english: in the Philippines this morning after attending the 47th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

text: Sa arrival statement sang presidente, ginsiling sini nga ang ASEAN Summit isa ka oportunidad para sa 11 ka member states kag sa ila mga partner nga madiskusyunan ang importante nga mga isyu sa tunga sang mga pagpanghangkat sa geopolitics kag sa ekonomiya.
english: In his arrival statement, the president said the ASEAN Summit is an opportunity for the 11 member states and their partners to discuss important issues amid geopolitical and economic challenges.

text: Lakip sa nadiskusyunan suno sa iya amo ang West Philippine Sea.
english: Among the issues discussed, he said, was the West Philippine Sea.

text: “We discussed significant international issues that emerging challenges that not only impact our peoples and our nation, but also the entire region, especially the West Philippine Sea,” suno sa punong ehekutibo.
english: “We discussed significant international issues that emerging challenges that not only impact our peoples and our nation, but also the entire region, especially the West Philippine Sea,” the chief executive said.

text: Pahayag sini, magapabilin ang Pilipinas nga mabakod kag kalmado sa pagdepensa sa soberanya kag kinamatarong kag hurisdiksyon sa amo nga teritoryo.
english: He said the Philippines will remain strong and calm in defending its sovereignty and rights and jurisdiction in the territory.

text: Ini tanan suno sa iya ang nagasanto sa kun ano ang nakabutang sa international law.
english: All of this, he said, is in line with what is stipulated in international law.

text: Gindugang sini nga magapadayon ang pungsod sa pagpabakod pa sa partnership sa mga pungsod nga kaangay sa Pilipinas nagahatag sang balor sa kalinong kag progreso sa ekonomiya.
english: He added that the country will continue to strengthen partnerships with countries like the Philippines that value peace and economic progress.

text: “The leaders and I spoke about future-proofing our region through economic cooperation and sustainable growth,” pahayag sini.
english: “The leaders and I spoke about future-proofing our region through economic cooperation and sustainable growth,” it said.

text:
Nagpahayag ang ASEAN leaders suno sa iya sang ila nga collective commitment sa “rules-based, open, inclusive, transparent, and non-discriminatory multilateral system.”

Nahibaluan nga antes nagtakop ang Summit and Related Summits, gin-turnover sang Malaysia sa Pilipinas ang hosting duties bilang chair sang ASEAN sa 2026.#
english:
He said ASEAN leaders have expressed their collective commitment to a “rules-based, open, inclusive, transparent, and non-discriminatory multilateral system.”

Before the Summit and Related Summits ended, Malaysia turned over to the Philippines the hosting duties as chair of ASEAN in 2026.#

text: Patay ang 16-anyos nga solterito matapos nga ginluthang sang wala pa makilal-an nga indibidwal sa Brgy.
english: A 16-year-old boy was shot dead by an unidentified individual in Brgy.

text: Bita-og Gaja, New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: Bita-og Gaja, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Chairel Dela Cruz, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Chairel Dela Cruz, resident of Brgy.

text: Inagdangan, Zarraga, Iloilo.
english: Inaggadan, Zarraga, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Corporal Greg Gonce, imbestigador sang New Lucena Municipal Police Station (MP), iya ginpahayag nga nagwa ang biktima sa balay sang iya magulang agud magconnect sa piso wifi malapit lang sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Corporal Greg Gonce, investigator of the New Lucena Municipal Police Station (MP), said the victim went out of his brother's house to connect to the piso wifi nearby.

text: Makaligad ang pila ka minutos, may nabatian nga asud-asud nga lupok ang iya magulang.
english: A few minutes later, his brother heard a loud gunshot.

text: Sang naggwa ini, naabtan na lang niya ang manghod nga nagahuray-ad, may igo sang bala sa tuo nga bahin sang iya dughan kag wala na sang kabuhi.
english: When he came out, he found his younger brother lying on the floor, with a bullet wound in the right side of his chest and dead.

text: Base sa panaysayon sang utod sini, nakadalagan pa ang biktima halin sa ginhulugan sini sang piso wifi tubtob sa likod sang ila puluy-an.
english: According to his brother, the victim managed to run from where he dropped the wifi money to the back of their house.

text: Narecover sa crime scene ang 13 ka basiyo sang 9mm caliber.
english: Recovered from the crime scene were 13 rounds of 9mm caliber.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan kag may person of interest na nga ginasundan.
english: Police are still investigating and a person of interest is being followed.

text: Gin-dominar sa gihapon sang Pilipinas ang ikaduha nga hampang sini batok sa Iran sa Heyuan WUS International Basketball Tournament sa China, 63-48.
english: The Philippines still dominated its second game against Iran in the Heyuan WUS International Basketball Tournament in China, 63-48.

text: Ini ang katapusan nga hampang sang Gilas sa amo nga pocket tournament kun sa diin ginauyatan sini ang 3-1 win-loss record.
english: This is the Gilas' last game in the pocket tournament where they hold a 3-1 win-loss record.

text: Una na nga nalutos sang Gilas ang Iran; samtang ang isa naman sini ka pierde ang naangkon sini sa una nga pagsambuwa batok sa team sang Senegal.
english: The Gilas had previously beaten Iran; while the other loss was in the first match against the Senegal team.

text: Wala sa sambuwa ang Filipino-American NBA guard nga si Jordan Clarkson, si Kai Sotto, kag si Scottie Thompson, apang nagpakita sang abilidad si Dwight Ramos paagi sa iya 17 points kag 14 rebounds.
english: Filipino-American NBA guard Jordan Clarkson, Kai Sotto, and Scottie Thompson were not in the game, but Dwight Ramos showed ability with his 17 points and 14 rebounds.

text: Sa Agusto 20, may yara sang friendly match ang Pilipinas batok sa Montenegro kag may sambuwa man batok sa Mexico sa Agusto 21 kun sa diin ginalauman nga yara na si Clarkson.
english: On August 20, the Philippines will have a friendly match against Montenegro and a match against Mexico on August 21 where Clarkson is expected to be present.

text: Ginapanan-aw ni Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno nga magasarurot ang inflation nga mas manubo pa sa target sang gobyerno sa una nga quarter sang 2024.
english: Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno expects inflation to fall below the government's target in the first quarter of 2024.

text: Sini lang nga Hunyo sang ginpanubo sang Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) ang panan-awan sini sa inflation sa 2023.
english: It was only this June that the Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC) lowered its 2023 inflation outlook.

text: Ginhimo ini nga 5% tubtub 6% halin sa una nga estimate nga 5% tubtub 7% nga gin-anunsyo sang Abril.
english: This was increased to 5% to 6% from the initial estimate of 5% to 7% announced in April.

text: Ini bangud sa nakit-an nga padayon nga pagnubo sa inflation nga 6.1% sang Mayo halin sa 6.6% sang Abril nga rason kun ngaa nahimo nga 7.5% ang year-to-date rate.
english: This is due to the continued decline in inflation to 6.1% in May from 6.6% in April, which brought the year-to-date rate to 7.5%.

text: Suno kay Diokno, posible magtupa sa 2%–4% band ang inflation sa fourth quarter subong nga 2023.
english: According to Diokno, inflation is likely to fall in the 2%–4% band in the fourth quarter of 2023.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang tiglikom nga naganubo na ang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The secretary said the price of petroleum products is already falling.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang DBCC nga posible magbalik ang inflation sa target range nga 2% tubtub sa 4% sa 2024 bangud sang ginahimo sang Inter-Agency Committee on Inflation and Market Outlook nga proactive measures agud ma-address ang problema sa nagasinaka nga presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: Earlier, the DBCC said inflation is likely to return to the target range of 2% to 4% in 2024 due to the proactive measures taken by the Inter-Agency Committee on Inflation and Market Outlook to address the problem of rising commodity prices.

text: Matunog ang espekulasyon nga posible makaupod ni Liza Soberano sa iya first Hollywood movie ang American actors nga sanday Cole Sprouse kag Kathryn Newton.
english: There is a lot of speculation that Liza Soberano might star in her first Hollywood movie with American actors Cole Sprouse and Kathryn Newton.

text: Sa upcoming movie ini nga “Lisa Frankenstein” nga ginsulat sang Oscar winner nga si Diablo Cody kag gina-direct ni Zelda Williams, anak sang late actor nga si Robin Williams.
english: In the upcoming movie it’s “Lisa Frankenstein” written by Oscar winner Diablo Cody and directed by Zelda Williams, daughter of the late actor Robin Williams.

text:
Wala pa na-anunsyo kun kalakip si Liza sa cast sang pelikula, apang sa Instagram Story ni Jessie Stafford (nagapanag-iya sang Los Angeles-based event production company JSLA Events), gin-repost ang isa sa posts ni Newton sa set kag nagsiling nga: “Sending you and your team all the amazing energy to kill this film!”

Na-tag sa amo nga story si Liza, Transparent Arts, kag ang “Lisa Frankenstein” director nga si Williams.
english:
It hasn’t been announced if Liza will be in the film’s cast, but Jessie Stafford’s Instagram Story (owner of Los Angeles-based event production company JSLA Events), reposted one of Newton’s posts on set and said: “Sending you and your team all the amazing energy to kill this film!”

Liza, Transparent Arts, and “Lisa Frankenstein” director Williams were tagged in that story.

text: Mayo lang sang gin-anunsyo nga nagpa-manage si Liza kay James Reid nga kabahin sang US-based Transparent Arts group kun sa diin may yara sang Asian-American talents.
english: It was recently announced that Liza has managed James Reid, who is part of the US-based Transparent Arts group, which features Asian-American talents.

text: Isa pa sa mga clue nga posible nga yara sa cast sang movie si Liza amo bangud nakit-an nga gina-follow siya nanday Williams kag Newton sa Instagram.
english: Another clue that Liza might be in the cast of the movie is because Williams and Newton have been spotted following her on Instagram.

text:
Nakit-an man nga gin-like ni Liza ang Instagram post ni Williams nga naga-promote sang “Lisa Frankenstein.”

Ginahulat pa ang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon ni Liza kun kabahin siya sang amo nga Hollywood film, nga kun matabo, amo ang iya debut sa iya potential career sa United States.
english:
Liza was also seen liking Williams’ Instagram post promoting “Lisa Frankenstein.”

Liza is still waiting for official confirmation if she will be part of the Hollywood film, which if it happens, will be her debut in her potential career in the United States.

text: Nagalaum ang goalkeeper sang Philippine women’s national football team nga madugangan pa ang goals sang Pilipinas sa maragtason sini nga pagpasakop sa nagapadayon nga 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup.
english: The goalkeeper of the Philippine women's national football team hopes to add more goals to the Philippines in its historic participation in the ongoing 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup.

text: Suno kay Olivia McDaniel nga amo man ang ginhingadlan nga Player of the Match matapos ginlutos ang New Zealand, para sa tanan ang ila nga nahimo gani nagalaum ang team nga mapasagunsunan pa ini sang masunod nga kadalag-an.
english: According to Olivia McDaniel, who was also named Player of the Match after defeating New Zealand, what they did was for everyone and the team hopes to continue it with the next victory.

text: Magluwas sa maayo nga performance sang 25-anyos nga goalkeeper sa tournament, ginakabig man ini nga daku nga parte sang pagsaka sang Filipinas sa international games lakip na ang iya duha ka saves sa penalty shootout sa World Cup-clinching quarterfinal win batok sa Chinese-Taipei sa 2022 Women’s Asian Cup.
english: Aside from the 25-year-old goalkeeper’s excellent performance in the tournament, she is also credited as a big part of the Philippines’ rise in international games including her two saves in the penalty shootout in the World Cup-clinching quarterfinal win against Chinese-Taipei in the 2022 Women’s Asian Cup.

text: Balik trabaho naman subong kag paspas sa training ang Filipinas bilang preparasyon para sa sambuwa batok sa European powerhouse nga Norway nga amo ang ila katapusan nga maatubang sa Group A sa Auckland, New Zealand.
english: The Philippines are now back to work and training fast in preparation for the match against European powerhouse Norway which is their last Group A match in Auckland, New Zealand.

text: Nahibaluan nga kun basehan ang world rankings, pinakamataas ang Norway sa Group A nga pang-World Number 12 kun sa diin lakip man ang best players nga sanday former Ballon d’Or winner Ada Hegerberg kag Barcelona superstar Caroline Graham Hansen.
english: It is known that based on the world rankings, Norway is the highest in Group A of World Number 12 where the best players are also former Ballon d'Or winner Ada Hegerberg and Barcelona superstar Caroline Graham Hansen.

text: Apang kun basehan naman ang performance subong nga World Cup, nalutos ini sang New Zealand 1-0 sa imbukada nga hampang kag nagtapos naman sa goalless draw ang ikaduha sini nga hampang kun sa diin nakasumpong sini ang Switzerland.
english: However, based on the performance of the current World Cup, New Zealand lost 1-0 in the opening match and ended in a goalless draw in the second match against Switzerland.

text: Balantayan sa Domingo ang hampang sang Pilipinas kag Norway sa Eden Park sa Auckland.
english: Watch the match between the Philippines and Norway at Eden Park in Auckland on Sunday.

text: Gin-athag ni Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno nga indi pagpataasan ang buwis sa instant noodles apisar pa sang mataas sini nga sodium content.
english: Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno clarified that the tax on instant noodles will not be increased despite its high sodium content.

text: Ang kada pack sang instant noodles nagaunod sang 1,500 milligrams tubtub masobra 2,000 mg sang sodium, samtang gina-rekomendar naman sa kada tawo nga magkonsumo lamang sang less than 2,300 mg kada adlaw.
english: Each pack of instant noodles contains 1,500 milligrams to more than 2,000 mg of sodium, while each person is recommended to consume less than 2,300 mg per day.

text: Suno kay Diokno, bisan pa may 60% sodium content ini, indi pagpasakaan ang sukot sa buwis bangud amo sini masami ang ginakaon sang pigado nga mga pamilya.
english: According to Diokno, even if it has 60% sodium content, the tax rate will not be increased because it is often eaten by poor families.

text: “If you’re thinking of the noodles, which are really salty, we will not cover that.
english: “If you’re thinking of the noodles, which are really salty, we will not cover that.

text: We know that many of our poor Filipinos consume that,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: We know that many of our poor Filipinos consume that,” the secretary said.

text: Pagpaathag ini sang opisyal kasunod sang pahayag ni Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman sang nagligad nga semana nga ginaduso sang Marcos administration nga pasakaan ang buwis subong nga tuig partikular na sa sweetened beverages kag junk food.
english: The official's clarification follows Budget Secretary Amenah Pangandaman's statement last week that the Marcos administration is proposing to raise taxes this year particularly on sweetened beverages and junk food.

text: Ini agud matapna ang diabetes, obesity, kag non-communicable diseases nga makuha sa poor diet.
english: This is to prevent diabetes, obesity, and non-communicable diseases caused by poor diet.

text: Suno naman kay Diokno, nagapakig-angot na ang Department of Finance sa National Nutrition Council kag sa Department of Health agud makakuha sang lista kun ano ang ilakip nga mga pagkaon.
english: Diokno said the Department of Finance is already in contact with the National Nutrition Council and the Department of Health to obtain a list of foods to be included.

text: Nakabunggo ang isa ka motorsiklo sa pribado nga salakyan kagab-i sa Barangay Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: A motorcycle collided with a private vehicle last night in Barangay Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Radjie Casiple, isa ka security guard nga nakasaksi sang insidente, iya ginpahayag nga madasig ang pagpadalagan sang driver sang motorsiklo rason nga nabunggo ini sa iya nasumalang nga SUV nga nagapaliko pasulod sa subdivision sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Radjie Casiple, a security guard who witnessed the incident, said the driver of the motorcycle was driving fast and collided with an SUV that was turning into a subdivision in the said area.

text: Suno sa iya, ara sa insakto nga linya kag nagasignal ang SUV nga maliko apang tungod sa kadasigon nga pagmaneho sang driver sang iya motorsiklo wala na ini nakalikaw kag nabunggo deritso sa SUV.
english: He said the SUV was in the right lane and was signaling to turn but due to the speed of the driver of his motorcycle, he could not avoid it and hit the SUV.

text: Bangud sa impact, wasak ang atubangan nga bahin sang motorsiklo samtang gupi na man ang kilid sang SUV.
english: Due to the impact, the front of the motorcycle was damaged while the side of the SUV was damaged.

text: Gilayon gindala sa hospital ang driver sang motorsiklo.
english: The driver of the motorcycle was rushed to the hospital.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan sa insidente kag sa pagkakilal-an sang driver sang motorsiklo.
english: Police are still investigating the incident and the identity of the motorcycle driver.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: MANILA — Inihayag ng bagong officer-in-charge ng National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) na si Angelito Magno na magiging prayoridad ng ahensya ang pagsasampa ng mga kaso kaugnay ng mga iregularidad sa mga proyekto sa flood control.
english: MANILA — The new officer-in-charge of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Angelito Magno said the agency will prioritize filing cases related to irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Ayon kay Magno, na pumalit kay Jaime Santiago matapos itong magbitiw bilang direktor ng NBI nitong unang bahagi ng buwan, tututukan ng kanyang pamunuan ang imbestigasyon sa mga “ghost” flood control projects at sa mga proyektong natukoy na substandard o mababa ang kalidad.
english: According to Magno, who replaced Jaime Santiago after he resigned as NBI director earlier this month, his administration will focus on investigating ghost flood control projects and projects identified as substandard or low quality.

text: “’Yung pag-iimbestiga dito sa mga una, sa mga ghost projects, ‘yun ang ating priority at masampahan kung sino man ang dapat sampahan ng kaso,” pahayag ni Magno.
english: “The investigation of the first, the ghost projects, that's our priority and we will prosecute whoever should be prosecuted,” Magno said.

text: Dagdag pa niya, ipagpapatuloy ng NBI ang mga programa at inisyatiba na sinimulan ng kanyang pinalitang si Santiago.
english: He added that the NBI will continue the programs and initiatives initiated by his replacement Santiago.

text: “Tuloy-tuloy ‘yung laban natin diyan, at mas lalo pa nating paiigtingin dito sa Maynila at lalo na sa ating mga probinsya,” ani Magno.
english: “We will continue our fight there, and we will intensify it here in Manila and especially in our provinces,” Magno said.

text: Nauna nang bumuo ang Department of Justice (DOJ) ng isang task force upang siyasatin ang mga anomalya sa mga proyekto sa flood control sa bansa.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has earlier formed a task force to investigate anomalies in flood control projects in the country.

text: Samantala, sinabi ni Ombudsman Boying Remulla na inaasahang maisasampa ang mga kaso kaugnay ng flood control probe sa Nobyembre.
english: Meanwhile, Ombudsman Boying Remulla said the cases related to the flood control probe are expected to be filed in November.

text: Na-diagnose nga may pneumonia sa duha ka baga si Pope Francis kasunod sang pagpaidalom sini sa ct scan samtang nagapabilin sa ospital.
english: Pope Francis was diagnosed with pneumonia in both lungs after undergoing a ct scan while in hospital.

text: Suno sa Vatican, ang tests nagapadayon sa pagpakita sang “complex picture” para sa isa sa pinakatigulang nga santo papa sa maragtas sang simbahan.
english: According to the Vatican, the tests continue to show a “complex picture” for one of the oldest popes in church history.

text: Ang bilateral pneumonia ang nagakinahanglan sang dugang nga pharmacological therapy suno pa sa Vatican.
english: Bilateral pneumonia requires additional pharmacological therapy, the Vatican said.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginsiling sang Vatican nga in good spirits ang 88-anyos nga santo papa kag nagapasalamat sa tanan nga nagapangamuyo para sa iya.
english: Meanwhile, the Vatican said the 88-year-old pope is in good spirits and thanks all those who pray for him.

text: Antes ang pneumonia diagnosis, ang mga tumuluo sa guwa sang Vatican ang nagpahayag sang ila kabalaka sa kondisyon sang santo papa.
english: Before the pneumonia diagnosis, the faithful outside the Vatican had expressed concern about the pope’s condition.

text: Patay ang 41-anyos nga amay matapos nga ginlampusan sang duha ka lalaki sa Brgy.
english: A 41-year-old father was stabbed to death by two men in Brgy.

text: Namocon, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: Namocon, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Reymond Dilig Tuburan, kasado, panday, samtang ang suspek amo si Romvic Tumalaytay, legal ang pang-edaron, lunsay residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Reymond Dilig Tuburan, married, carpenter, while the suspect was identified as Romvic Tumalaytay, legal age, both residents of the said barangay.

text: Ang isa naman ka suspek ang padayon naman nga gina-identify sang kapulisan.
english: The other suspect is still being identified by the police.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, Officer-In-Charge sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station (MPS), iya ginpahayag nga halin sa highway ang biktima angkas ang iya lima ka tuig nga anak.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alfred Mansoy, Officer-In-Charge of the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station (MPS), said the victim was coming from the highway with his five-year-old son.

text: Sang malapit na sa ila balay, ginlambatan  sila sang duha ka lalaki kag ginlampusan sang ginabulubanta 3 ka tapak nga kalabaon nga kahoy kun sa diin, nakita ini tanan sang iya anak.
english: When they were near their house, they were ambushed by two men and beaten with a 3-foot-long stick.

text: Natigayon naman nga madakpan ang suspek matapos nga nagsungka ini sa kapulisan halin sa balay sang iya amigo sa Parara Norte, Tigbauan kag pag-identify sang 5 ka tuig nga bata sang biktima.
english: The suspect was arrested after he surrendered to the police from his friend's house in Parara Norte, Tigbauan and identified the victim's 5-year-old son.

text: Hugot naman nga ginapanginwala sang suspek nga gin-ubra sini ang krimen.
english: The suspect denied committing the crime.

text: Padayon sa gihapon ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan kag pag- identify sa isa pa gid sini ka kaupod.
english: Police are still investigating and identifying another accomplice.

text: Ginapuntariya sang pageant fans sa Thailand si Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi.
english: Pageant fans in Thailand are targeting Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi.

text: Ini kasunod sang Facebook post sang isa ka Thai pageant fan page nga Talkmissthailand kun sa diin ginpakita ang photoshopped ukon edited photo ni Celeste sang nagdaog ini bilang Miss Philippines Earth Italy sang 2018 kag ang isa pa ka litrato amo ang iya pagdaog bilang Miss Universe Philippines 2022.
english: This follows a Facebook post by a Thai pageant fan page Talkmissthailand which showed a photoshopped or edited photo of Celeste when she won Miss Philippines Earth Italy in 2018 and another photo of her winning Miss Universe Philippines 2022.

text:

english:

text: Madasig man ang fans sang Filipino-Italian pageant titleholder sa pag-depensa sa iya nga pangalan.
english: Fans of the Filipino-Italian pageant titleholder were also quick to defend her name.

text: Sa tunga sini, nangin graceful naman ang sabat sang reigning Miss Universe Philippines sa isyu.
english: Meanwhile, the reigning Miss Universe Philippines' response to the issue was graceful.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nakit-an niya ang edited photos, nabasa niya ang mga insulto kag ang mga pagpamahog.
english: He said he saw the edited photos, read the insults and the threats.

text: Gintawag niya ini bilang “unnecessary cyberbullying” kag nagalaum siya nga mabuhinan ini kag matapna.
english: She termed it as “unnecessary cyberbullying” and she hopes it can be reduced and prevented.

text: Sa statement sang beauty queen, gin-engganyo man sini ang iya fans nga indi gid magsabat kag indi man magpatol.
english: In a statement, the beauty queen also encouraged her fans not to respond and not to cut.

text: Sa baylo, mas maayo suno sa iya nga gamiton ang hashtag nga #kindnesscampaign agud malikawan ang “any form of hate.” ##
english: Instead, he said it would be better to use the hashtag #kindnesscampaign to avoid “any form of hate.” ##

text: Wala ang Serbian superstar kag National Basketball Association (NBA) Finals Most Valuable Player (MVP) nga si Nikola Jokic sa nagahilapit nga FIBA World Cup sa Pilipinas.
english: Serbian superstar and National Basketball Association (NBA) Finals Most Valuable Player (MVP) Nikola Jokic will be absent from the upcoming FIBA ​​World Cup in the Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag sa ginkumbinse man kuntani sang coach ang two-time NBA-MVP nga maghampang para sa Serbia, apang nagpamalibad na ini bangud sa mga prayoridad sini nga kinahanglan unahon matapos nakuha ang 2022-2023 championship kaupod sa Denver Nuggets.
english: The coach reportedly tried to convince the two-time NBA-MVP to play for Serbia, but he refused because of his priorities after winning the 2022-2023 championship with the Denver Nuggets.

text: Kun matandaan, nakaupod si Jokic sa team sang Serbia sa 2019 FIBA World Cup sa China nga nagtapos sa 6-2 record kag nagpanglima sa amo nga edisyon.
english: Jokic was part of the Serbian team in the 2019 FIBA ​​World Cup in China that finished with a 6-2 record and finished fifth in that edition.

text: Pananglitan wala si Jokic, daku ini nga pagpanghangkat sa Serbia nga maga-atubang sa China, South Sudan kag Puerto Rico sa Group B sa stage games sa Araneta Coliseum sa katapusan sang Agusto.
english: Suppose Jokic is out, it will be a big challenge for Serbia who will face China, South Sudan and Puerto Rico in Group B in stage games at Araneta Coliseum at the end of August.

text: Katapusan nga nakaupod sa Serbia si Jokic nga kilala man nga The Joker sa Eurobasket kag sa European Qualifiers.
english: Jokic, also known as The Joker, last played for Serbia in Eurobasket and the European Qualifiers.

text: Sa World Cup qualifiers, may yara ini sang average nga 26.5 points, 9.0 rebounds, kag 3.0 assists sa duha ka games.
english: In World Cup qualifiers, he averaged 26.5 points, 9.0 rebounds, and 3.0 assists in two games.

text: Itataguyod ni Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: ang interes pang-ekonomiya ng Pilipinas at palalakasin ang ugnayan sa mga kasaping bansa ng Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) sa 32nd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting na gaganapin sa South Korea mula Oktubre 30 hanggang Nobyembre 2, ayon sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
english: the Philippines' economic interests and strengthen ties with Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) countries at the 32nd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting to be held in South Korea from October 30 to November 2, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).

text: Sa pre-departure briefing sa Malacañang, sinabi ni DFA Spokesperson Angelica Escalona na tutungo si Pangulong Marcos sa Busan at Gyeongju sa imbitasyon ni South Korean President Lee Jae Myung.
english: In a pre-departure briefing in Malacañang, DFA Spokesperson Angelica Escalona said President Marcos will head to Busan and Gyeongju at the invitation of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung.

text: Ayon sa DFA, inaasahang magbubunga ang dalawang sesyon ng APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting ng apat na dokumento, kabilang ang leaders’ declaration at tatlong pahayag ukol sa artificial intelligence (AI), pagbabago sa demograpiya, at industriyang kultural at malikhaing sining.
english: According to the DFA, the two sessions of the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting are expected to produce four documents, including the leaders’ declaration and three statements on artificial intelligence (AI), demographic change, and the cultural and creative arts industry.

text: Bilang bahagi ng kanyang pagdalo, makikibahagi rin si Pangulong Marcos sa Leaders’ Dialogue with the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) at magbibigay ng talumpati sa APEC CEO Summit, na nagtitipon sa mga kinatawan ng APEC at mga nangungunang negosyante upang talakayin ang mahahalagang isyung pang-ekonomiya sa rehiyon.
english: As part of his visit, President Marcos will also participate in the Leaders' Dialogue with the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) and deliver a speech at the APEC CEO Summit, which brings together APEC representatives and leading businessmen to discuss important economic issues in the region.

text: Bukod dito, makikipagpulong din ang Pangulo sa mga negosyante at lider ng industriya, at makikisalamuha sa mga miyembro ng Filipino community sa Busan.
english: The President will also meet with businessmen and industry leaders, and meet with members of the Filipino community in Busan.

text: Bilang huling bahagi ng kanyang pagbisita, pangungunahan ni Pangulong Marcos ang wreath-laying at tree planting ceremony sa United Nations Memorial Cemetery sa Busan bilang pagpupugay sa 7,420 sundalong Pilipino na lumaban sa Korean War bilang bahagi ng Philippine Expeditionary Forces to Korea.
english: As the final part of his visit, President Marcos will lead a wreath-laying and tree planting ceremony at the United Nations Memorial Cemetery in Busan in tribute to the 7,420 Filipino soldiers who fought in the Korean War as part of the Philippine Expeditionary Forces to Korea.

text: Ginbuksan sang Iloilo City Government ang bag-o nga PESO Recruitment Center subong nga adlaw, Agosto 18, 2025, sa second floor sang City Hall.
english: The Iloilo City Government opened the new PESO Recruitment Center today, August 18, 2025, on the second floor of the City Hall.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PESO Manager Mx.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PESO Manager Mx.

text: Gab Umadhay, ang center ginpatukod para sa kahapusan sang mga job seekers nga gusto magpangita sang trabaho.
english: Gab Umadhay, the center was established for the convenience of job seekers who want to find work.

text: Pasalig ni Umadhay nga ang mga aplikante nga magsulod sa center may matatap nga staff nga magabulig sa ila, magaconnect sa employer, kag magahatag sang update kon ano na ang status sang aplikasyon.
english: Umadhay assured that applicants who enter the center will have caring staff who will assist them, connect with the employer, and provide updates on the status of the application.

text: Kun wala pa sang available nga employer, ang staff mismo ang magapakig-angut sa mga kompanya para sa posibilidad sang placement.
english: If there is no employer available, the staff will contact the companies themselves for the possibility of placement.

text: Maluwas sa job matching, ang center man ang magabulig sa mga aplikante sa pagproseso sang dokumento, paghimo kag pagprint sang resume, pagkuha sang ID pictures, kag iban pa nga kinahanglanon sa aplikasyon.
english: In addition to job matching, the center will also help applicants with document processing, resume creation and printing, taking ID pictures, and other application requirements.

text: Ginpabutyag man ni Umadhay nga may 5,147 ka job opportunities nga pagatanyag sang center sa Oktubre, kabahin sang logistics, industrial, agriculture, kag BPO sectors.
english: Umadhay also said that there are 5,147 job opportunities that the center will offer in October, part of the logistics, industrial, agriculture, and BPO sectors.

text: May 235 man ka oportunidad para sa mga luyag magnegosyo paagi sa entrepreneurship programs.
english: There are also 235 opportunities for those who want to start a business through entrepreneurship programs.

text: Ang launching ginpasakupan sang mga key partners halin sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) 6, Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) RO 6, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) 6, kag Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) 6.
english: The launching was attended by key partners from the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) 6, Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) RO 6, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) 6, and Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) 6.

text: Gindayaw sang mga ahensya ang pagpanikasog sang syudad sa paghatag sang mas epektibo nga serbisyo sa mga Ilonggo.
english: The agencies praised the city's efforts to provide more effective services to Ilonggos.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga recruitment center sang PESO, matapos sang una nga ginbuksan sa SM City Iloilo, samtang ang ikatatlo yara sa Robinsons Mall.
english: This is the second recruitment center of PESO, after the first one opened at SM City Iloilo, while the third is at Robinsons Mall.

text: Balantayan 1:30 karon sa hapon (oras sa Pilipinas) ang hampang sang Philippine women’s national football team kontra sa New Zealand sa FIFA World Cup 2023.
english: The Philippine women's national football team will play New Zealand in the FIFA World Cup 2023 at 1:30 pm today.

text: Patigayunon ang hampang sa Wellington Regional Stadium kun sa diin ginalauman nga lunsay fans sang World Number 26 ang magakadto.
english: The match will be held at the Wellington Regional Stadium where all fans of the World Number 26 are expected to attend.

text: Preska ang New Zealand halin sa 1-0 nga kadalag-an batok sa World Number 12 nga Norway sa imbukada sang tournament.
english: New Zealand are fresh off a 1-0 win over World Number 12 Norway in the tournament opener.

text: Ang Filipinas naman ang nalutos sa kamot sang Switzerland, 2-0, sa ila nga debut game.
english: The Philippines lost to Switzerland, 2-0, in their debut game.

text: Yara subong ang Filipinas sa pang-ulihi nga pwesto sa Group A nga may 0 point kag may -2 nga goal difference.
english: The Philippines is currently in last place in Group A with 0 points and a -2 goal difference.

text: Nagapanguna naman sa group ang Switzerland nga may 3 points, +2 goal difference; sunod ang New Zealand nga may 3 points, +1 goal difference; kag ang Norway nga may zero point, -1 goal difference.
english: Switzerland leads the group with 3 points, +2 goal difference; followed by New Zealand with 3 points, +1 goal difference; and Norway with a zero point, -1 goal difference.

text: Indi sigurado ang Vatican kun san-o mahimo makaguwa sa ospital si Pope Francis.
english: The Vatican is not sure when Pope Francis could be released from the hospital.

text: Suno kay Matteo Bruni, director sang Holy See Press office, magapadayon ang pagbulong sa 88-anyos nga Santo Papa sa ospital sa Roma tubtub nga kinahanglan.
english: According to Matteo Bruni, director of the Holy See Press office, the 88-year-old Pope will continue to be treated at a hospital in Rome until necessary.

text: May yara ini sang respiratory tract infection, apang suno kay Bruni, nakatulog ini sang maayo kag wala nagtaas ang hilanat sa una nga gab-i sang pagpabulong.
english: He had a respiratory tract infection, but Bruni said he slept well and didn’t run a fever the first night of treatment.

text: Antes ang medical treatment, isa ka semana na nga nagasuprer si Pope sang bronchitis kag nagapalihog na lang sa iya mga aide sa pagbasa sa iya nga speeches kag addresses bangud nabudlayan maghambal kag magginhawa.
english: Before the medical treatment, Pope had been suffering from bronchitis for a week and was asking his aides to read his speeches and addresses because he had difficulty speaking and breathing.

text: Biyernes sang aga oras sa Roma sang gindala ini sa Gemelli Hospital nga amo ang pinakadaku nga pasilidad sa amo nga pungsod.
english: He was taken to the Gemelli Hospital, the largest facility in the country, on Friday morning.

text: May espesyal ini nga pasilidad para sa mga Santo Papa.
english: It has a special facility for Popes.

text: Diri man anay nagtinir si Pope Francis sang Hunyo 2023 sang nagpaidalom ini sa surgery para ma-repair ang abdominal hernia.
english: Pope Francis also stayed here in June 2023 when he underwent surgery to repair an abdominal hernia.

text: Sa guwa sang ospital sang weekend, madamo nga tumuluo nga Katoliko ang nagtipon sa atubang sang statue ni John Paul II para nga magpangamuyo para sa ikaayong lawas sang Argentine pontiff.
english: Outside the hospital over the weekend, many Catholic faithful gathered in front of a statue of John Paul II to pray for the Argentine pontiff's health.

text: Makatulublag nga isyu ang bronchitis para sa Santo Papa bangud nagsuprer na ini nga daan sang lung-related issues bisan pa sa bata nga edad.
english: Bronchitis is a troubling issue for the Pope because he has already suffered from lung-related issues even at a young age.

text: 2013 sang nangin Santo Papa si Pope Francis nga amo ang labing-una halin sa South America.
english: 2013 when Pope Francis became Pope, the first from South America.

text: Sa edad nga 88, naga-baston na ini kag nagagamit sang wheelchair.
english: At 88, he is on crutches and uses a wheelchair.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, natumba ini kag nakaangkon sang injury sa butkon.
english: Last month, he fell and sustained an arm injury.

text: Nagsuprer man anay si Pope sang diverticulitis, isa ka common condition nga makatuga sang inflammation ukon infection sa colon.
english: Pope also previously suffered from diverticulitis, a common condition that can cause inflammation or infection in the colon.

text: Sang 2021, may surgery man siya agud makakas ang parte sang iya colon.
english: In 2021, he also had surgery to remove part of his colon.

text: Patay ang 18 ka mga tawo sa panibag-o nga stampede sa India nga maangot sa gihapon sa bantog nga Hindu Maha Kumbh festival.
english: At least 18 people have been killed in a new stampede in India still linked to the famous Hindu Maha Kumbh festival.

text: Sa mga napatay, lima ang kabataan, kun sa diin pito ka tuig ang pinakabata.
english: Of the dead, five were children, the youngest being seven years old.

text: 79-anyos naman ang pinakatigulang.
english: The oldest is 79 years old.

text: Kadam-an sa mga tawo sa railway station sa New Delhi kun sa diin natabo ang insidente amo ang mga tumuluo nga magakadto kuntani sa religious festival sa Prayagraj city.
english: Most of the people at the railway station in New Delhi where the incident took place were believers who were about to attend a religious festival in Prayagraj city.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, indi man magnubo sa 30 ka mga tawo ang napatay sang nag-dis-uganay man ang mga deboto sa holy confluence sang Ganges, Yamuna kag mythical Saraswati rivers.
english: Last month, at least 30 people were killed when devotees also clashed at the holy confluence of the Ganges, Yamuna and mythical Saraswati rivers.

text: Anum ka semana ini nga kapistahan, ginahiwat lamang sa kada 12 ka tuig, kag may maragtas na sang mga insidente sang stampede kaangay sang 1954 kun sa diin masobra 400 ang napatay bangud na-dis-ugan kag nalumos.
english: It is a six-week festival, held only every 12 years, and has a history of stampede incidents such as 1954 when more than 400 people died from drowning.

text: Sang 2013, sa amo man nga kahiwatan, 36 man ka mga tawo ang napatay.
english: In 2013, during the same event, 36 people also died.

text: Ini nga kapistahan amo ang pinakadaku nga pagtilipon sa Hindu religious calendar.
english: This festival is the biggest gathering in the Hindu religious calendar.

text: Ginabanta sang mga opisyal nga 500 million na ka mga deboto ang nakabisita kag nakaupod sa kahiwatan halin sang nag-umpisa ini sang Enero.
english: Officials estimate that 500 million devotees have visited and participated in the event since it began in January.

text: Gintalana si Ely Estante bilang bag-o nga executive assistant para sa market kag animal protection sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: Ely Estante has been appointed as the new executive assistant for market and animal protection in Iloilo City.

text: Sa isa ka exclusibo nga interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Estante nga nagapasalamat siya sa oportunidad nga ginhatag sa iya, kag handa siya magbulig sa siyudad paagi sa mga programa nga nagapabakod sang animal welfare kag merkado nga operasyon.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Estante said he is grateful for the opportunity given to him, and he is ready to help the city through programs that strengthen animal welfare and market operations.

text: Ginpanugyan niya nga kinahanglan ang pondo para sa mga sapat, ilabi na sa mga programa nga nagatuyo magpabakuna kag magkapon sang mga sapat agud malikawan ang paglapta sang rabies.
english: He suggested that funding is needed for animals, especially for programs that aim to vaccinate and neuter animals to prevent the spread of rabies.

text: Ginalantaw man niya ang posibilidad nga magamit ang mga sobra nga pagkaon halin sa mga restaurants kag merkado bilang bulig sa mga stray animals.
english: He is also looking at the possibility of using surplus food from restaurants and markets as a relief for stray animals.

text: Ginpakita man ni Estante ang interes nga magpatukod sang opisina nga magatutok gid sa animal protection agud mas epektibo ang pagpatuman sang mga plano.
english: Estante also expressed interest in establishing an office that will focus on animal protection to more effectively implement the plans.

text: Ginlantaw man niya ang kahimtangan sang slaughter house sa siyudad kag ginplano nga usisahon ang sistema para masiguro ang humane treatment sang mga sapat kag kalimpyo sang pasilidad.
english: He also looked at the condition of the slaughter house in the city and planned to inspect the system to ensure humane treatment of animals and cleanliness of the facility.

text: Sa subong, nagapadayon ang iya koordinasyon sa mga ahensya kag stakeholders para sa mas lapad nga implementasyon sang iya mga advocacy.
english: It is currently continuing its coordination with agencies and stakeholders for wider implementation of its advocacies.
