text: Nagsaka na sa ikaduha nga pwesto sa world ranking sa men’s pole vault ang Filipino pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena.
english: Filipino pole vaulter EJ Obiena has climbed to second place in the world ranking in the men's pole vault.

text: Base sa pinakaulihi nga rankings, halin sa pang-numero tres, nagtaas si Obiena sa 1,432 points kag naunahan si Christopher Nielsen sang United States nga yara anay sa ikaduha nga spot sa sulod sang 98 ka semana.
english: Based on the latest rankings, from number three, Obiena rose to 1,432 points ahead of Christopher Nielsen of the United States who was in second place for 98 weeks.

text: Nagapang-tatlo na subong si Nielsen nga may total score nga 1,428.
english: Nielsen is now in third place with a total score of 1,428.

text: Nagapabilin naman nga world number 1 si Armand Duplantis sang Sweden nga may 1,569 points.
english: Armand Duplantis of Sweden remains world number 1 with 1,569 points.

text: “Your very own skinny kid from Tondo, alumni of CKSC and UST, is now WORLD NUMBER TWO,” kabahin sang anunsyo sang 25-anyos nga Pinoy athlete.
english: “Your very own skinny kid from Tondo, alumni of CKSC and UST, is now WORLD NUMBER TWO,” the 25-year-old Pinoy athlete announced.

text: “Thank you to everyone who made this possible, and my deepest gratitude to those who went to war so that I could continue this dream.
english: “Thank you to everyone who made this possible, and my deepest gratitude to those who went to war so that I could continue this dream.

text:
This is not just my accomplishment alone, but everyone’s.”

Nahibaluan nga sulod na si Obiena sa 2024 Paris Olympics matapos na-clear ang 5.82-meter qualifying mark sa Wanda Diamond League’s Bauhaus Galan meet sa Sweden sang nagligad nga Hulyo 3.
english:
This is not just my accomplishment alone, but everyone’s.”

Obiena is now qualified for the 2024 Paris Olympics after clearing the 5.82-meter qualifying mark at the Wanda Diamond League’s Bauhaus Galan meet in Sweden last July 3.

text: Sang Hunyo, matandaan nga si Obiena ang una nga Asian nga nakasulod sa “six-meter club” matapos nagdaog sang bulawan nga medalya sa Bergen Jump Challenge sa Norway — tion nga iya man nga na-reset ang Asian kag national pole vault records.
english: In June, Obiena became the first Asian to enter the “six-meter club” after winning a gold medal at the Bergen Jump Challenge in Norway — a time when she also reset Asian and national pole vault records.

text: Preska pa si Obiena halin sa gold medal finish sa 2023 Asian Athletics Championships sa Bangkok, Thailand sang nagligad lang nga adlaw.
english: Obiena was fresh from a gold medal finish at the 2023 Asian Athletics Championships in Bangkok, Thailand just the other day.

text: Wala ini sang pahuway bangud liwat ini nga makit-an sa Hulyo 21 sa Meeting Herculis EBS– ang Monaco leg sang Diamond League.
english: There is no rest for it as it will be seen again on July 21 at the Meeting Herculis EBS– the Monaco leg of the Diamond League.

text: Yara man sa amo nga kumpetisyon sanday Duplantis kag Nielsen.
english: Duplantis and Nielsen were also in that competition.

text: Sa Agusto, indi man pagpalampason ni Obiena ang pagpasakop kag pagdaog sa World Athletics Championship sa Budapest, Hungary.
english: In August, Obiena will also not miss competing and winning the World Athletics Championship in Budapest, Hungary.

text: Ginlunsar sang Iloilo City Government ang Uswag Atipan Center sa 7th floor sang City Hall subong nga adlaw, Agosto 18, 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Government launched the Uswag Atipan Center on the 7th floor of the City Hall today, August 18, 2025.

text: Ini nga one-stop hub ginpatukod agud mapadasig kag mapalapit pa ang serbisyo sa pumuluyo sang syudad.
english: This one-stop hub was established to speed up and bring services closer to the people of the city.

text: Ginpahayag sang alkalde nga ang ideya sang center naguwa matapos siya nakabisita sa mga barangay kag nakabati sang mga personal nga istorya kag kinahanglanon sang mga residente.
english: The mayor said the idea of ​​the center came after he visited the barangays and heard the personal stories and needs of the residents.

text: Ginpabutyag man nga ang serbisyo nga ihatag sang center kabahin sang handum nga mapadayon ang matuod-tuod nga pagserbisyo sa mga Ilonggo.
english: It was also expressed that the services provided by the center are part of the desire to continue the genuine service to the Ilonggos.

text: Ginsaysay sang center manager nga ang Atipan Center ginlantaw bilang isa ka panimalay para sa mga nagakinahanglan sang bulig, hindi lang ini programa kundi isa ka paagi sa pagpakita sang pag-atipan sang syudad.
english: The center manager explained that the Atipan Center was seen as a home for those in need, not just a program but a way to show the city's care.

text: Ang center nagatanyag sang medical kag dental services, financial kag burial assistance, educational support, job opportunities, kag mga programa para sa kababaihan kag senior citizens.
english: The center offers medical and dental services, financial and burial assistance, educational support, job opportunities, and programs for women and senior citizens.

text: May centralized help desk man para sa mas personal nga bulig.
english: There is also a centralized help desk for more personal assistance.

text: Ginlantaw sang mga opisyal nga ini nga proyekto isa ka milestone sa paghatag sang mas compassionate, transparent, kag inclusive nga serbisyo sa Iloilo City.
english: Officials viewed this project as a milestone in providing more compassionate, transparent, and inclusive services in Iloilo City.

text: Magahimo sang maragtas ang Filipinas subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 21, bangud ini ang labing-una nga pagtapak sang Philippine football team sa pitch sa FIFA World Cup.
english: The Philippines will make history today, July 21, as the Philippine football team steps on the pitch for the first time in the FIFA World Cup.

text: Atubangon sang Filipinas ang Switzerland ‘la una karon sa hapon (oras sa Pilipinas) sa opening match sa Dunedin Stadium sa New Zealand.
english: The Philippines will face Switzerland early this afternoon (Philippine time) in the opening match at the Dunedin Stadium in New Zealand.

text: Pinakanubo ang rank sang Pilipinas sa Group A bangud pang-46 lamang ini sa world rankings, samtang nagapanguna sa grupo ang Norway nga pang-12 sa kalibutan; Switzerland nga pang-20; kag New Zealand nga pang-26.
english: The Philippines ranks lowest in Group A as it is only 46th in the world rankings, while Norway leads the group at 12th in the world; Switzerland 20th; and New Zealand 26th.

text: Tanan nga pungsod ang maka-partsipar sa tatlo ka hampang sa group phase.
english: All countries will be able to participate in three matches in the group phase.

text: Ang duha naman sa pinakamataas nga mga team sa kada grupo amo ang maga-abanse sa Round-of-16 knockout stage.
english: The top two teams in each group will advance to the Round-of-16 knockout stage.

text: Nagapanguna sa Filipinas ang Australian coach nga si Alen Stajcic; samtang team captain naman si Tahnai Annis kag co-captain si Hali Long sa amo nga football tournament.
english: The Philippines is led by Australian coach Alen Stajcic; while Tahnai Annis is team captain and Hali Long is co-captain of the football tournament.

text: Apisar sang prediksyon sang mga eksperto nga indi makalusot ang underdog nga Pilipinas sa group stage, nagpahayag naman ang team nga handa sila sa global stage kag determinado nga pamatud-an nga kuwalipikado sila sa amo nga lebel.
english: Despite the prediction of experts that the underdog Philippines will not make it to the group stage, the team said they are ready for the global stage and determined to prove that they are qualified for that level.

text: Matapos atubangon sang Pilipinas ang Switzerland subong nga adlaw, makasumpong sini ang host nga New Zealand sa Hulyo 25 sa Wellington, kag magabyahe balik sa Auckland para sa match batok sa Norway sa Hulyo 30 agud makumpleto ang group stage.
english: After facing Switzerland today, the Philippines will face host New Zealand on July 25 in Wellington, and travel back to Auckland for the match against Norway on July 30 to complete the group stage.

text: Posible matabo ang “Big One” earthquakes nga magnitude 7.9 tubtub sa magnitude 8.2 bisan sa guwa sang Metro Manila.
english: “Big One” earthquakes of magnitude 7.9 to magnitude 8.2 are possible even outside Metro Manila.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag ni Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) Director Dr. Teresito Bacolcol samtang nga padayon ang preparasyon pananglitan magtay-og na ang “Big One” sa National Capital Region (NCR).
english: This was revealed by Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) Director Dr. Teresito Bacolcol while continuing preparations in case the “Big One” shakes the National Capital Region (NCR).

text: Suno kay Bacolcol, ang Philippine Fault sa Nueva Ecija ang mahimo maka-generate sang magnitude 7.9 nga linog kag posible magtuga sang tsunami waves nga tubtub sa 9-10 metros.
english: According to Bacolcol, the Philippine Fault in Nueva Ecija could generate a magnitude 7.9 earthquake and possibly cause tsunami waves of up to 9-10 meters.

text: Dugang sini, mahimo man makatuga sang magnitude 8.2 nga linog ang 400-kilometros nga Negros Trench.
english: He added that the 400-kilometer Negros Trench could also cause a magnitude 8.2 earthquake.

text: Pahayag sang director, ginatutukan ang pagpanghanda sa Manila bangud amo ini ang economic hub ukon political seat sang gobyerno, apang indi dapat pagkalimtan nga mahimo matabo amo sini nga kalamidad sa iban nga parte sang pungsod.
english: The director said the preparation is focused on Manila because it is the economic hub or political seat of the government, but it should not be forgotten that such a disaster could happen in other parts of the country.

text: “The world doesn’t revolve around West Valley Fault and marami pang bigger ones in other parts of the country, huwag nating kalimutan.
english: “The world doesn’t revolve around West Valley Fault and there are many bigger ones in other parts of the country, let’s not forget.

text: That’s the reason why everybody should prepare… Lahat ng mga Filipinos should prepare kasi hindi lang sa Metro Manila pwede magkaroon ng malaking lindol,” pahayag sini.
english: That's the reason why everybody should prepare... All Filipinos should prepare because not only in Metro Manila can have a big earthquake,” he said.

text: Suno naman kay Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Secretary Renato Solidum Jr., bisan pa nga nakasentro ang preparasyon nila kag sang Phivolcs sa Metro Manila, padayon man nga ginatun-an kag ginahandaan ang iban nga parte sa Pilipinas.
english: Department of Science and Technology (DOST) Secretary Renato Solidum Jr. said that although their preparations and the Phivolcs are focused on Metro Manila, other parts of the Philippines are also being studied and prepared.

text: Lakip sa preparasyon suno sa iya amo ang simultaneous earthquake drills nga ginahimo sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Among the preparations, he said, are simultaneous earthquake drills being conducted nationwide.

text: “Nationally, the biggest impact would be if there is a movement in West Valley Fault.
english: “Nationally, the biggest impact would be if there is a movement in West Valley Fault.

text: The exposure is so high in Metro Manila, that’s why we started looking in Manila in 2002 to 2004.
english: The exposure is so high in Metro Manila, that’s why we started looking in Manila in 2002 to 2004.

text: In reality, we have studied many cities in the Philippines, we have prepared maps.
english: In reality, we have studied many cities in the Philippines, we have prepared maps.

text: In fact, we have different scenarios all over the country,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: In fact, we have different scenarios all over the country,” the secretary said.

text:
Matandaan nga nag-anunsyo ang Japan kag ang Pilipinas nga irepaso ang “Big One” disaster plans sa 2026 agud malantaw kun may himuon nga mga pagbag-o.

Ang ginahandaan nga “Big One” sa Metro Manila ang ginapanan-aw nga magadangat sa magnitude 7.2 ukon mas mabaskog pa nga mangin resulta kun maghulag ang West Valley Fault.
english:
Japan and the Philippines have announced that they will review their “Big One” disaster plans in 2026 to see if any changes will be made.

The prepared “Big One” in Metro Manila is expected to reach magnitude 7.2 or stronger as a result if the West Valley Fault moves.

text: Tungod sa padayon nga pagbaha, nagpasar sang resolusyon ang 12 ka mga kapitan agud ipanawagan ang rehabilitasyon sang Budburan Creek sa Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: Due to the continuous flooding, 12 barangay captains passed a resolution calling for the rehabilitation of Budburan Creek in Lapuz, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Elfren Cenayo sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Punong Barangay Elfren Cenayo of Brgy.

text: Don Esteban Lapuz, ginpahayag niya nga 12 ka barangay kapitan ang nagpasar kag nagpirma sang resolusyon nga ginpadala sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno para tutukan ang problema sa baha nga dala sang Budburan Creek.
english: Don Esteban Lapuz, he said that 12 barangay captains passed and signed a resolution sent to government agencies to focus on the flood problem caused by Budburan Creek.

text: Suno sa iya, bisan madamo sang drainage system, wala sang epektibo nga outlet ukon gwaan ang tubig.
english: He said that although there are many drainage systems, there is no effective outlet for the water.

text: Ginpadal-an na nila sang sulat ang City Government, ang congressman, kag iban pa nga ahensya.
english: They have already sent letters to the City Government, the congressman, and other agencies.

text: Kag suno sa iya, sang una, may ginpatuman nga relocation sang mga residente sa palibot sang creek, apang subong, may mga bodega na nga nagtindog sa lugar, kabangdanan nga mas nagnubo ang kapasidad sang tubig nga mag-agi.
english: He said that in the past, there was a relocation of residents around the creek, but now, there are warehouses that have been built in the area, causing the capacity of the water to pass through.

text: Ginpahayag ni Kapitan Cenayo nga daw “patay na gid ang Budburan Creek” kag ginapangayo nila ang solusyon antes pa maglala ang epekto sang pagbaha sa ilang mga barangay.
english: Kapitan Cenayo said that the Budburan Creek is “dead” and they are asking for a solution before the flooding affects their barangays.

text: Ginhilway sang Hamas ang tatlo ka iban pa nga Israelis nga ila ginbihag halin sang Oktubre 2023.
english: Hamas has released three other Israelis it has held captive since October 2023.

text: Ini amo ang Israeli-American nga si Sagui Dekel-Chen, Israeli-Russian nga si Sasha Trupanov kag Israeli-Argentinian nga si Yair Horn nga ginparada anay sa entablado, ginpahambal sa atubang sang mga tawo, antes gintugyan sa Red Cross.
english: It was Israeli-American Sagui Dekel-Chen, Israeli-Russian Sasha Trupanov and Israeli-Argentinian Yair Horn who were first paraded on stage, made to speak in front of the crowd, before being handed over to the Red Cross.

text: Ginhatagan man sila sang militante nga grupo sang gift bags kag certificate nga amo ang nagamarka nga hilway na sila.
english: The militant group also gave them gift bags and certificates marking their release.

text: Bilang kabaylo, nagpaguwa man ang Israel sang 369 ka mga preso nga Palestinians kag detainees.
english: In return, Israel also released 369 Palestinian prisoners and detainees.

text: Ini na ang pang-anum nga hostage-prisoner swap sang Hamas kag Israel sa idalom sang una nga hugnat sang ceasefire agreement.
english: This is the sixth hostage-prisoner swap between Hamas and Israel under the first phase of the ceasefire agreement.

text: Sa subong, 19 na ka mga Israelis kag lima ka Thai hostages ang nabuy-an sang Hamas kag 73 pa ang nabilin sa Gaza, apang sa sini nga numero, ginapatihan sang Israeli military nga patay na ang katunga.
english: So far, Hamas has released 19 Israelis and five Thai hostages and 73 remain in Gaza, but of this number, the Israeli military believes half are dead.

text: Nag-isyu man sang statement si US President Donald Trump nga dapat Sabado sang udto, na-release na sang Hamas ang tanan nga hostages sa Gaza.
english: US President Donald Trump also issued a statement that Hamas should have released all hostages in Gaza by Saturday afternoon.

text: Pananglitan wala pa suno sa iya, ang Israel na ang maga-desisyon kun maga-violate sila sa ceasefire kag magbalik sa giyera kag suportahan ini sang Estados Unidos.
english: If not, he said, Israel will decide whether to violate the ceasefire and return to war and be supported by the United States.

text: “Israel will now have to decide what they will do about the 12:00 O’CLOCK, TODAY, DEADLINE imposed on the release of ALL HOSTAGES.
english: “Israel will now have to decide what they will do about the 12:00 O’CLOCK, TODAY, DEADLINE imposed on the release of ALL HOSTAGES.

text: The United States will back the decision they make!” kabahin sang statement ni Trump sa iya nga social media platform.
english: The United States will back the decision they made!” part of Trump's statement on his social media platform.

text: Gindala si Pope Francis sa ospital para sa medical examination bangud sa ginasuprer sini nga bronchitis.
english: Pope Francis was taken to the hospital for a medical examination due to bronchitis.

text: Suno sa Vatican, yara sa Agostino Gemelli Polyclinic sa Roma ang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa agud nga magpaidalom man sa kinahanglanon nga diagnostic tests.
english: According to the Vatican, the 88-year-old Pope is at the Agostino Gemelli Polyclinic in Rome to undergo the necessary diagnostic tests.

text: Ginkumpirma man nga ginkanselar anay ang mga meeting sini sa masunod nga tatlo ka adlaw.
english: It also confirmed that its meetings for the next three days have been cancelled.

text: “This morning, at the end of the audiences, Pope Francis will be admitted to the Agostino Gemelli Polyclinic for some necessary diagnostic tests and to continue in a hospital setting treatment for bronchitis that is still ongoing,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “This morning, at the end of the audiences, Pope Francis will be admitted to the Agostino Gemelli Polyclinic for some necessary diagnostic tests and to continue in a hospital setting treatment for bronchitis that is still ongoing,” the statement read.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila ka beses nga na-ospital ang Argentine pontiff halin sang naglinigad nga tinuig lakip na ang pagpaidalom sini sa abdominal surgery sang 2023.
english: The Argentine pontiff has been hospitalized several times since last year, including undergoing abdominal surgery in 2023.

text: Halin sang nagligad nga sinemana, nabudlayan man ini sa paghambal kag pagginhawa bangud sa bronchitis rason nga ginpalihog lamang sa aides ang iya speeches kag addresses.
english: Since last week, he has also had difficulty speaking and breathing due to bronchitis, so he has been asked to give his speeches and addresses to aides.

text: Sang Miyerkules, sa iya nga weekly general audience, nagsiling ini nga indi pa siya makasarang magbasa apang nagyuhom kag nagdugang nga kabay pa nga masarangan na sini sa masunod.
english: On Wednesday, at his weekly general audience, he said he can't read yet but smiled and added that he hopes he can next time.

text: Sang Biyernes sang aga, antes ini na-ospital, may mga schedule pa ini sa Vatican lakip na ang meeting sa prime minister sang Slovakia nga si Robert Fico.
english: On Friday morning, before he was hospitalized, he still had schedules at the Vatican including a meeting with Slovak prime minister Robert Fico.

text: Makatulublag nga isyu ang bronchitis para sa Santo Papa bangud nagsuprer na ini nga daan sang lung-related issues bisan pa sa bata nga edad.
english: Bronchitis is a troubling issue for the Pope because he has already suffered from lung-related issues even at a young age.

text: 2013 sang nangin Santo Papa si Pope Francis nga amo ang labing-una halin sa South America.
english: 2013 when Pope Francis became Pope, the first from South America.

text: Sa edad nga 88, naga-baston na ini kag nagagamit sang wheelchair.
english: At 88, he is on crutches and uses a wheelchair.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, natumba ini kag nakaangkon sang injury sa butkon.
english: Last month, he fell and sustained an arm injury.

text: Nagsuprer man anay si Pope sang diverticulitis, isa ka common condition nga makatuga sang inflammation ukon infection sa colon.
english: Pope also previously suffered from diverticulitis, a common condition that can cause inflammation or infection in the colon.

text: Sang 2021, may surgery man siya agud makakas ang parte sang iya colon.
english: In 2021, he also had surgery to remove part of his colon.

text: Ginlutos kag ginkuhaan sang korona ni World No.1 Carlos Alcaraz ang reigning champion nga si Novak Djokovic sa makahalawat-hawat nga five-set men’s final sa Wimbledon.
english: World No.1 Carlos Alcaraz defeated reigning champion Novak Djokovic in a thrilling five-set men’s final at Wimbledon.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga Wimbledon title sang 20-anyos nga Spanish tennis player sa iya labing-una man nga pagsaka sa finals sang amo nga prestihiyoso nga tennis tournament sa England.
english: This is the first Wimbledon title for the 20-year-old Spanish tennis player in his first appearance in the finals of the prestigious tennis tournament in England.

text: Halos lima ka oras ang ginlawig sang hampang ni Alcaraz antes nalutos ang 36-anyos nga World Number 2 kag Serbian superstar, 1-6 7-6 (8-6) 6-1 3-6 6-4.
english: Alcaraz’s match lasted nearly five hours before defeating the 36-year-old World Number 2 and Serbian superstar, 1-6 7-6 (8-6) 6-1 3-6 6-4.

text: Si Alcaraz ang ikatatlo nga pinakabata nga Wimbledon champion sa Open Era kag ini ang ikaduha nga major title sa iya pangalan matapos nga nadag-an man ang US Open sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Alcaraz is the third-youngest Wimbledon champion in the Open Era and this is the second major title to his name after also winning the US Open last year.

text: Ang iya kadalag-an bilang rising star amo ang nagbalabag sa beterano nga si Djokovic nga maangkon ang iya ika-24 nga Grand Slam title sa iya nga karera kag ikatatlo kuntani nga major title sa 2023 matapos nadag-an ang Australian kag French Open.
english: His victory as a rising star prevented veteran Djokovic from winning his 24th career Grand Slam title and a third major title in 2023 after winning the Australian and French Opens.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang katapusan nga nalutos si Djokovic sa Wimbledon, naga-edad pa lamang si Alcaraz sang 10 ka tuig.
english: It is known that the last time he lost to Djokovic at Wimbledon, Alcaraz was only 10 years old.

text: Ginpaathag ni Annabelle Falle, Chairwoman sang MITSCOOP, ang kabangdanan sang reklamo sang ila mga operators kag PAO angot sa wala pa pag-release sang service contracting.
english: Annabelle Falle, Chairwoman of MITSCOOP, explained the cause of the complaint of their operators and PAO regarding the non-release of service contracting.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Chairwoman Falle, suno sa iya, wala pa gid narelease ang service contracting bangud may problema sa bangko nga ginatudlo sang LTFRB nga magproseso sang pondo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Chairwoman Falle said the service contracting has not been released yet because there is a problem with the bank appointed by the LTFRB to process the funds.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga ang account sang ila bangko gin-garnish na sang Marso 13, bisan pa nga sa Hunyo pa siya opisyal nga nagpungko bilang chairman.
english: He claimed that their bank account had been garnished on March 13, even though it was only in June that he officially took over as chairman.

text: Ang resecution sang kaso ginlatag pa sa Agosto 2024, rason nga subong, 0 na ang balance sang ila Landbank account.
english: The resecution of the case has been postponed to August 2024, which is why their Landbank account has a balance of 0.

text: Gindugang pa ni Falle nga ang DOLE case nga ginatubang sang kooperatiba may kahilabtanan sa cash bond nga ginbilin pa sang una nga chairman.
english: Falle added that the DOLE case faced by the cooperative has to do with the cash bond left by the former chairman.

text: Suno sa iya, ang DOLE nagdesisyon nga pareho tanan ang bayaran nga P10,500, base sa gin-execute nga finality.
english: He said the DOLE decided to pay the same amount of P10,500, based on the executed finality.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga wala nakaatubang ang MITSCOOP sa time sang ikaduha nga chairman, kag tani gin-una pa nila ang DOLE agud masolusyunan ang isyu.
english: He also said that MITSCOOP did not face the time of the second chairman, and they should have given priority to the DOLE to resolve the issue.

text: Nagpaandam si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sa tanan nga world leaders batok sa pahayag ni Russian President Vladimiri Putin nga handa na ang Moscow nga tapuson ang giyera.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned all world leaders against Russian President Vladimir Putin's statement that Moscow is ready to end the war.

text: Ini kasunod sang maragtason nga development sang nagligad nga 24 oras nga naga- involve sang phone call sa tunga nanday US president Donald Trump kag sang Russian president sa katuyuan nga umpisahan ang peace talks.
english: This follows a historic development in the past 24 hours involving a phone call between US President Donald Trump and the Russian president with the aim of starting peace talks.

text: Ginhimo ni Zelenskyy ang comment matapos ang iya pag-istorya kay Polish prime minister Donald Tusk sa telepono.
english: Zelenskyy made the comment after a telephone conversation with Polish prime minister Donald Tusk.

text: Una naman nagpaandam si Zelensky nga nagahanda man ang Russia nga magdeploy sang tropa sa Belarus nga possible gamiton para sa panibag-o nga giyera sa isa ka NATO country.
english: Earlier, Zelensky warned that Russia is also preparing to deploy troops in Belarus that could be used for a new war with a NATO country.

text: Suno sa iya nakuha nga impormasyon halin sa Ukrainian intelligence, si Putin ang nagaporma sang 10 tubtob 15 divisions nga ginabug-usan sang kapin 100,000 ka tropa nga ipadala sa Belarus para sa military exercises.
english: According to information he has obtained from Ukrainian intelligence, Putin is forming 10 to 15 divisions consisting of more than 100,000 troops to be sent to Belarus for military exercises.

text: Gintawgan ni United States President Donald Trump ang mga presidente sang Russia kag Ukraine agud istoryahan ang gyera sang duha ka pungsod sa Europa.
english: United States President Donald Trump called the presidents of Russia and Ukraine to discuss the war between the two countries in Europe.

text: Suno kay Trump, malawig kag produktibo ang iya pag-istorya kay Russian leader Vladimir Putin on Wednesday kag nagpasugot ini nga umpisahan ang negosasyon agud matapos ang giera sini batok sa Ukraine.
english: Trump said he had a long and productive talk with Russian leader Vladimir Putin on Wednesday and he agreed to start negotiations to end its war against Ukraine.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov ang phone call nga naglawig sang isa ka oras kag tunga.
english: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed the phone call lasted an hour and a half.

text: Pahayag sini, suportado ni Putin ang ideya ni Trump nga nag-abot na ang tion agud magbuligay sila.
english: He said Putin supports Trump's idea that the time has come for them to work together.

text: Gin-imbitar man ni Putin ang American president nga magbisita sa Moscow.
english: Putin also invited the American president to visit Moscow.

text: Sunod man nga gin-istorya ni Trump si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy kag ginpahayag nga gusto naman sini sang kalinong.
english: Trump also spoke to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and said he wanted peace.

text: Tensyonado ang relasyon sang Kyiv kag Moscow halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sang Pebrero 2022.
english: Relations between Kyiv and Moscow have been tense since the war began in February 2022.

text: Ginapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon kaangot sa aksidente sa bus sa Guatemala nga nagbilin sang 55 ka mga patay.
english: Investigations are ongoing into the bus accident in Guatemala that left 55 dead.

text: 70 ang kabug-usan nga sakay sa salakyan nga suno sa local media ginalakipan sang mga estudyante kag commuters nga pakadto sa capital city para sa ila nga medical appointments.
english: 70 people were on board the vehicle, which according to local media included students and commuters heading to the capital city for their medical appointments.

text: Nahulog ang bus sa pil-as sang Lunes sang aga kag binudlayan pa ang rescuers nga makuha ang mga lawas sang mga biktima sa creek.
english: The bus fell into a cliff on Monday morning and rescuers were still struggling to retrieve the bodies of the victims from the creek.

text: Nagdeklarar naman si Guatemalan President Bernardo Arévalo de Leon sang tatlo ka adlaw nga national mourning para dumdumon ang mga biktima kag paghatag man sang simpatiya sa ila nga mga pamilya.
english: Guatemalan President Bernardo Arévalo de Leon declared three days of national mourning to remember the victims and to express his condolences to their families.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang normal nga ruta sang bus amo ang San Cristóbal Acasaguastlán kag Guatemala City.
english: It is known that the normal bus route is San Cristóbal Acasaguastlán and Guatemala City.

english: The 24-year-old driver of the bus was confirmed among the dead.

text: Gina-usisa sang otoridad kun nadulaan ini sang control bangud sa brake failure.
english: Authorities are investigating whether he lost control due to brake failure.

text: I-attempt liwat ni Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog nga mag-deliver sang privilege speech sa regular session sang Iloilo City Council sa masunod nga semana.
english: Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog will again attempt to deliver a privilege speech in the regular session of the Iloilo City Council next week.

text: Ini matapos nga wala ini gintugutan sang mayorya sang konseho nga maghatag sang iya speech sang nagligad nga Mierkules, Agusto 13.
english: This was after the majority of the council did not allow him to deliver his speech last Wednesday, August 13.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mabilog, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang limitasyon ang isa ka konsehal may kaangtanan sa paghatag sang privilege speech angot sa isyu sa Real Property Tax.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mabilog said there is no limit for a councilor to give a privilege speech on the issue of Real Property Tax.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, indi siya mag-untat sa iya kawsa bangud kawsa man ini sang mga pumuluyo nga nagaantos sang epekto sang tuman ka mahal nga buwis sa syudad.
english: Mabilog said he will not give up on his cause because it is also the cause of the people who are suffering from the effects of the high taxes in the city.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ikatatlo nga tion nga napaslawan si Mabilog nga makuha ang suporta sang iya kaupdanan sa konseho.
english: This is the third time that Mabilog has failed to win the support of his colleagues in the council.

text: Sang Hulyo 16, nag-propose ini sang ordinansa nga nagaduso sang 80% reduction sa real property tax (RPT) apang wala ini ginsuportahan sang iban nga konsehal.
english: On July 16, he proposed an ordinance proposing an 80% reduction in real property tax (RPT) but other councilors did not support it.

text: Sang Hulyo 31, wala man sang bisan isa ka konsehal nga nagsegunda sa gin-file niya liwat nga ordinansa.
english: On July 31, not a single councilor seconded the ordinance he refiled.

text: Gin-akusahan naman ni Mabilog nga bulag kag bungol sa pagbakho sang mga taxpayers ang iya kaupdanan nga konsehal sa diin 11 gid sa ila ang kaalyado ni Mayor Raisa Treñas.
english: Mabilog accused his fellow councilors, 11 of whom are allies of Mayor Raisa Treñas, of being blind and deaf to the cries of taxpayers.

text: Gina-evaluate sang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) ang mga proyekto nga ila ginapatuman sa Western Visayas agud masiguro nga naga-angay ini sa plano kag specifications, ilabi na ang may kaangtanan sa flood control.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) is evaluating the projects it is implementing in Western Visayas to ensure that they are in line with the plan and specifications, especially those related to flood control.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Jose Al Fruto, CESO IV, Assistant Regional Director sang DPWH 6, ginpahayag niya nga ginasuportahan niya ang tanan nga inisyatibo nga may kahilabtanan sa proyekto bangud concern ini sang tanan.
english: Jose Al Fruto, CESO IV, Assistant Regional Director of DPWH 6, said he supports all initiatives related to the project because it is a concern of everyone.

text: Suno sa iya, may regular nga proseso ang DPWH sa pagmonitor kag pagpatuman sang proyekto, kag ginapaninguhaan nga matapos ini sa husto nga oras kag kalidad bisan pa may mga hagna.
english: He said the DPWH has a regular process to monitor and implement the project, and is trying to complete it on time and quality despite the bills.

text: Ginpabutyag pa ni Fruto nga importante nga ma-evaluate sang insakto ang proyekto base sa plano agud ma-address ang mga isyu, ilabi na sa mga flood control projects nga ginatutukan sang ahensiya.
english: Fruto said it is important to evaluate the project properly based on the plan to address the issues, especially in the flood control projects that the agency is focusing on.

text: Dismayado ang Pinoy fans matapos nga wala nakaupod si Kai Sotto sa una nga hampang sang Orlando Magic sa National Basketball Association (NBA) Summer League sa Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.
english: Filipino fans are disappointed after Kai Sotto missed the first game of the Orlando Magic in the National Basketball Association (NBA) Summer League in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.

text: Na-rehistro si Sotto bilang DNP (Did Not Play – Coach’s Decision) sa hampang kun sa diin nalutos man ang Magic sa Detroit Pistons, 89-78.
english: Sotto was registered as a DNP (Did Not Play – Coach’s Decision) in the game where the Magic also lost to the Detroit Pistons, 89-78.

text: Nanguna sa Pistons si James Wiseman, ang ikaduha nga overall pick sa 2020 NBA Draft, nga may 16 points, 11 rebounds, kag two blocks; kag yara man si Jalen Durent, ang 13th overall pick sa draft sang nagligad nga tuig nga may 17 points kag eight rebounds.
english: The Pistons were led by James Wiseman, the second overall pick in the 2020 NBA Draft, with 16 points, 11 rebounds, and two blocks; and there’s also Jalen Durent, the 13th overall pick in last year’s draft with 17 points and eight rebounds.

text: Nanguna naman sa Magic si Kevon Harris nga may 21 points kag si Anthony Black nga may 17 points, five rebounds, kag five assists.
english: The Magic were led by Kevon Harris with 21 points and Anthony Black with 17 points, five rebounds, and five assists.

text: Ang sunod nga tyansa ni Sotto amo ang hampang sang Magic batok sa Indiana Pacers kun sa diin yara ang iya former Adelaide 36ers teammate nga si Mojave King.
english: Sotto's next chance is the Magic's game against the Indiana Pacers where his former Adelaide 36ers teammate Mojave King is present.

text: Balantayan ang hampang Lunes sang gab-i sa Las Vegas samtang 8:30 sa Martes sang aga oras diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Watch the game Monday night in Las Vegas while 8:30 am Tuesday morning here in the Philippines.

text: Pagkatapos atubang sa Pacers, may tatlo pa ka hampang ang Magic sa Summer League lakip na ang game batok sa New York Knicks sa July 13, pagasundan sang Portland Trail Blazers sa July 14, kag may isa pa atubangon nga team sa wala pa natumod nga petsa.
english: After facing the Pacers, the Magic have three more Summer League games including a game against the New York Knicks on July 13, followed by the Portland Trail Blazers on July 14, and another team at an unspecified date.

text: Indi pa masigurado kun personal nga masaksihan sang Filipino basketball fans ang hampang ni Milwaukee Bucks forward Giannis Antetokounmpo sa FIBA World Cup sa Manila sa Agusto.
english: It is not yet certain whether Filipino basketball fans will personally witness the game of Milwaukee Bucks forward Giannis Antetokounmpo at the FIBA ​​World Cup in Manila in August.

text: Duha-duha ang kondisyon sang two-time NBA Most Valuable Player nga makahampang para sa pungsod Greece bangud naga-recover pa lamang ini matapos nga ginpaidalom sa cleanup procedure ang iya wala nga tuhod sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The two-time NBA Most Valuable Player is in doubt to play for Greece as he is still recovering after undergoing a cleanup procedure on his left knee last week.

text: Matandaan nga nagsuprer si Antetokounmpo sang back injury sa first-round playoff series batok sa Miami Heat, apang indi maathag kun kaangot ang amo nga injury sa iya latest nga pagpa-opera.
english: Antetokounmpo suffered a back injury in the first-round playoff series against the Miami Heat, but it is unclear whether the injury was related to his latest surgery.

text: Patigayunon ang World Cup sa Pilipinas, Japan, kag Indonesia umpisa sa Agusto 25 tubtub sa Septyembre 10.
english: The World Cup will be held in the Philippines, Japan, and Indonesia from August 25 to September 10.

text: Natuon ang Greece sa Group C kaupod sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika, New Zealand, kag Jordan.
english: Greece is in Group C along with the United States of America, New Zealand, and Jordan.

text: Daku nga kadulaan sa Greece pananglitan indi makasulod sa tournament ang nasambit nga basketball star nga top scorer anay sa EuroBasket tournament sang nagligad nga tuig nga may average nga 29.3 points apisar pa nga nalutos ang iya nga team batok sa Czech Republic sa round-of-16.
english: It will be a big loss for Greece if the basketball star, who was the top scorer in last year's EuroBasket tournament with an average of 29.3 points, does not qualify for the tournament despite his team's defeat against the Czech Republic in the round-of-16.

text: Kabahin man ang 28-anyos nga ginbansagan Greek Freak sa team sa Greece sang 2019 World Cup apang wala ini nakalusot sa group stage.
english: The 28-year-old, nicknamed the Greek Freak, was also part of the team in Greece at the 2019 World Cup but failed to qualify for the group stage.

text: Nagpasaka sang lawsuit sa federal court ang malapit 30 ka mga religious groups sa America batok sa Trump administration bangud sa tikang sang gobyerno nga nagahatag sang pehanugot sa mga immigration agents nga magpang-aresto bisan sa sulod sang mga simbahan.
english: Nearly 30 religious groups in the United States have filed a lawsuit in federal court against the Trump administration over the government's move to allow immigration agents to make arrests even inside churches.

text: Ang lawsuit nga gin-file sa U.S. District Court sa Washington, ang nagapanindugan nga ang bag-o nga policy ang nagapalapnag sang kahadlok sa mga tawo nga nagaresulta sa pagnubo sang mga sumilimba sa mga worship services kag sa iban nga mga programa sa simbahan.
english: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Washington, argues that the new policy is spreading fear among people resulting in a decrease in worshipers at worship services and other church programs.

text: Nagresulta ini, base sa nasaad sa suit, sa pagdingot sa religious freedom sang mga grupo.
english: This resulted, according to the suit, in restricting the religious freedom of the groups.

text: Ang bag-o nga lawsuit nagapabaskog sang mga argumento nga ginhimo sa pareho man nga lawsuit nga gin-file sang Enero 27 sang lima ka ka mga congregations kag ang ulihi gin-updan sang Cooperative Baptist Fellowship kag Sikh temple.
english: The new lawsuit reinforces arguments made in a similar lawsuit filed Jan. 27 by five congregations and the latter joined by the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship and Sikh temple.

text: Ini ang pending subong sa U.S. District Court sa Maryland.
english: It is currently pending in the U.S. District Court in Maryland.

text: Wala pa sang sabat ang Trump administration sa bag-o nga lawsuit, nga nagpangalan sa Department of Homeland Security kag ang immigration enforcement agencies bilang defendants.
english: The Trump administration has yet to respond to the new lawsuit, which named the Department of Homeland Security and the immigration enforcement agencies as defendants.

text: Nagpaandam si Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno nga magalala lamang ukon magasaka sang 1.4 percentage points ang inflation sa pungsod pananglitan aprubahan ang saka nga P150 sa mimimum wage sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno warned that inflation in the country will only worsen or rise by 1.4 percentage points if the P150 increase in the minimum wage nationwide is approved.

text: Ang pagpaathag ni Diokno kag paandam sa posible resulta sini sa inflation ang kasunod sang hagna nga gin-aprubahan “in principle” sa Senado sang nagligad nga bulan kun sa diin may P150 wage hike para sa mga naga-trabaho sa private sector sa Pilipinas.
english: Diokno's explanation and warning of its possible consequences on inflation follows a bill that was approved “in principle” in the Senate last month where there is a P150 wage hike for those working in the private sector in the Philippines.

text: Ang estimate ni Diokno nga 1.4 percentage points nga isaka sa inflation ang nakasandig man sa estimate sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA).
english: Diokno's estimate of a 1.4 percentage points increase in inflation is also based on the estimate of the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA).

text: Ginpamangkot man sini kun sin-o ang magabenepisyo sa sini, kag kun sin-o ang magasuprer.
english: He also asked who would benefit from it, and who would suffer.

text: Pahayag pa ni Diokno, kun yara sa 5.5% ang inflation sa 2023, ang ginaduso nga wage hike ang mahimo makapatimbuok sa sini sa 6.9%.
english: Diokno said that if inflation is at 5.5% in 2023, the proposed wage hike could increase it to 6.9%.

text: Una na nga ginpaathag ni Senate President Juan Miguel Zubiri nga ginduso ang amo nga hagna bangud ang wage increases nga gina-aprubahan sang Regional Wage Board ang tuman ka nubo kag indi man makabayad sa inubrahan sang mga mamumugon.
english: Earlier, Senate President Juan Miguel Zubiri explained that the bill was proposed because the wage increases approved by the Regional Wage Board are too low and cannot pay for the work of the workers.

text: Nagrekomendar na ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang panibag-o nga suggested retail price (SRP) para sa bombay subong nga nakit-an ang liwat nga pagsaka sa presyo sini sa mga merkado.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has recommended a new suggested retail price (SRP) for bombay now that it has seen a resurgence in its price in the markets.

text: Nagsugtanay ang farmers groups kag iban pa nga agriculture stakeholders nga P150 per kilo ang SRP sa red onions kag P140 kada kilo naman para sa white onions.
english: The farmers groups and other agriculture stakeholders agreed on an SRP of P150 per kilo for red onions and P140 per kilo for white onions.

text: Suno kay DA Spokesperson Kristine Evangelista, kinahanglan pa nga maaprubahan ni Senior Agriculture Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban ang amo nga proposal.
english: According to DA Spokesperson Kristine Evangelista, the proposal still needs to be approved by Senior Agriculture Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban.

text: Gin-athag man ni Evangelista nga nagpasugot na diri ang stakeholders nga amo ang nagtiglawas sa mga traders kag amo ini ang mangin guide sa pagguwa sang produkto halin sa cold storage.
english: Evangelista also explained that the stakeholders who represent the traders have already agreed and this will guide the release of products from cold storage.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginakahangaw-an nga magtimbuok liwat ang presyo sini ilabi na bangud ginpahayag nga may mga merkado na kun sa diin naga-P200 kada kilo ang baligyaanay nga doble sa presyo kada kilo sang nagligad nga Marso.
english: It is known that there are concerns that the price of rice will rise again especially since there are already markets where it is sold at P200 per kilo which is double the price per kilo last March.

text: Magapabilin ang Filipino-American guard nga si Jordan Clarkson sa iya NBA team nga Utah Jazz tubtub sa 2025-2026 season.
english: Filipino-American guard Jordan Clarkson will remain with his NBA team, the Utah Jazz, until the 2025-2026 season.

text: Suno sa reports, gina-finalize subong ang tatlo ka tuig kag balor $55 million ukon masobra P3-billion nga contract extension kay Clarkson.
english: According to reports, a three-year, $55 million or more than P3-billion contract extension for Clarkson is being finalized.

text: Naga-average ang 31-anyos nga basketball star sang career-high nga 20.8 points kag 4.4 assists nga may 4.0 rebounds sa 61 ka mga hampang sang nagligad nga season.
english: The 31-year-old basketball star averaged a career-high 20.8 points and 4.4 assists with 4.0 rebounds in 61 games last season.

text: Siya ang nangin recipient sang Sixth Man of the Year award sang NBA sang 2020-2021 nga nakaamot sang 15.9 points, 3.4 rebounds, kag 2.7 assists sa 661 ka career games sa Los Angeles Lakers, Cleveland Cavaliers, kag sa Utah Jazz.
english: He was the recipient of the NBA’s Sixth Man of the Year award in 2020-2021 contributing 15.9 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 2.7 assists in 661 career games with the Los Angeles Lakers, Cleveland Cavaliers, and the Utah Jazz.

text: Hugot nga ginpakamalaot ni Pope Francis ang immigration crackdown ni US President Donald Trump.
english: Pope Francis has strongly condemned US President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown.

text: Sa isa ka tumalagsahon nga open letter sa Catholic Bishops sang America, ginsiling ni Pope Francis nga ang pag-criminalize sa mga migrants kag ang mga tikang nga nagagamit sang pwersa batok sa ila ang magatakop sa kalainan.
english: In an extraordinary open letter to America’s Catholic Bishops, Pope Francis said that the criminalization of migrants and measures that use force against them will put an end to evil.

text: Suno sa Pope nga una na gintawag nga “disgrace” ang plano ni Trump nga i- deport ang minilyon nga mga migrants, dako nga sala nga i-assume nga ang tanan nga undocumented immigrants ang mga kriminal.
english: According to the Pope, who has previously called Trump's plan to deport millions of migrants a "disgrace," it is a big mistake to assume that all undocumented immigrants are criminals.

text: Humalin sang 2013, nangin kritikal ang santo papa sa immigration policies ni Trump.
english: Since 2013, the pope has been critical of Trump's immigration policies.

text: Sang 2016, sa una nga White House campaign ni Trump, ginsiling sang Pope nga indi Kristiyano nga buluhaton ang pagtrato ni Trump sa isyu sang immigration.
english: In 2016, during Trump’s first White House campaign, the Pope said that Trump’s treatment of the immigration issue was not a Christian task.

text: Gintawag naman sini nga “major crisis” para sa US ang polisa ni Trump.
english: He called Trump's policy a "major crisis" for the US.

text: Sa amo nga sulat, apisar indi direkta, apang kaangay nga nagapatuhoy man ini sa pagdepensa ni Vice President JD Vance sa deportasyon.
english: In the letter, although not directly, it seems to refer to Vice President JD Vance's defense of deportation.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni Vance nga isa man ka Katoliko, nga ang konsepto sang simbahan nga “ordo amoris”, ukon “order of love”, nagasuhestiyon nga ang mga Katoliko ang dapat maghatag prayoridad sa mga non-immigrants.
english: Vance, who is also a Catholic, said the church's concept of “ordo amoris”, or “order of love”, suggests that Catholics should give priority to non-immigrants.

text: Suno sa santo papa, ang matuod nga pagpalangga ang wala nagapili sang bisan sin-o.
english: According to the pope, true love does not choose anyone.

text: Isa ka vehicular accident ang nagluntad sa intersection sang Solis-Iznart Street, City Proper, Iloilo City, pasado alas 11 sang aga, Agosto 14, 2025.
english: A vehicular accident occurred at the intersection of Solis-Iznart Street, City Proper, Iloilo City, around 11 am, August 14, 2025.

text: Duwa ka salakyan ang na-involve: isa ka private van nga gina-drive ni alias Jona, 70 anyos, padulong sa Mulley Loney Street, kag isa ka modernized bus nga gina-drive ni alias Rafa, 49 anyos, padulong sa Bonifacio Drive.
english: Two vehicles were involved: a private van driven by alias Jona, 70, heading towards Mulley Loney Street, and a modernized bus driven by alias Rafa, 49, heading towards Bonifacio Drive.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Virgil Caporal sang Traffic Investigation and Enforcement Unit ICPS 1, nagbungguanay ang duha sa tunga sang intersection tungod pareho nag-ulhot ang duwa ka salakyan sa tagsa ka lane nga nagresulta sa pagbunggu-anay kag pagkagupi sang front bumper sang private van.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Virgil Caporal of Traffic Investigation and Enforcement Unit ICPS 1 said the two vehicles collided in the middle of the intersection.

text: Wala man sang nasamaran sa aksidente kag padayon ginapahanumduman ang mga motorista nga maghalong sa pagbiyahe kag mag-obserbar sang mga traffic signs agud malikawan ang pareho nga aksidente.
english: No one was injured in the accident and motorists are reminded to be careful while traveling and observe traffic signs to avoid similar accidents.

text: Bombo Bryan Gonzales
english: Bombo Bryan Gonzales

text: Gin-agyan sang convoy ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: The convoy of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang Aganan Flyover sa Pavia, Iloilo agud i-check ang kontrobersyal nga proyekto nga gin-umpisahan sang 2019 apang tubtub subong wala pa gihapon matapos.
english: the Aganan Flyover in Pavia, Iloilo to check the controversial project that was started in 2019 but has not yet been completed.

text: Kadungan ini sang iya pagbisita sa syudad kahapon, Agusto 13, agud pangunahan ang inagurasyon sa rehabilitated Iloilo Fish Port complex.
english: This coincides with his visit to the city yesterday, August 13, to lead the inauguration of the rehabilitated Iloilo Fish Port complex.

text: Gin-cite sang Presidential Communications Office (PCO) ang report nga sala ang original nga disenyo kag pag-check sa kadalumon sang pundasyon sang flyover gani nga kinahanglan naman nga kay-uhon sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) gamit ang jet grouting.
english: The Presidential Communications Office (PCO) cited the report that the original design and checking of the foundation depth of the flyover was wrong and that the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) had to repair it using jet grouting.

text: “Dumaan ang convoy ni Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: “The convoy of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.

text: sa Aganan Flyover sa Pavia, Iloilo upang personal na suriin ang proyektong sinimulan noong 2019 ngunit hanggang ngayon ay hindi pa tapos.
english: at the Aganan Flyover in Pavia, Iloilo to personally inspect the project that began in 2019 but is still not completed.

text: Ayon sa mga ulat, mali ang orihinal na disenyo at pagsusuri sa lalim ng pundasyon kaya’t kailangang ayusin gamit ang jet grouting,” suno sa PCO.
english: According to reports, the original design and inspection of the foundation depth was wrong so it needs to be repaired using jet grouting,” the PCO said.

text: Dugang sang opisina, ang budget para diri ang kuhaon naman sa pondo nga para kuntani sa pagtapos sa flyover, apang kulang gihapon para dalayon nga matapos na ang project.
english: The office added that the budget for this will be taken from the fund that was supposed to be used for the completion of the flyover, but it is still not enough to complete the project immediately.

text: Ginpangalanan man sang opisina ang kontraktor ngaInternational Builders Corporation nga amo man ang kontraktor sa Ungka Flyover sa Iloilo City nga kontrobersyal man bangud sa structural issues.
english: The office also named the contractor International Builders Corporation which is also the contractor of the Ungka Flyover in Iloilo City which is also controversial due to structural issues.

text: “Ang pondo para rito ay kukunin mula sa budget na nakalaan sana para sa pagtatapos ng flyover, at kulang pa rin upang tuluyang matapos ang proyekto.
english: “The funds for this will be taken from the budget allocated for the completion of the flyover, and there is still not enough money to complete the project.

text: Ang contractor ng naturang proyekto ay IBC International Builders Corporation, na siya ring gumawa ng pansamantalang isinara na Ungka Flyover sa Iloilo City dahil sa structural issues.
english: The contractor of the project is IBC International Builders Corporation, which also built the temporarily closed Ungka Flyover in Iloilo City due to structural issues.

text: Sa ngayon, nananatiling malaking perwisyo sa trapiko ang matagal nang pagkaantala ng konstruksyon,” suno pa sa opisina.
english: At present, the long delay in construction remains a major traffic hazard,” the office said.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagabalor ang Aganan Flyover sang P802-million kag ginpauntat ang construction sang Disyembre 2022 bangud sa safety kag structural concerns kasunod sang inconsistent soil test results nga rason sang pagguwa sang mga pagpangduha-duha sa pundasyon sang proyekto.
english: The Aganan Flyover is worth P802-million and construction was halted in December 2022 due to safety and structural concerns following inconsistent soil test results that raised doubts about the foundation of the project.

text: May yara na sang third-party consultant nga nagapatigayon sang detalyado nga geotechnical study sa amo nga kontrobersyal nga flyover.#
english: A third-party consultant is already conducting a detailed geotechnical study on the controversial flyover.

text: Ginsita sang Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) ang pila ka mga kwestyonable nga flood control projects sa budget hearing sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kahapon, October 27.
english: The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) cited several questionable flood control projects during the budget hearing of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) yesterday, October 27.

text: Kaangay na lang sa proyekto sa Camiling River sa Tarlac, nga nagalala ang pagbaha bangud sa nasambit nga proyekto.
english: Similar to the Camiling River project in Tarlac, which is worsening flooding due to the said project.

text: Suno sa DENR ginabaha man ang pila ka mga lugar sa bahin sang New Bataan, Davao De Oro.
english: According to the DENR, some areas in New Bataan, Davao De Oro are also flooded.

text: Sa Malolos naman, isa ka dike ang gintukod sa tunga sang baybayon nga wala man sang pulos suno sa DENR.
english: In Malolos, a dike was built in the middle of the beach which is also useless, according to the DENR.

text: Nagpaandam si North Korean leader Kim Jong Un nga magabalos ini kag pabaskugon pa ang ila nga nuclear forces kasunod sang trilateral military cooperation nga ginhimo sang United States, Japan kag South Korea.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has warned that he will retaliate and strengthen his nuclear forces following the trilateral military cooperation between the United States, Japan and South Korea.

text: Suno kay Kim, nagpasaka sang tension sa rehiyon kag nangin pamahog sa ila seguridad ang pagpadala sang US sang nuclear strategic assets amo man ang war exercises kag military cooperation sini kaupod ang Tokyo kag Seoul.
english: Kim said the US's deployment of nuclear strategic assets as well as its war exercises and military cooperation with Tokyo and Seoul have raised tensions in the region and threatened their security.

text: Dugang sini, nangin mas agresibo pa ang war exercises sang tatlo ka mga nasyon ipaanggid sa ila ginhimo sang gin-kanselar anay ang diplomacy schedules bangud sa gamo sa pulitika.
english: He added that the war exercises of the three countries have become more aggressive compared to what they did when the diplomatic schedules were canceled due to political unrest.

text: Sa giyera naman sang Russia kag Ukraine, nagpahayag si Kim nga padayon ang ila pagsuporta sa kawsa sang Moscow nga depensahan ang ila teritoryo, seguridad, kag territorial integrity.
english: On the Russia-Ukraine war, Kim said he continues to support Moscow's cause to defend its territory, security, and territorial integrity.

text: Sang Enero, matandaan nga nagpahayag ang South Koreans nga nagapreparar sila sa pagpadala sang dugang nga tropa sa Russia magluwas pa sa 11,000 nga nauna na nila gin-deploy agud magbulig sa giyera batok sa Kyiv.
english: In January, the South Koreans said they were preparing to send more troops to Russia in addition to the 11,000 they had previously deployed to help in the war against Kyiv.

text: ILOILO CITY- Todo pagpanghanda na ang football team sang Iloilo-Secondary level nga magatiglawas sang Region 6 sa Palarong Pambansa 2023.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Iloilo-Secondary level football team that will represent Region 6 in the Palarong Pambansa 2023 is fully prepared.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Japheth Buenalatrona, coach sang Iloilo football team nga gina-represent sang mga players halin sa Barotac Nuevo National Comprehensive High School, iya ginpahayag nga naga-focus subong sa physical development ang mga players bangud ginalauman nga mas dalagko ang mga players nga ila makaatubang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Japheth Buenalatrona, coach of the Iloilo football team represented by players from Barotac Nuevo National Comprehensive High School, said the players are now focusing on physical development because they are expected to face bigger players.

text: Suno kay Buenalatrona,sa taktikal nga aspeto, gina-polish na nila ang mga estratehiya nga ila himuon sa field.
english: According to Buenalatrona, in the tactical aspect, they are already polishing the strategies they will do in the field.

text: Matandaan nga naghampang anay ang Iloilo football team sa Cluster 3 Pre-Palarong Pambansa Qualifying Meet sa Cebu City sang nagligad nga Hunyo 14 tubtob 17, 2023 kun sa diin sila ang nagkampeon gani sila ang maga-advance sa Palarong Pambansa 2023 sa Marikina City sa Hulyo 29 tubtob Agusto 5, 2023.
english: The Iloilo football team played in the Cluster 3 Pre-Palarong Pambansa Qualifying Meet in Cebu City last June 14 to 17, 2023 where they won the championship and will advance to the Palarong Pambansa 2023 in Marikina City from July 29 to August 25, 2023.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Region 6 man ang defending champion sa Palarong Pambansa nga ulihi nga ginpatigayon sang 2019 apang napaiway sang tatlo ka tuig bangud sa pandemya.
english: Region 6 is also the defending champion in the Palarong Pambansa which was last held in 2019 but was postponed for three years due to the pandemic.

text: Nagdungka na sa syudad sang Iloilo ang pinaka-ulihi nga guided missile frigate sang Philippine Navy, ang BRP Miguel Malvar (FFG-06), bilang kabahin sang Operational Readiness and Capability Test (ORACT) antes ini isalang sa full operational deployment.
english: The latest guided missile frigate of the Philippine Navy, the BRP Miguel Malvar (FFG-06), has docked in Iloilo City as part of the Operational Readiness and Capability Test (ORACT) before it is put into full operational deployment.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Commodore Joselito De Guzman, Commander sang Naval Forces Central, iya ginpahayag nga katuyuan Operational Readiness and Capability Test ang masiguro nga ang barko kag ang crew may kapasidad sa pag-patrol kag pagprotekta sa kadagatan nga akop sang Pilipinas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Commodore Joselito De Guzman, Commander of the Naval Forces Central, said the purpose of the Operational Readiness and Capability Test is to ensure that the ship and its crew have the capacity to patrol and protect Philippine waters.

text: Ginpangunahan ni De Guzman kag ni Captain Paul Hechanova ang commanding officer sang BRP Miguel Malvar kag tumandok sang Passi City, Iloilo.
english: De Guzman and Captain Paul Hechanova led the commanding officer of BRP Miguel Malvar and a native of Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay De Guzman, ang masunod nga destination pagkatapos sang Iloilo amo ang Cebu.
english: According to De Guzman, the next destination after Iloilo is Cebu.

text: Pahayag pa sang opisyal nga kun madinalag-on ang mga patigayunon nga test, possible nga magpadayon pa ini sa Northern Mindanao para sa dugang nga deployment exercises.
english: The official said that if the tests are successful, it is possible to continue to Northern Mindanao for further deployment exercises.

text: Ang BRP Miguel Malvar isa ka simbolo sang padayon nga modernisasyon sang Philippine Navy kag sang determinasyon sang Pilipinas nga protektahan ang teritoryo sini sa kadagatan.
english: The BRP Miguel Malvar is a symbol of the Philippine Navy’s continued modernization and the Philippines’ determination to protect its maritime territory.

text: Ginklaro ni Phivolcs volcanologist Dr. Paul Alanis nga wala sang connection ang magkasunod nga linog sa natabo sa natuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang pungsod, sa magkasunod man nga paglupok sang bulkan Taal kag Kanlaon.
english: Phivolcs volcanologist Dr. Paul Alanis said the consecutive earthquakes have no connection to what happened in different parts of the country, including the consecutive eruptions of Taal and Kanlaon volcanoes.

text: Ini ang sa pihak sang halos pagkapareho sang duha ka mga natural calamity.
english: This is despite the almost similarity of the two natural calamities.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dr. Alanis nga wala sang koneksyon ang mga mabaskog nga linog sa sunod-sunod nga pag-alburuto sang bulkan Kanlaon kag Taal.
english: He said Dr. Alanis said the strong earthquakes were not connected to the successive eruptions of Kanlaon and Taal volcanoes.

text: Kun i-base suno sa iya sa subong nga sitwasyon sang duha, lunsay yara sa idalom sang alert level ang duha ka mga bulkan.
english: Based on the current situation of the two, he said, both volcanoes are below the alert level.

text: Gin-relieve na sa iya pwesto si Engr.
english: Engr. has been relieved of his post.

text: Roy Pacanan bilang District Engineer sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO), ini ginkumpirma sa ginpatigayon nga 5th regular session sang Iloilo City Council kaina sang aga.
english: Roy Pacanan as District Engineer of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO), this was confirmed in the 5th regular session of the Iloilo City Council this morning.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapatigayon sang imbestigasyon ang Iloilo City Council sa mga flood control projects kag wala makatambong si Pacanan sa quad committee hearing sang lunes.
english: The Iloilo City Council is conducting an investigation into flood control projects and Pacanan did not attend the quad committee hearing on Monday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Romel Duron, Asst.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Councilor Romel Duron, Asst.

text: Majority Floor Leader, iya ginpahayag nga pila man ini ka beses nga wala nagsabat si Pacanan sa panawagan kag wala man nakapakita sa ginpatawag nga hearing sang Iloilo City Council.
english: Majority Floor Leader, he said that Pacanan has not responded to the call several times and has not appeared in the hearing convened by the Iloilo City Council.

text: Suno kay Duron, kabahin sang hearing sang Quad Committee ang handom sang konseho nga pamatian ang bahin ni Pacanan para mahatagan sang kasanagan ang mga isyu kag reklamo angot sa implementasyon sang proyekto batok sa pagbaha sa Iloilo.
english: According to Duron, part of the hearing of the Quad Committee is the council's desire to hear Pacanan's side to shed light on issues and complaints regarding the implementation of the anti-flood project in Iloilo.

text: Dugang pa niya, indi kuntani maglab-ot sa sini nga desisyon kon nagpakita sang kooperasyon si Pacanan.
english: He added that this decision would not have been reached if Pacanan had shown cooperation.

text: Wala man kuntani problema kun willing lang siya makig-angot sa konseho, agud maistoryahan kag mabuligan sang insakto ang dapat nga lihok nga pagahimuon para sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: There would be no problem if he was willing to contact the council, so that they could discuss and help properly the action that should be taken for the city of Iloilo.

text: Indi mag-isol ang Gilas Pilipinas Women sa playoff debut batok sa New Zealand sa 2023 FIBA Women’s Asia Cup sa Sydney, Australia.
english: The Gilas Pilipinas Women will not shy away from a playoff debut against New Zealand at the 2023 FIBA ​​Women’s Asia Cup in Sydney, Australia.

text: Atubangon sang Pinay cagers ang Tall Ferns samtang atubangon naman sang Australia ang South Korea kun sa diin ang magadaog ang makaupod sang Japan kag China sa Final Four.
english: The Filipino cagers will face the Tall Ferns while Australia will face South Korea where the winner will join Japan and China in the Final Four.

text: Kun makalusot sa New Zealand, atubangon sang Gilas Women ang five-time reigning champion nga Japan sa semis nga kun matabo amo ang una nga semifinal appearance sang Pilipinas halin sang Division A promotion sang 2015.
english: If they qualify for New Zealand, the Gilas Women will face five-time reigning champion Japan in the semis, which will be the Philippines' first semifinal appearance since the Division A promotion in 2015.

text: Preska pa ang Gilas halin sa 92-81 nga kadalag-an batok sa Chinese Taipei sa group stage nga rason nga buhi ini gihapon sa Division A sang FIBA Asia.
english: The Gilas are still fresh off a 92-81 victory over Chinese Taipei in the group stage, which is why they are still alive in Division A of FIBA ​​Asia.

text: Nagapati ang longtime team anchor kag center nga si Jack Animam nga indi na madali-dali ang ila nga team subong kag ila gid tinguhaan nga makasaka sa maragtason nga semifinals.
english: Longtime team anchor and center Jack Animam believes that their team will not be in a hurry now and will try to reach the historic semifinals.

text: Balantayan ang hampang 3:00 karon sa hapon.
english: Watch the game at 3:00 pm today.

text: Nakumpirmar nga si Atty. Angelito “Lito” Magno ang bag-o nga gin-appoint bilang officer-in-charge (OIC) sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), suno sa Malacañang.
english: It was confirmed that Atty. Angelito “Lito” Magno is the newly appointed officer-in-charge (OIC) of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), according to Malacañang.

text: Ang anunsyo ang ginpagguwa matapos batunon ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The announcement was made after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang irrevocable resignation ni anay NBI Director Jaime Santiago.
english: the irrevocable resignation of former NBI Director Jaime Santiago.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro sa isa ka press briefing kadungan sang 47th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits sa Malaysia.
english: This was confirmed by Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro at a press briefing on the sidelines of the 47th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits in Malaysia.

text: Si Magno ang isa ka beterano nga abogado nga nag-umpisa bilang line agent sa NBI tubtob nga nangin Deputy Director for Investigative Services.
english: Magno is a veteran lawyer who started as a line agent in the NBI until he became Deputy Director for Investigative Services.

text: Kilala man siya sa iya abilidad sa imbestigasyon, information ang communications technology (ICT), kag pagpanguna sa patag sang law enforcement.
english: He is also known for his investigative skills, information the communications technology (ICT), and leadership in the field of law enforcement.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto, nagsumiter sang resignation si Santiago, matapos ang ginapahayag nga may mga “detractors” kag “may malain nga interes” sa iya posisyon nga padayon nga ginagub-an ang iya reputasyon.
english: It can be recalled that in August, Santiago submitted his resignation, after it was alleged that there were “detractors” and “bad interests” in his position that continued to damage his reputation.

text: Pabor si Board Member Rolex T. Suplico sang 5th District sang Iloilo, nga amo man ang chairman sang Committee on Social Welfare sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, nga untaton ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program ukon 4Ps.
english: Board Member Rolex T. Suplico of the 5th District of Iloilo, who is also the chairman of the Committee on Social Welfare in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, is in favor of ending the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program or 4Ps.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Suplico, ginpahayag niya nga indi siya kumporme sa konsepto nga ginabayaran ang ginikanan para atipanon ang ila kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Suplico said he does not agree with the concept that parents are paid to take care of their children.

text: Suno sa iya, wala sang economic advancement nga nagakatabo sa programa.
english: He said there is no economic advancement happening in the program.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga mas maayo pa nga taga-an sang kapital ang mga benepisyaryo, tudluan sang negosyo, kag ibutang sa edukasyon ang pondo ng para sa 4Ps.
english: He said it is better to give capital to the beneficiaries, teach them business, and invest the funds for 4Ps in education.

text: Ginpunto niya nga dapat ihatag sa insakto ang pondo kag gamiton ini sa mga programa nga may long-term nga epekto sa kabuhi sang pumuluyo.
english: He pointed out that the funds should be allocated properly and used for programs that have a long-term impact on the lives of the people.

text: Bibigyan ng Department of Education (DepEd) ng dalawang araw na work from home (WFH) ang mga non-teaching personnel bago ang pagtatapos ng Oktubre.
english: The Department of Education (DepEd) will give two days of work from home (WFH) to non-teaching personnel before the end of October.

text: Sinabi ni Education Secretary Sonny Angara na mayroong siyang inilabas na memorandum ukol sa nasabing WFH arrangement sa mga non-teaching personnel ng mula Oktubre 27 hanggang Oktubre 30.
english: Education Secretary Sonny Angara said he has issued a memorandum regarding the WFH arrangement to non-teaching personnel from October 27 to October 30.

text: Ang WFH arrangement sa mga non-teaching staff ay dapat aprubado ng kanilang superiors.
english: The WFH arrangement for non-teaching staff must be approved by their superiors.

text: Marapat na natitiyak nila na habang nasa WFH ay nagagawa pa rin nila ang kanilang mga trabaho.
english: They should be able to make sure that while on WFH they are still doing their jobs.

text: Mapait ang nangin kapalaran sang Pilipinas sa pagbukas sang Fiba Women’s Asia Cup matapos nagdangat sa 71 ka puntos ang abanse sang Australia sa hampang sa Sydney Olympic Park Sports Centre.
english: The Philippines had a bitter fate in the opening of the Fiba Women's Asia Cup after Australia took a 71-point lead in the match at the Sydney Olympic Park Sports Centre.

text: Ginkamasaan sang World Rank Number 3 nga Opals ang Gilas Women, 105-34, sa pagpanguna sang Aussie players nga sanday Darcee Garbin kag Lauren Scherf nga may tag-18 kag 17 puntos.
english: The World Rank Number 3 Opals defeated the Gilas Women, 105-34, led by Aussie players Darcee Garbin and Lauren Scherf with 18 and 17 points each.

text: Ginbuksan sang Australia ang hampang sa 16-2 scoring spree; kag magluwas sa 26-16 nga skor sa second frame, napaslawan na ang Pilipinas nga makahimo sang double digits sa nabilin nga mga quarter.
english: Australia opened the match on a 16-2 scoring spree; and aside from a 26-16 score in the second frame, the Philippines had failed to make double digits in the remaining quarters.

text: Si Vanessa de Jesus lamang ang naga-isahanon nga Filipino player nga naka-double digits sa hampang matapos nakahimo ini sang 18 ka puntos.
english: Vanessa de Jesus was the only Filipino player to score double digits in the game after scoring 18 points.

text: Atubangon sang Gilas Women subong nga adlaw ang team sang Japan nga six-time winner kag amo man ang defending champion.
english: The Gilas Women will face the six-time winner and defending champion Japan today.

text: May pagsaka sa presyo sang liquified petroleum gas (LPG) subong nga bulan sang Mayo bangud man sa mas mataas nga international contract price.
english: There was an increase in the price of liquified petroleum gas (LPG) this May due to the higher international contract price.

text: Sandig sa abiso sang Petron, may ipatuman nga P0.85 per kilogram nga saka sa presyo epektibo subong nga Mayo 1.
english: According to Petron's notice, there will be a P0.85 per kilogram price increase effective May 1.

text: Ang presyo naman sang autoLPG ang magasaka sang P0.48 per liter.
english: The price of autoLPG will increase by P0.48 per liter.

text: Suno naman sa Solane, may P0.85/kg nga saka sa presyo sang LPG products nga epektibo man subong nga adlaw.
english: According to Solane, there is a P0.85/kg increase in the price of LPG products which is also effective today.

english: This is the Construction of Flood Mitigation Structure – Section 1, Lapuz, Iloilo City with a programmed amount of ₱150 million.

text: Suno sa iya, ginpanami ang palibot, may suga na, may solar-powered nga kagamitan, kag may klaro nga benepisyo nga makuha sang pumuluyo.
english: He said the environment has been improved, there are lights, solar-powered equipment, and there are clear benefits to the people.

text: Ginklaro man niya nga halos isa ka tuig na ang konstruksyon, apang wala siya nakakita sang proposal ukon time frame sang proyekto, halin sa pagsugod tubtob sa pagtakop sini.
english: He also clarified that construction has been going on for almost a year, but he has not seen a proposal or a time frame for the project, from its inception to its completion.

text: Gin-ako man ni Diño nga bisan pa may ginahambal nga anomalya sa national level, ginapasalamatan niya gihapon ang proyekto bangud ang pumuluyo ang makaangkon sang benepisyo.
english: Diño also acknowledged that despite the alleged anomalies at the national level, he still appreciates the project because the people will benefit.

text: Ginpunto niya nga ang mga isyu sa national level dapat sabton sang kompaniya sa insakto nga proseso.
english: He pointed out that issues at the national level should be addressed by the company in due process.

text: Masobra 73,000 ka mga trabaho ang itanyag sa nagkalain-lain nga job fairs sa bilog nga pungsod sa Mayo 1, Labor Day.
english: More than 73,000 jobs will be offered at various job fairs across the country on May 1, Labor Day.

text: Suno sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), 73,779 ka mga trabaho ang mangin available sa event nga pasakupan sang 808 employers sa 42 ka job fair sites sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: According to the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), 73,779 jobs will be available at the event which will be attended by 808 employers at 42 job fair sites nationwide.

text: Lakip sa mga industriya nga magapartisipar amo ang BPO, manufacturing, financial and insurance activities, manpower services, kag sales and marketing.
english: Among the industries that will participate are BPO, manufacturing, financial and insurance activities, manpower services, and sales and marketing.

text: Suno sa DOLE, ang nagapanguna nga bakante amo ang customer service representatives, production workers/operators, financial consultants, service crew, kag sales agents ukon sales clerks.
english: According to the DOLE, the main vacancies are customer service representatives, production workers/operators, financial consultants, service crew, and sales agents or sales clerks.

text: Ang nagapangita sang trabaho ang gina-abisuhan na nga magtipon na sang application requirements kaangay sang resume ukon curriculum vitae, certificate of employment para sa mga naka-trabaho na anay, diploma, kag transcript of records.
english: Job seekers are advised to collect application requirements such as resume or curriculum vitae, certificate of employment for those who have worked before, diploma, and transcript of records.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, ang job fair site sa Western Visayas ang nahamtang sa Robinsons Iloilo.
english: According to initial information, the job fair site in Western Visayas is located at Robinsons Iloilo.

text: Magluwas sa job fairs, ginpahayag man sang DOLE nga nag-partner ini sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) kag sa Department of Agriculture (DA) agud pangunahan ang “Kadiwa ng Pangulo Para sa Manggagawa” agud mas barato lang ang balaklon sang mga mamumugon sa mismo Labor Day.
english: Aside from the job fairs, the DOLE also said it partnered with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the Department of Agriculture (DA) to lead the “Kadiwa ng Pangulo Para sa Manggagawa” to make things cheaper for workers on Labor Day.

text: Naluwas sang mga personnel sang Quezon City Police District (QCPD) ang tatlo ka tuig nga bata kag naaresto ang yaya sini nga nakidnap sa iya.
english: Quezon City Police District (QCPD) personnel rescued a three-year-old boy and arrested his nanny who kidnapped him.

text: Ang yaya ang nangayo sang ransom kabaylo sang bata.
english: The nanny demanded a ransom in exchange for the child.

text: Base sa report sang PNP, sang gab-i sang Agusto 10 sang gintaban sang yaya ang bata halin sa Aragon St., Brgy.
english: According to the PNP, on the night of August 10, the nanny from Aragon St., Brgy.
