english: Paltok.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon, nagareklamo sang pagsakit sang tiyan ang suspek kag naglisensya sa iya employer nga magakuha lang sang bulong kag gin-upod niya ang bata apang wala na sila nagbalik.
english: Investigation revealed that the suspect complained of stomach pain and asked his employer to get medicine and he took the child with him but they did not return.

text: Makaligad ang pila ka oras, may nabaton nga text message ang ginikinana sang bata kag nagapangayo sang ₱150,000 bilang ransom.
english: A few hours later, the child's mother received a text message demanding ₱150,000 as ransom.

text: Gilayon nagpatigayon sang entrapment ang otoridad nga nagresulta sa pag-rescue sa bata.
english: Authorities immediately conducted an entrapment which resulted in the rescue of the child.

text: Naaresto ang yaya kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso.
english: The nanny was arrested and is scheduled to face charges.

text: Maga-conduct sang basketball clinic ukon special evaluation kag instruction sa Pilipinas ang assistant coach sang Los Angeles Lakers nga si Phil Handy.
english: Los Angeles Lakers assistant coach Phil Handy will conduct a basketball clinic or special evaluation and instruction in the Philippines.

text: Diri na sa Manila si Handy ukon mas kilala man nga “Mr. 94 Feet of the Game” agud magpatigayon sang training programs para sa local basketball coaches, elite varsity teams, kag sa Converge FiberXers sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).
english: Handy or better known as “Mr. 94 Feet of the Game” is now in Manila to conduct training programs for local basketball coaches, elite varsity teams, and the Converge FiberXers of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).

text: Ginalauman nga madamo sang matun-an ang mga Pinoy sa iya nga mga itudlo nga amo man ang iya ginhimo sa pila ka greatest players sang NBA kaangay kanday Kobe Bryant, Lebron James, kag Kawhi Leonard.
english: It is expected that Filipinos will learn a lot from his teachings as he did with some of the greatest players of the NBA such as Kobe Bryant, Lebron James, and Kawhi Leonard.

text: Bisan ini ang una nga bes nga nakabisita si Handy sa Manila, ginpahayag sini nga excited siya nga makatuon sang dugang sa Pilipinas nga isa man ka makabig ‘basketball-crazy’ nga pungsod.
english: Although this is Handy's first visit to Manila, he said he is excited to learn more about the Philippines which is also considered a 'basketball-crazy' country.

text: Magluwas nga nakahampang para sa US, nakahampang man si Handy sa England, France, kag Australia antes sini ginsulod ang coaching kag player development.
english: In addition to playing for the US, Handy also played in England, France, and Australia before entering coaching and player development.

text: Isa si Handy sa ginalantaw pinakadamo nga nahibaluan sa patag sang basketball bangud ang iya teams ang nakasuld sa NBA finals sa anum ka sunod-sunod nga tuig halin sang 2015-2020.
english: Handy is one of the most knowledgeable people in the field of basketball as his teams reached the NBA finals six consecutive years from 2015-2020.

text: Bilang assistant coach, tatlo na ang iya ginauyatan nga kampyonato: Cleveland Cavaliers sang 2016, Toronto Raptors sang 2019, kag Lakers sang 2020.
english: As an assistant coach, he has three championships in his hands: Cleveland Cavaliers in 2016, Toronto Raptors in 2019, and Lakers in 2020.

text: Gin-share sini nga paborito sini nga championship ang padaog sang Cavaliers matapos ang maragtason nga pagbangon gikan sa 3-1 deficit batok sa Golden State Warriors.
english: He shared that his favorite championship is to win the Cavaliers after a historic recovery from a 3-1 deficit against the Golden State Warriors.

text: Apisar off-season para sa iya bilang Lakers’ assistant coach, ginpahayag ni Handy nga indi niya pagpahapusan ang pag-handle sa players nga iya tudluan bangud makabaton sila sang training kaangay sang paghanas man sang players sang Lakers.
english: Despite the off-season for him as the Lakers' assistant coach, Handy said he will not hesitate to handle the players he will teach because they will receive training similar to the training of the Lakers players.

text: “I’m gonna treat them the same way I treat Laker players, that’s what they expect anytime I step on the floor.
english: “I’m gonna treat them the same way I treat Laker players, that’s what they expect anytime I step on the floor.

text: Doesn’t matter the athlete, the gender, the skill level, they’re gonna get Phil Handy in whole just prepare to work and have some fun as you’re working,” suno kay Handy.
english: Doesn’t matter the athlete, the gender, the skill level, they’re gonna get Phil Handy in whole just prepare to work and have some fun as you’re working,” according to Handy.

english: The 15 boy and girl officials of the Iloilo Provincial Government were officially named during the celebration of Linggo ng Kabataan 2025.

text: Ini nga inisyatiba, nga kabahin sang tinuig nga selebrasyon sang Linggo sang Kabataan, gintuyo nga maghatag inspirasyon kag kusog sa masunod nga henerasyon sang mga lider pinaagi sa paghatag sa ila sang entablado nga mapakita ang ila mga abilidad.
english: This initiative, which is part of the annual celebration of Children's Week, aims to inspire and empower the next generation of leaders by giving them a stage to showcase their abilities.

text: Sa ikaduha nga magkasunod nga tuig sa Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships, ginkilala ang Filipino gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo bilang best performing male athlete.
english: For the second consecutive year at the Asian Artistic Gymnastics Championships, Filipino gymnast Carlos Yulo was recognized as the best performing male athlete.

text: Ini matapos nagtakop ang kampanya sang two-time world champion kahapon, Hunyo 18, sa Singapore nga may tatlo ka gold medals: sa parallel bars, sa floor exercise, kag sa vault.
english: This comes after the two-time world champion's campaign ended yesterday, June 18, in Singapore with three gold medals: in the parallel bars, in the floor exercise, and in the vault.

text: Silver naman ang nakuha sini sa individual all-around kag bronze medal sa horizontal bar.
english: She won silver in the individual all-around and a bronze medal in the horizontal bar.

text: Mas madamo ang nahakot niya nga medalya subong nga tuig ipaanggid sa tatlo ka gold medals kag isa ka silver sa nagligad nga Asian championships.
english: He won more medals this year compared to three gold medals and one silver in the previous Asian championships.

text: Sa pangkabug-usan, sa bulig sang nahakot nga medalya sang 23-anyos nga Tokyo Olympian, nagpangaduha ang Pilipinas sa best performing nations.
english: Overall, with the help of the medal won by the 23-year-old Tokyo Olympian, the Philippines came second in the best performing nations.

text: Nakuha sini ang kabug-usan nga tatlo ka gold medals, duha ka silver, kag tatlo ka bronze medals.
english: It won a total of three gold medals, two silver, and three bronze medals.

text: Nagpanguna naman ang China nga may walo ka gold medals, duha ka silver, kag tatlo ka bronze.
english: China led the way with eight gold medals, two silver, and three bronze.

text: Kuwalipikado naman si Yulo sa World Artistic Gymnastics Championships sa Antwerp, Belgium sa bulan sang Septyembre kun sa diin tinguhaan sini nga maka-secure sang spot para sa pinakadaku nga entablado — ang 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: Yulo is qualified for the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Antwerp, Belgium in September where she will try to secure a spot for the biggest stage — the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Nakasulod na ang 280 ka mga truck nga may dala sang pagkaon kag bulong sa Gaza.
english: A total of 280 trucks carrying food and medicine have already entered Gaza.

text: Suno sa Israeli military body Cogat nga naga-coordinate sang pagsulod sang bulig sa Gaza, ang mga truck nagsulod paagi sa Kerem Shalom kag Zikim crossings.
english: According to the Israeli military body Cogat which coordinates the entry of aid into Gaza, the trucks entered through the Kerem Shalom and Zikim crossings.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga truck ang halin sa nagkalaguba nga ayuda nga ginkolekta kag ginpanagtag sang United Nations kag International organizations.
english: The trucks are from the damaged aid collected and distributed by the United Nations and international organizations.

text: Magluwas sa mga truck, may yara sang 131 ka mga pallets sang bulig nga gin-airdrop sa bulig sang United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Germany, Belgium, Italy, the Netherlands kag France.
english: In addition to the trucks, there were 131 pallets of aid airdropped with the help of the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Germany, Belgium, Italy, the Netherlands and France.

text: Sa karon, ang US kag ang Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF) amo lamang ang mga organisasyon nga nagadul-ong sang bulig sa Gaza.
english: Currently, the US and the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF) are the only organizations delivering aid to Gaza.

english: The stay-in driver of Land Transportation Office (LTO) VI director Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II in Parc Regency Subdivision, Brgy.

text: Ungka 2, Pavia, Iloilo matapos nga ginluthang sang mag-utod.
english: Ungka 2, Pavia, Iloilo after being shot by brothers.

text: Ang biktima amo si Wilmer Casquite Villaros, legal ang edad, kasado, residente sang Janiuay, Iloilo, apang temporaryo nga nagatinir sa amo nga subdivision.
english: The victim was identified as Wilmer Casquite Villaros, legal age, married, resident of Janiuay, Iloilo, but temporarily staying in the said subdivision.

text: Samtang ang mga suspek, amo sanday Jay-R, 40, kag Boy, 45, kag nagaalegar nga taga-Barangay Aldeguer, Sara apang may I.D. nga nagapakita nga taga-Pampanga.
english: Meanwhile, the suspects, identified as Jay-R, 40, and Boy, 45, and allegedly from Barangay Aldeguer, Sara but with I.D. who appears to be from Pampanga.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Gabirel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakaangkon sang pilas ang biktima sa iya nga ulo, likod, kag kamot.
english: Police Lieutenant Gabirel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said the victim sustained injuries to his head, back and hands.

text: Suno kay Manguera, na-recover sa crime scene ang empty shells sang 9mm nga pusil apang, duha ka mga armas ang gingamit sang mga suspek kon sa diin, caliber 22 ang isa.
english: Manguera said empty shells of a 9mm pistol were recovered from the crime scene but the suspects used two firearms, one caliber 22.

text: Gintuad man sini nga ginahulat pa ang resulta sang autopsy result sang biktima agud nga mas maathag sa talatapan ang nangin kabangdanan sang kamatayon sini.
english: He also admitted that they are still waiting for the result of the autopsy result of the victim so that the office will be clearer about the cause of his death.

text: Gin-ako man sang natungdan nga tubtob subong, wala pa nila matul-id kon sa diin ginhaboy sang mga suspek ang ila armas.
english: He also admitted that until now, they have not been able to determine where the suspects threw their weapons.

text: Ginalantaw man sang Pavia PNP nga magdagdag sang search warrant sa mga suspek agud nga malantaw ang ila puluy-an kag mapangita ang mga armas nga gingamit sa krimen.
english: Pavia PNP is also considering adding a search warrant to the suspects to search their homes and find the weapons used in the crime.

text: Ipasaka naman subong nga adlaw ang kaso nga murder batok sa mga suspek.
english: A case of murder will be filed against the suspects today.

text: Gintawag nga isa ka “self-serving statement” ni Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, hepe sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (ICTTMO), ang reklamo sang isa ka Passenger Assistant Officer halin sa Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP).
english: Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, chief of the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (ICTTMO), called the complaint of a Passenger Assistant Officer from the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) a “self-serving statement”.

text: Ang ini nga reklamo ang may kaangtanan sa pagpabor sang traffic enforcers ang traditional jeepneys kaysa sa modernized jeepneys.
english: This complaint is related to the traffic enforcers' preference for traditional jeepneys over modernized jeepneys.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, iya ginpahayag nga mas maayo nga personal nga magpadulong ang sin-o man nga may reklamo sa ila opisina agud matutukan kag matagan gilayon sang hustisya ukon solusyon ang isyu.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos said it is better for anyone who has a complaint to personally approach their office so that the issue can be focused and given immediate justice or solution.

text: Pahayag pa sini, bukas gid ang opisina sang ICTTMO sa tanan nga reklamo kag luyag nila nga madiretso ini sa ila para masiguro nga mahatagan gilayon sang solusyon ang problema.
english: He said the ICTTMO office is open to all complaints and they want them to be directed to them to ensure that the problem is resolved immediately.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, may yara sila sang “zero tolerance” batok sa bisan ano nga klase sang korapsyon, pang-abuso, ukon malain nga pamatasan sang ila mga personnel.
english: Garbanzos said they have “zero tolerance” against any kind of corruption, abuse, or bad behavior by their personnel.

text: Ginpunto man sang natungdan nga wala gid nila gina-consider ang bisan ano nga kaso sang ICTTMO, sa diin nagahatag pa ini sila sang nagakaigo nga mga penalties.
english: He also pointed out that they do not consider any case of the ICTTMO, where they still give appropriate penalties.

text: Dugang pa ni Garbanzos, wala gid sila nagapangduha-duha nga magpahalin sang ila mha personnel sa ila mga serbisyo ilabi na kun mapamatud-an nga may mabug-at ini nga sala nga nahimo.
english: Garbanzos added that they do not hesitate to dismiss their personnel from their services especially if they are proven to have committed serious crimes.

text: Ginklaro man niya lakip sa mga polisa nga protektahan ang interes sang publiko kag siguruhon nga patas kag husto ang pagpatuman sang mga layi trapiko para sa tanan nga mga motorista mapa-publiko man ukon pribado.
english: He also clarified that among the policies is to protect the interest of the public and ensure fair and just enforcement of traffic laws for all motorists whether public or private.

text: Reunited na si Megastar Sharon Cuneta kay Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, sa iya asawa nga si Helen Gamboa kag sa ila kabataan, kag naga-guwa subong nga nahitso na sang mag-pamilya ang isyu nga natuga sang pulitika.
english: Megastar Sharon Cuneta is reunited with Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, his wife Helen Gamboa and their children, and it appears that the family has resolved the issue caused by politics.

text: Matandaan nga sang May 2022 elections, nagsumpunganay sa vice presidential race ang bana ni Sharon — si Senator Kiko Pangilinan — kag si Senator Sotto nga tiyo naman naman sang megastar.
english: In the May 2022 elections, Sharon's husband — Senator Kiko Pangilinan — and Senator Sotto, the megastar's uncle, faced each other in the vice presidential race.

text: Bisan una na nga ginpahayag ni Sotto nga wala man sang kaso ini para sa iya, gin-ako man sini nga “big deal” ini para sa ila nga pamilya bangud sa ila lain-lain nga perspektibo.
english: Although Sotto had previously said that it was not a case for him, he also admitted that it was a “big deal” for their family because of their different perspectives.

text: May pictures nga ginpakita ang Megastar nga ginakup-an sini sanday Sotto kag Helen.
english: The Megastar showed pictures of himself hugging Sotto and Helen.

text:
Si Ciara, nga anak sang mag-asawa, ang nag-share man sang pictures sa ila pagkit-anay kag nagsiling, “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.”

Matandaan nga sang Oktubre, una na nga nagpahayag si Sharon nga mabug-at para sa iya ang inagyan sang iya pamilya, iya ginlaragway nga “game called politics”, sang pareho nga nag-file sang certificate of candidacy ang iya bana kag tiyo sa kaangay lang nga posisyon.
english:
Ciara, the couple’s daughter, also shared pictures of their meeting and said, “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.”

It can be recalled that in October, Sharon earlier said that the experience of her family was difficult for her, she described it as “game called politics”, when both her husband and uncle filed certificates of candidacy for the same position.

text: Lunsay napierde ang duha ka outgoing senators sa amo nga vice-presidential race.
english: Both outgoing senators lost the vice-presidential race.

text: May yara sang 75,000 family food packs nga handa na nga ipanagtag sang DSWD-Negros Island Region Field Office para sa relief operations bangud paglupok sang Bulkan Kanlaon.
english: There are 75,000 family food packs ready to be distributed by the DSWD-Negros Island Region Field Office for relief operations due to the eruption of Volcano Kanlaon.

text: Lakip sa mga possible nga maapektuhan ang mga LGU kaangay sang La Castellana, Canlaon City, Murcia, La Carlota City, kag Bago City.
english: Among the LGUs likely to be affected are La Castellana, Canlaon City, Murcia, La Carlota City, and Bago City.

text: Padayon nga ginabantayan sang DSWD Field Office ang sitwasyon kag nakig-angot ang ila Quick Response Teams sa mga LGU para sa technical assistance kag possible dugang nga bulig.
english: The DSWD Field Office continues to monitor the situation and its Quick Response Teams are in contact with the LGUs for technical assistance and possible additional assistance.

text: Magluwas sa mga food packs, nakahanda man ang pila pa ka mga logistics sang NIR Field Office kaangay sang mobile kitchen, mobile command center, kag water filtration truck nga possible gamiton sa bisan ano man nga oras kun maglala ang sitwasyon.
english: Besides the food packs, the NIR Field Office has also prepared several other logistics such as a mobile kitchen, mobile command center, and water filtration truck that can be used at any time if the situation worsens.

text: Bisan wala pa sang klaro kun madayon ukon indi ang Barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan Elections sa Disyembre, ginpahayag ni Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Director sang COMELEC Region 6, nga handa na ang ahensya.
english: Although it is not yet clear whether or not the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections will be held in December, Atty. Dennis Ausan, Regional Director of COMELEC Region 6, said the agency is ready.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Ausan, ginahulat na lang ang pinal nga desisyon sang Supreme Court kag ni President Bongbong Marcos kun pirmahan ang layi nga naga-extend sang termino sang mga opisyal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Ausan said the final decision of the Supreme Court and President Bongbong Marcos on whether to sign the law extending the term of officers is awaited.

text: Sa pihak sini, padayon ang preparasyon , lakip ang pag-review sang voter’s list, guidelines, kag koordinasyon sa mga lokal nga opisina.
english: Meanwhile, preparations are ongoing, including reviewing the voter's list, guidelines, and coordination with local offices.

text: Ginpahanumdom man ni Atty. Ausan nga hulaton ang opisyal nga anunsyo kun may sunod pa nga registration para sa mga wala nakalabot kahapon.
english: He also reminded Atty. Please wait for the official announcement if there will be another registration for those who did not attend yesterday.

text: Ginklaro man ni Atty. Ausan nga handa ang COMELEC magserbisyo kag magsiguro sang patas kag matawhay nga eleksyon, bisan ano pa man ang desisyon.
english: He also clarified that Atty. He called on the COMELEC to be ready to serve and ensure a fair and orderly election, regardless of the decision.

english: ILOILO CITY – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was invited.

text: nga magtambong sa opening ceremonies sang FIBA World Cup 2023 sa Philippine Arena.

english: According to Deputy Event Director Erika Dy, the president is invited but there is no confirmation if he will attend.

english: His father, former president Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: Ang FIBA World Cup ang magasugod sa Agosto 25 sa hampang sang Gilas Pilipinas batuk sa Dominican Republic.
english: The FIBA ​​World Cup will start on August 25 with the Gilas Pilipinas match against the Dominican Republic.

text: Kung madumduman, mangin si late former president Benigno ‘Noynoy’ Aquino III ang nagtambong man sang 2013 Asia Championship Finals match sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag Iran kun sa diin, nakuha sang Gilas ang silver medal.
english: Even late former president Benigno 'Noynoy' Aquino III attended the 2013 Asia Championship Finals match between the Philippines and Iran where the Gilas won the silver medal.

text: Samtang, si anay president Rodrigo Duterte ang nagpamuno sa ceremonial toss sang Olympic Qualifying Tournament kun sa diin, nakontra sang Pilipinas ang France.
english: Meanwhile, former president Rodrigo Duterte led the ceremonial toss of the Olympic Qualifying Tournament where the Philippines faced France.

text: ILOILO CITY — Ang facility sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) subong ang temporaryo nga ginatineran sang pila ka miyembro sang Badjao community.
english: ILOILO CITY — The facility of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is now the temporary shelter of some members of the Badjao community.

text: Sa interbyu sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head sang Public Safety and Management Office (POSMO), may mga lugar na nga gin-identify ang lokal nga gobyerno kag ang Task Force Badjao agud mangin temporary shelter sang mga indigenous people samtang ginahandum nga mahatagan sila sang permanente nga lugar nga matiniran.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head of the Public Safety and Management Office (POSMO), said the local government and the Task Force Badjao have already identified areas to become temporary shelters for indigenous people while they wish to be given permanent places to live.

text: Isa sa mga gin-utilize nga pasilidad amo ang sa DSWD, nga temporaryo nga ginapuy-an sang Badjao samtang ginahulat pa ang dugang nga mga desisyon kag koordinasyon sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: One of the facilities utilized was the DSWD, which temporarily housed the Badjao while awaiting further decisions and coordination with government agencies.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Garbanzos nga padayon ang monitoring kag pagbulig sang Task Force Badjao agud masiguro nga mahatagan sang husto nga serbisyo kag proteksyon ang mga miyembro sang komunidad
english: Garbanzos also said that the Task Force Badjao continues to monitor and assist to ensure that community members are provided with proper services and protection.

text: Ginapadasig na ni Sen.
english: Sen.

text: Kiko Pangilinan sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure ang pag-livestream sa ila ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon.
english: Kiko Pangilinan to the Independent Commission for Infrastructure to livestream their ongoing investigation.

text: Suno sa senador, gina-anunsyo na sini sang komisyon rason nga kinahanglan na nila ini nga panindugan.
english: The senator said the commission is already announcing this so they need to take a stand.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga gusto sang publiko nga mahibaluan kun ano ang mga nagakatabo sa likod sang ila mga ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon tuhoy sa mga maanomaliya nga infra project sang pungsod.
english: He also pointed out that the public wants to know what is happening behind their ongoing investigations into the country's anomalous infrastructure projects.

text: Partikular na diri ang topiko nga ginakaulamiran sang kontrobersyal nga flood control anomaly.
english: Particularly the topic of the controversial flood control anomaly.

text: Padayon naman ang pagduson ni Pangilinan san transparency kag accountability.
english: Pangilinan continues to push for transparency and accountability.

text: Gin-umpisahan ini sang Senador kag ni ML Partly List Rep Leila De Lima pinaagi sa pagpubliko sang ila mga SALN kahapon.
english: Senator and ML Partly List Rep Leila De Lima started this by publishing their SALNs yesterday.

text: Nagpasugot si US President Donald Trump sa 30-days nga pause sa iya mga pagpamahog nahanungod sa taripa batok sa Mexico kag Canada.
english: US President Donald Trump has agreed to a 30-day pause on his threats about tariffs against Mexico and Canada.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Nowell Patrick Relatos, Bombo International Correspondent sa Canada, iya ginpahayag nga ang pause ang magaserbe nga cool-down period kasunod sang mga ‘tumultuous days’ nga nagbutang sa North Amerika sa trade war, kon sa diin, nagtuga sang pagnubo sang economic growth nga nagresulta sa pagtaas sang mga presyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nowell Patrick Relatos, Bombo International Correspondent in Canada, said the pause will serve as a cool-down period following the ‘tumultuous days’ that put North America in a trade war, which, led to a decline in economic growth that resulted in price increases.

text: Suno kay Relatos, ang pause sa taripa ang kaangay nga tikang sa Mexico nga nagatugot sang isa ka period of negotiations nahanungod sa over drug smuggling kag illegal immigration.
english: According to Relatos, the pause in tariffs is a similar move in Mexico that allows a period of negotiations regarding over drug smuggling and illegal immigration.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang 10% nga taripa nga ginmando ni Trump sa China ang natalana sa gihapon nga mag-epekto, apisar pa nga nagplano si Trump nga magsapol kay Chinese President Xi Jinping sa masunod nga pila ka adlaw.
english: He also explained that the 10% tariffs that Trump ordered on China are still scheduled to go into effect, despite Trump planning to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping in the next few days.

text: Samtang, ang trade war ang ginakahadlukan sang pila ka investors, companies kag political leaders, apang wala nagakahulugan nga ang pamahog ni Trump sa taripa ang natapos na.
english: Meanwhile, a trade war is feared by some investors, companies and political leaders, but that doesn’t mean Trump’s threat of tariffs is over.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang damlag lang, si Trump nagmando sang 25% nga taripa sa mga import gikan sa Mexico kag Canada, nga may 10% nga taripa sa Canadian oil, natural gas kag electricity.
english: Notably, Trump recently ordered 25% tariffs on imports from Mexico and Canada, with 10% tariffs on Canadian oil, natural gas and electricity.

text: Nagapati si Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Felipe Medalla nga posible malab-ot ang mas manubo pa sa 2% nga inflation rate sa tuig 2024.
english: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Felipe Medalla believes that it is possible to reach less than 2% inflation rate by 2024.

text: Sa katapusan nga Monetary Board policy meeting, gina-forecast sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas ang average inflation nga six percent para sa 2023 kag 2.9 percent para sa 2024.
english: At the last Monetary Board policy meeting, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas forecasts average inflation of six percent for 2023 and 2.9 percent for 2024.

text: Apang para kay Medalla nga isa ka ekonomista kag anay dean sang University of the Philippines School of Economics, posible ang below two percent inflation sa tunga-tunga sang 2024 kun basehan na ang pinakaulihi nga forecasting models.
english: But for Medalla, an economist and former dean of the University of the Philippines School of Economics, below two percent inflation is possible by mid-2024 based on the latest forecasting models.

text: Matandaan nga sa ginpaguwa nga data sang Philippine Statistics Authority, nagpanaog sa 7.6% ang inflation sang Marso, apang ang average inflation subong nga tuig ang yara gihapon sa 8.3%.
english: According to data released by the Philippine Statistics Authority, inflation fell to 7.6% in March, but the average inflation this year remained at 8.3%.

text: Ginpasalig naman ni Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno nga prayoridad sa gihapon sang administrasyon nga matapna ang inflation kag maglatag sang immediate kag long term solutions apisar nga nakit-an nga nagnubo na ini sa Marso.
english: Finance Secretary Benjamin Diokno assured that the administration's priority is still to tackle inflation and put in place immediate and long term solutions despite the decline in March.

text: Matandaan man nga nag-umpisa sang Abril 2022 nga mas mataas ang inflation sa two percent tubtub sa four percent target sang gobyerno kasunod sang Ukraine war nga may daku nga epekto sa global kag local oil kag non-oil commodity prices.
english: It can also be recalled that since April 2022, inflation has been higher than the government's two percent to four percent target following the Ukraine war, which has had a significant impact on global and local oil and non-oil commodity prices.

text: Isa ka truck nga may karga nga baras ang natumba sa Brgy.
english: A truck loaded with sand overturned in Brgy.

text: Jaguimitan, Passi CitySa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo sa nga nakasakse sang insidente, samtang nagapasaka sa tukladon nga parte sang dalan ang truck napatay ang makina sini kag nadula-an sang control ang driver.
english: Jaguimitan, Passi City According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo from witnesses of the incident, while climbing the steep part of the road, the truck's engine died and the driver lost control.

text: Bangud sini, nag-amat-amat padulhog ang truck tubtob nga natumba ini sa kilid sang dalan.
english: As a result, the truck slowly descended until it fell to the side of the road.

text: Maswerte nga nakalukso gwa ang driver kag wala may naagum nga samad.
english: Fortunately, the driver jumped out and was not injured.

text: Wala man sang iban nga tawo nga napilasan sa insidente apang naguba ang kudal sang isa ka balay nga gintumbahan sang truck.
english: No one else was injured in the incident but the fence of a house was damaged by the truck.

text: Sa subong, ginrespondihan na sang Passi City PNP ang natabo kag padayon pa nga ginahibalo ang rason sang insidente.
english: Passi City PNP has responded to the incident and is still investigating the cause of the incident.

english: The signature campaign of the residents calling for the closure of the L Three RG Farm due to the large number of flies that is causing damage to the residents has been submitted to the office of the mayor of Dueñas.

text: Sa interbyu sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Orland Palabrica sang Brgy.
english: Sa interbyu sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Orland Palabrica sang Brgy.

text: Monpon, Dueñas, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nasumiter na niya sa talatapan ni Mayor Robert Pama ang signature campaign kag nabaton na ini sang staff sang alkalde.

english: Suno kay Kapitan Palabrica, kadam-an sa mga pumuluyo ang nagpabor nga ipasira na gid ang nasambit nga poultry farm nga ginatudlo nga rason sa pagdamo sang langaw sa ila barangay.

english: Matandaan nga una na nga nagreklamo ang pila ka residente bangud sa perwisyo nga dala sang langaw, kag posible nga epekto man ini sang operasyon sang L Three RG Farm sa lugar.

english: Ping Lacson ang isa ka important witness sa masunod nga hearing sang Blue Ribbon Committee angot sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects kun ma-appoint ini liwat bilang chairman sang komite.

english: With the help of the said witness, the filing of cases against corrupt politicians, officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), and contractors will be expedited.

english: Lacson said they have already discussed with Senate Pres.

text:
Na-recover na sang otoridad ang duha ka black boxes halin sa American Eagle passenger jet kag ang device halin sa helicopter matapos nagbungguanay ang duha ka aircraft sang nagligad nga Miyerkules sang gab-i.

Sandig sa National Transportation Safety Board, gina-download na subong ang data halin sa devices nga mahimo makabulig sa pagtumod kun ngaa natabo ang collision nga rason kun ngaa nahulog ang eroplano kag helicopter sa Potomac River sa Washington DC.
english:
Authorities have recovered two black boxes from an American Eagle passenger jet and a device from a helicopter after the two aircraft collided last Wednesday night.

According to the National Transportation Safety Board, data from the devices is now being downloaded that may help determine the cause of the collision that caused the plane and helicopter to crash into the Potomac River in Washington DC.

text: 41 pa lamang gihapon ka bangkay ang na-recover kag indi sigurado ang otoridad kun san-o matapos ang pagpangita sa mga lawas sang 67 ka mga tawo nga ginapatihan nga lunsay nagkalamatay.
english: Only 41 bodies have been recovered and authorities are unsure when the search for the bodies of the 67 people believed to have died will be completed.

text: Lakip sa nakit-an na nga bangkay amo ang iya sang duha ka soldado nga sakay sa Blackhawk helicopter.
english: Among the bodies found were those of two soldiers aboard a Blackhawk helicopter.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Philippine Embassy sa US nga nagakumpirma sa kamatayon ni Police Colonel Pergentino Noble Malabed Jr., head sang Directorate for Logistics’ supply management division sang Philippine National Police nga kabahin sang nakasakay sa American Airlines flight 5342.
english: The Philippine Embassy in the US issued a statement confirming the death of Police Colonel Pergentino Noble Malabed Jr., head of the Directorate for Logistics' supply management division of the Philippine National Police who was aboard American Airlines flight 5342.

text: Nagpasalig ang embahada sang assistance sa pamilya ni Malabed kasunod sang amo nga trahedya.
english: The embassy promised assistance to Malabed's family following the tragedy.

text: On official duty ang pulis sang amo nga tion particular na sa pre-delivery inspection sang 2,675 vests nga natalana baklon sang PNP.
english: The policeman was on official duty at the time particularly in the pre-delivery inspection of the 2,675 vests scheduled to be purchased by the PNP.

text: Lauman ang pagsaka sa presyo sang bugas sa masunod nga mga semana bangud sa manubo nga buffer stock, mataas nga farmgate prices sang palay kag nagasaka nga presyo sang imported rice.
english: Rice prices are expected to rise in the coming weeks due to low buffer stocks, high farmgate prices of rice and rising prices of imported rice.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag deputy spokesman Rex Estoperez, gina-project sang ahensya nga magadangat tubtub sa P5 per kilo ang isaka sa presyo sang bugas.
english: According to Department of Agriculture Assistant Secretary and deputy spokesman Rex Estoperez, the agency projects an increase of up to P5 per kilo in the price of rice.

text: Sa harvest season, gin-cite sang opisyal ang mataas nga presyo sang rice procurement nga yara sa P22 tubtub sa P23 kada kilo.
english: During the harvest season, the official cited the high price of rice procurement at P22 to P23 per kilo.

text: Ginpaathag ni Estoperez nga kun nagataas ang procurement price,buot silingon, magataas man ang market price; kun magsaka ang farmgate price, magasaka man ang market price.
english: Estoperez explained that if the procurement price increases, it means that the market price will also increase; if the farmgate price goes up, the market price will go up.

text: Ang isa pa ka naga-epekto sa retail price sang bugas amo ang rice inventory subong sang pungsod nga naga-cover lamang sang 51 ka adlaw nga mas manubo ipaanggid sa kinaandan nga 90-day buffer agud ma-cover ang private kag government inventories.
english: Another factor impacting the retail price of rice is the country's current rice inventory which covers only 51 days less compared to the usual 90-day buffer to cover private and government inventories.

text: Gindugang pa ni Estoperez nga indi lang Pilipinas ang nagabatyag sini subong bangud may price increase man sa bugas mangin sa iban nga mga pungsod bangud apektado sang Ukraine-Russia war ang presyo sang inputs.
english: Estoperez added that it is not only the Philippines that is feeling this now because there is also a price increase in rice even in other countries because the price of inputs is affected by the Ukraine-Russia war.

text: Gintagaan sang masanag nga kasayuran sang Bombo Abogado nga si Atty. Frances Parcon-Torres ang publiko parte sa mga kaso nga naga-involve sang mga menor de edad, labi na gid ang may kaangtanan sa mga rumble nga nagluntad sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Bombo Abogado, Atty. Frances Parcon-Torres urged the public on cases involving minors, especially those related to the rumble that occurred in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Parcon, ginpahayag niya nga ang criminal liability sang kabataan nagadepende sa injuries nga naangkon sang biktima sa insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Parcon said the criminal liability of the children depends on the injuries sustained by the victim in the incident.

text: Ginsaysay man niya nga base sa Republic Act 9344 ukon Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act, ang mga naga-edad 10 tubtub 15 anyos wala sang criminal liability.
english: He also explained that based on Republic Act 9344 or Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act, those aged 10 to 15 years old have no criminal liability.

text: Apang kon ang menor de edad naga-edad 15 tubtub wala pa 18 kag may discernment ukon kabalo sa ila ginahimo, pwede sila mapasakaan sang kaso.
english: However, if the minor is between the ages of 15 and under 18 and has discernment or knows what they are doing, they can be charged.

text: Indi man ini dapat gamiton sang kabataan bilang rason para maghimo sang sala kay may ara gihapon sila sang intervention kag pwede ang ginikanan nila ang manabat sa civil aspect.
english: Children should not use this as an excuse to commit a crime because they still have an intervention and their parents can be held responsible for the civil aspect.

text: Suno kay Parcon, isa sa mga rason sang kabataan nga naga-intra sa rumble amo ang kakulangan sang guidance sa panimalay, peer pressure, kag ang misconception sa layi sa RA.
english: According to Parcon, one of the reasons for children participating in rumble is the lack of guidance at home, peer pressure, and the misconception of the RA law.

text: Paathag ni Parcon, ginapaminsar sang iban nga kabataan nga indi sila makasuhan bisan mag-obra sang sala, gani nagapadayon sila sa indi maayo nga binuhatan.
english: Parcon explained that some children think that they cannot be prosecuted even if they commit a crime, so they continue to do bad things.

text:
Ginalauman ni Parcon nga mapasar ang Comprehensive Juvenile Intervention Program upod sa CSWDO agud matapna ang mga insidente kag mabuligan ang kabataan nga magbag-o.

Ginhingyo man niya ang barangay kag mga ginikanan nga buligan ang kabataan sa pagpili sang insakto nga grupo kag pagpahilayo sa kinagamo kag krimen.
english:
Parcon hopes to pass the Comprehensive Juvenile Intervention Program with the CSWDO to prevent incidents and help children change.

He also urged the barangay and parents to help the children choose the right group and stay away from violence and crime.

text: Ginsaysay sang produkto sang University of San Agustin nga Rank 8 sa July 2025 Licensure Examination for Interior Designers ang nanuhay-tuhay nga mga inagyan sini nga naghulma man sang iya disiplina sa kaugalingon samtang gina-usoy sini ang karera nga iya napili.
english: The University of San Agustin product who ranked Rank 8 in the July 2025 Licensure Examination for Interior Designers recounted her varied experiences that also shaped her self-discipline as she pursued the career of her choice.

text: Ini amo si Marben East Clarito Bonifacio, residente sang Brgy.
english: This is Marben East Clarito Bonifacio, resident of Brgy.

text: Tabag, Pontevedra, Capiz, nga nakakuha sang 83.45% nga rating sa pasinawan.
english: Tabag, Pontevedra, Capiz, who obtained an 83.45% rating in the examination.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bonifacio, ginpahayag sini nga nagdalagan man sa pito ka tuig ang iya pagtinir sa kolehiyo diri sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bonifacio said he also spent seven years at the college in the city.

text: Una ini nga nagsulod sa Pharmacy program sang unibersidad, apang makaligad ang duha ka tuig, nagdesisyon na gid ini nga mag-shift sa Interior Designing bangud diri nagasanto ang iya hilig kag abilidad.
english: She initially entered the university's Pharmacy program, but after two years, she finally decided to shift to Interior Designing because this is where her passion and skills matched.

text: Bangud sa pagpanghangkat sa pinansyal nga aspeto, duha ka tuig man siya nga nangin working student kag na-assign sa Campus Ministry.
english: Due to financial challenges, he also became a working student for two years and was assigned to the Campus Ministry.

text: Halos isa ka academic year man ini nga nag-untat bangud sa “kadungulan” suno sa iya kag napa-barkada man rason nga na-atrasar siya sa pag-eskwela.
english: He also stopped almost an academic year because of “poverty” according to him and also made friends which caused him to be late for school.

text: Halin sang naka-gradwar ini sang 2022, nakasulod siya sa tatlo ka mga kumpaniya, apang na-delay man sa pagkuha sang exam bangud sa financial struggles nga kinahanglan sini lampasan.
english: Since graduating in 2022, she has joined three companies, but was also delayed in taking the exam due to the financial struggles she had to overcome.

text: Sa pihak sini nga mga inagyan, ginbalon na sini ang disiplina: nangin mapisan sa pag-review bisan yara sa trabaho, kag gintutukan sini ang iya target nga makapasar sa pasinawan.
english: Despite these experiences, he has embraced discipline: he has been diligent in reviewing even while at work, and he has focused on his goal of passing the exam.

text: “Abi ko gani A.I. (artificial intelligence),” pahayag sini sang ginbalikan ang tion nga napahibalo na sa iya nga topnotcher siya sa examination.
english: “I thought it was A.I. (artificial intelligence),” he said, recalling the time he was informed that he was a topnotcher in the examination.

text: “Ara to ang ngalan ko.
english: “There’s my name.

text: Tapos number 8 ako.
english: Then I'm number 8.

text: Ang goal ko ya makapasar lang ko ya, nakibot lang ko [nga topnotcher].
english: My goal was to pass, I was surprised [to be a topnotcher].

text: Na-shock ako.
english: I was shocked.

text: Daw tanan man nga kapoy nadula.
english: It seems that all the fatigue has disappeared.

text: Grabe man nga sakripisyo mo,” suno kay Bonifacio.
english: You made a great sacrifice,” Bonifacio said.

text: “Sobra-sobra man ang ginhatag sang Ginuo sa akon.
english: “The Lord has given me so much.

text:
Ginpasalamatan ko gid sang daku.”

Panugyan sini sa iban nga mga kabataan, dapat nga may yara gid sang disiplina kag magtutok gid sa goal samtang naga-eskwela.
english:
I was very grateful.”

He advised other children to have discipline and focus on their goals while studying.

text: “Indi lang gid madulaan sang hope.
english: “Just never lose hope.

text: May yara gid na sang solusyon ang kada problema.
english: There is always a solution to every problem.

text: Malampasan mo gid na basta may ara ka disiplina kag consistent ka gid,” pahayag sang Topnotcher.
english: You can overcome it as long as you have discipline and you are consistent,” said the Topnotcher.

text:
Dugang sini, “Dapat may ara ka gid goal kag target, kag indi ka gid magpadala sa mga distractions.”

Nagapadayon subong sa pag-“explore” si Bonifacio kag wala man ginadula ang posibilidad sa pag-trabaho sa iban nga mga pungsod.#
english:
He added, “You have to have a goal and a target, and never give in to distractions.”

Bonifacio is now continuing to explore and does not rule out the possibility of working in other countries.

text: Gindesignar ang tatlo ka mga miyembro sang Gabinete agud mangin caretakers sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas samtang nga yara sa luwas sang pungsod si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: The three Cabinet members were designated to be caretakers of the Philippine government while President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. is abroad.

text: Ini amo sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Education Secretary Sonny Angara, kag Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III.
english: They are Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Education Secretary Sonny Angara, and Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III.

text: Subong nga aga, Oktubre 24, naglakat si Marcos padulong sa Malaysia para magtambong sa 47th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits nga naka-schedule sa Oktubre 26-28.
english: This morning, October 24, Marcos left for Malaysia to attend the 47th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits scheduled for October 26-28.

text: Suno kay Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) spokesperson Angelica Escalona, ginalauman nga iduso ni Marcos ang mga interes sang Pilipinas kadungan sang mga aktibidad kun sa diin nalakip ang 14 leaders-level meetings kag tatlo ka signing ceremonies.
english: According to Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) spokesperson Angelica Escalona, ​​Marcos is expected to promote Philippine interests during activities that include 14 leaders-level meetings and three signing ceremonies.

text: Ini nga seremonya nagalakip ang Declaration on the Admission of Timor-Leste sa ASEAN bilang 11th member, Signing of the Second Protocol To Amend the ASEAN Trade in Goods Agreement, kag ASEAN-China Free Trade 3.0 Upgrade.
english: This ceremony includes the Declaration on the Admission of Timor-Leste to ASEAN as an 11th member, Signing of the Second Protocol To Amend the ASEAN Trade in Goods Agreement, and ASEAN-China Free Trade 3.0 Upgrade.

text: May patigayunon man nga bilateral meetings kaupod sa iban nga mga lider sa Southeast Asia.#
english: Bilateral meetings will also be held with other Southeast Asian leaders.

text: Ginmandu sang Japanese authorities sa ginatos ka mga residente malapit sa Tokyo nga mag-evacuate anay bangud labi nga nagalapad ang isa ka sinkhole sa intersection sa amo nga area.
english: Japanese authorities have ordered hundreds of residents near Tokyo to evacuate as a sinkhole at an intersection in the area widens.

text: Martes sang nagbukas ang parte sang road intersection sa Saitama prefecture nga naglamon gid sang isa ka truck kag driver sini.
english: On Tuesday, part of a road intersection in Saitama prefecture opened, swallowing a truck and its driver.

text: Didto gihapon ang 74-anyos nga driver tubtub subong, buot silingon, pang-apat na ini nga adlaw nga na-trap sa sinkhole kag ginatinguhaan nga ma-rescue.
english: The 74-year-old driver is still there, which means that he has been trapped in the sinkhole for the fourth day and is trying to be rescued.

text: Masobra na sa 40 metros ang kalaparon sang buho nga apat ka pilo sa kalapadon sini sang una ini nga nagtuhaw.
english: The hole is more than 40 meters wide, four times the width it was when it first appeared.

text: Naggamit na ang rescuers sang cranes para nga mahakwat ang parte sang truck pagguwa sa buho, kag may ginpadala naman nga drones underground apang wala gihapon sang komunikasyon sa driver halin sang Martes.
english: Rescuers have used cranes to lift parts of the truck out of the hole, and drones have been sent underground but there has been no communication with the driver since Tuesday.

text: Nagapati ang otoridad nga ang naguba nga mga tubo amo ang rason sang buho, bangud nag-leak ang wastewater, naghuyang ang duta, kag naglapad pa gid ang sinkhole.
english: Authorities believe damaged pipes caused the sinkhole, as wastewater leaked, the soil loosened, and the sinkhole widened further.

text: Magluwas sa pagpabakwit sa mga residente, ginhingyo man ang 1.2 million nga mga residente nga likawan anay ang pagpaligo kag pagpanglaba para nga mabuhinan ang tubig nga amo ang nagapabudlay sa rescue mission.
english: Besides evacuating residents, 1.2 million residents were also asked to avoid bathing and washing to reduce the water that makes the rescue mission difficult.

text: Sa bahin sang Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, nagmandu na ini sang emergency inspections sa kaangay nga sewer pipes sa Saitama kag anum ka iban pa nga prefectures kun sa diin 39 million ka mga tawo ang nagapuyo.
english: For its part, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism has ordered emergency inspections of similar sewer pipes in Saitama and six other prefectures where 39 million people live.

text: Naglab-ot ang ashfall sa pila ka areas sang Negros Occidental kasunod sang tres minutos nga paglupok sang Bulkan Kanlaon kagab-i, Oktubre 24.
english: Ashfall reached several areas of Negros Occidental following the three-minute eruption of Kanlaon Volcano last night, October 24.

text: Santo sa reports, nagtupa ini sa Bago City, La Carlota City, kag Pontevedra.
english: According to reports, it landed in Bago City, La Carlota City, and Pontevedra.

text:
May mga barangay naman sa La Castellana, Negros Occidental kag Canlaon City, Negros Oriental nga naka-eksperyensya sang “sulfurous fumes.”

Sandig sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), nag-umpisa ang minor explosive eruption 8:05 pm kag naglawig tubtub 8:08 pm.
english:
Meanwhile, barangays in La Castellana, Negros Occidental and Canlaon City, Negros Oriental experienced sulfurous fumes.

According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), the minor explosive eruption began at 8:05 pm and lasted until 8:08 pm.

text: Naglab-ot sa 2,000 metros ang kataason sang abo nga ginbuga sang bulkan halin sa baba sini antes nagliso pa-naaminhan-nasidlangan ang direksyon.
english: The ash spewed from the volcano's crater reached a height of 2,000 meters before turning northeast.

text: Nag-abiso naman ang PHIVOLCS sa mga residente nga siraduhan anay ang ila nga mga bintana kag pwertahan kun may matabo nga ashfall.
english: PHIVOLCS advised residents to close their windows and doors in case of ashfall.

text: Antes ang explosive eruption kagab-i, naka-rekord ang Phivolcs sang 19 ash emission halin sang September 8 tubtub October 23, kag may mga natabo man nga volcanic earthquake nga nagtimbuok sa 90 events sang October 16.
english: Before last night's explosive eruption, the Phivolcs recorded 19 ash emissions from September 8 to October 23, and there were also volcanic earthquakes that totaled 90 events on October 16.

text: Nagapabilin ang status sang bulkan sa Alert Level II nga nagakahulugan nga may “increased unrest.” Sa sini nga status, posible matabo ang steam-driven ukon phreatic eruptions.
english: The volcano remains at Alert Level II, which means there is “increased unrest.” In this status, steam-driven or phreatic eruptions are likely to occur.

text: “This means that this most recent explosive eruption may be followed by further moderate intensity activity such as ash emission events or similar short-lived explosive eruptions.
english: “This means that this most recent explosive eruption may be followed by further moderate intensity activity such as ash emission events or similar short-lived explosive eruptions.

text: Such eruptions could produce dangerous volcanic hazards within the 4-kilometer radius Permanent Danger Zone or PDZ, disperse ash over the general west of the volcano and produce material that could feed lahars in affected drainage channels,” suno sa ahensya.
english: Such eruptions could produce dangerous volcanic hazards within the 4-kilometer radius Permanent Danger Zone or PDZ, disperse ash over the general west of the volcano and produce material that could feed lahars in affected drainage channels,” according to the agency.

text: Hugot nga ginadumilian ang pagsulod sa four-kilometer radius PDZ kag ang pagpalupad sang aircraft malapit sa bulkan.
english: It is strictly prohibited to enter the four-kilometer radius PDZ and to fly aircraft near the volcano.

text: Tinguhaan sang Los Angeles Lakers nga mapatas sa 1-1 ang serye sa pag-atubang sini sa No.
english: The Los Angeles Lakers will try to tie the series at 1-1 when they face the No. 1 seed.

text: 1 seed nga Denver Nuggets sa Game 2 sang Western Conference Finals sang National Basketball Association (NBA) 8:30 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: 1 seed Denver Nuggets in Game 2 of the Western Conference Finals of the National Basketball Association (NBA) 8:30 this morning Philippine time.

text: Ginpromisa man ni Lebron James nga mangin desperado ang Lakers nga mas kay-uhon ang hampang sa Game 2 agud nga makabawi matapos ginlutos sang Nuggets, 132-126, sa Game 1.
english: Lebron James also promised that the Lakers will be desperate to improve their game in Game 2 to recover after being beaten by the Nuggets, 132-126, in Game 1.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lakers coach Darvin Ham nga kinahanglan sini nga i-“recalibrate” ang lineup bangud sa nakit-an nga size advantage sa starting lineup sang Denver Nuggets.
english: Lakers coach Darvin Ham said he needs to “recalibrate” the lineup due to the perceived size advantage in the starting lineup of the Denver Nuggets.

text: Wala ginsapubliko sang coach ang paglain sa lineup sa Game 2 kag wala man sang na-signal nga game plan adjustments.
english: The coach did not publicize the lineup change in Game 2 and did not signal any game plan adjustments.

text: Apang may reports nga nagaguwa nga gina-konsiderar nga ibutang si Rui Hachimura sa starting lineup sang Game 2.
english: However, reports are surfacing that Rui Hachimura is being considered for Game 2’s starting lineup.

text: Sa nagligad nga fourth quarter sa Game 1, matandaan nga yara si Hachimura sa court agud nga bantayan ang Nuggets superstar nga si Nikola Jokic agud nga ihatag kay Anthony Davis ang abilidad nga mag-contest samtang indi ini ang primary defender kay Jokic.
english: Last fourth quarter in Game 1, Hachimura was on the court to guard Nuggets superstar Nikola Jokic in order to give Anthony Davis the ability to contest while not being the primary defender to Jokic.

text: Patigayunon ang hampang sa Ball Arena, home court sang Denver Nuggets.
english: The game will be played at Ball Arena, home court of the Denver Nuggets.

text: Dakop ang 10 ka mga manugpangisda sakay sa duha ka mga sakayan pandagat bangud sa paggamit sang dinamita sa pagpangisda sa Sitio Balinguian, Mangalabang, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: Ten fishermen aboard two fishing boats were arrested for using dynamite in fishing in Sitio Balinguian, Mangalabang, Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Mismo ang Iloilo Provincial Bantay Dagat Task Force ang nakadakop sa siyam ka mga manugpangisda nga residente sang Batuanan, Carles samtang isa ang pumuluyo sang Balat-an, Mambusao, Capiz.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Bantay Dagat Task Force itself arrested nine fishermen who are residents of Batuanan, Carles while one is a resident of Balat-an, Mambusao, Capiz.

text: Ang mga manugpangisda ang naglapas sa Section 92 sang Republic Act 8550 ukon ang The Philippine Fisheries Code of 1998 as amended by Republic Act 10645.
english: The fishermen violated Section 92 of Republic Act 8550 or The Philippine Fisheries Code of 1998 as amended by Republic Act 10645.

text: Samtang, ang ila sakayan kag mga gamit ang yara na sa kustodiya sang Task Force.
english: Meanwhile, their boat and equipment are now in the custody of the Task Force.

text: Ginabanta 20kgs sang nagkalain-lain nga isda ang nakuha sa ila nagabalor P3,600.
english: About 20kgs of various fish were seized from them worth P3,600.

text: Ang mga isda ang ipasa sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources para sa scientific examination.
english: The fish will be submitted to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources for scientific examination.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang dynamite fishing ang naga-involve sang paggamit sang explosives nga ginahaboy sa tubig dagat agud mapatay ang madamo nga isda.
english: Dynamite fishing involves the use of explosives thrown into seawater to kill large numbers of fish.

text: Ini ang nagapanguna nga rason sang paghalit sang coral reefs kag pagguba sang coastal resources.
english: It is the leading cause of damage to coral reefs and destruction of coastal resources.

text: Ginsiling sang Palasyo nga wala sini gin-impluwensyahan ang desisyon sang Sandiganbayan nga i-abswelto si Chief Presidential Legal Counsel Juan Ponce Enrile sa kaso sini angot sa pork barrel scam.
english: The Palace said it did not influence the Sandiganbayan's decision to acquit Chief Presidential Legal Counsel Juan Ponce Enrile in his pork barrel scam case.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, may separation of powers ang gobyerno.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, the government has a separation of powers.

text: Ginarespeto nila ang bisan ano man nga desisyon sang korte tuhoy sa kaso ni Enrile.
english: They respect whatever the court decides on Enrile's case.

text: Nakit-an sang Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO) nga naatrasar-gamay ang probinsya sang Iloilo sa adoptive measures ilabi na subong nga daku gid nga halit ang tuga sang climate change kaangay sang pagbaha.
english: The Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO) found that the province of Iloilo is slightly behind in adopting measures especially now that climate change is causing huge damage such as flooding.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PENRO head Atty. Cesar Emmanuel Buyco, iya ginpahayag nga gamay pa ang mga kanal sa mga populated areas, kag madamo sang ginapanghaboy nga mga basura rason nga indi dayon maka-ilig ang tubig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PENRO head Atty. Cesar Emmanuel Buyco, he said that the canals in the populated areas are still small, and there is a lot of garbage being dumped so that the water cannot flow immediately.

text: Kabahin sang ginplastar sini nga mga tikang sang Provincial Government amo ang “Forest Province” status nga ginalagas sang probinsya nga malab-ot sa 2044.
english: Part of the measures laid out by the Provincial Government is the “Forest Province” status that the province is pursuing to achieve by 2044.

text: Lakip sa ginahimo agud maangkon ini nga status amo ang Tanum Iloilo for MoRProGRes Framework 2024-2044 nga nagatuyo nga ma-cover ang mga kagulangan sa Iloilo paagi sa data-based implementation.
english: Among the initiatives to achieve this status is the Tanum Iloilo for MoRProGRes Framework 2024-2044 which aims to cover the forests in Iloilo through data-based implementation.

text: Suno kay Buyco, importante man ang proyekto sa imprastraktura ilabi na bangud dako gid ang volume sang ulan subong kaangay sang na-eksperyensyahan sang nagligad nga bulan bangud sa enhanced southwest monsoon ukon habagat.
english: According to Buyco, the infrastructure project is also important especially since the volume of rainfall is very high now as experienced last month due to the enhanced southwest monsoon or habagat.

text: Masako man ang opisina suno kay Buyco sa reforestation sa forest land kag watershed areas.
english: Buyco said the office is also busy with reforestation in forest land and watershed areas.

text:
May yara man sang ginapatigayon nga development sang integrated social forest project bilang resource base para sa food security kag tourism; kag pagpakig-angot sa publiko kag sa private stakeholders agud nga makampanya ang pagtanum sang kahoy kag forest development activities sa mga balay, eskwelahan, opisina, mga banwa, kag iban pa nga mga lugar.#

(Photo: Balita Halin sa Kapitolyo)
english:
There is also an ongoing development of an integrated social forest project as a resource base for food security and tourism; and engaging with public and private stakeholders to campaign for tree planting and forest development activities in homes, schools, offices, towns, and other areas.#

text:
Nagsaka na sa 41 ka mga bangkay ang na-recover sang otoridad halin sa Potomac River matapos nga nagbungguanay ang isa ka passenger plane kag ang Army helicopter sa Washington D.C. sang nagligad nga Miyerkules sang gab-i.

28 sa mga biktima nga ini ang na-identify na suno sa Washington fire department.
english:
Authorities have recovered 41 bodies from the Potomac River after a passenger plane collided with an Army helicopter in Washington D.C. last Wednesday night.

28 of these victims have been identified, according to the Washington fire department.

text: Suno kay fire department head John Donnelly, nagalaum sila nga ma-recover ang 67 ka mga bangkay apang indi ini sigurado kun san-o matapos ang recovery operation.
english: Fire department head John Donnelly said they hope to recover the 67 bodies but he is not sure when the recovery operation will be completed.

text: Ginalauman man nila nga magaabot sa weekend ang mas maayo nga salvage equipment agud nga makakas sang crew ang passenger plane kag ang helicopter halin sa madalom nga tubig kag matigayon nila nga ma-retrieve ang iban nga mga lawas sang mga pasahero.
english: They also expect better salvage equipment to arrive over the weekend so that the crew can pull the passenger plane and the helicopter out of the deep water and retrieve the other bodies of the passengers.

text: Magluwas sa tatlo ka soldado nga patay, ang talalupangdon nga nagkalamatay sa insidente amo ang piloto nga kalaslon, isa ka estudyante nga mabalik sa eskwelahan matapos nagkadto sa funeral, isa ka abogado nga mapauli kuntani para sa iya birthday, grupo sang teenage figure skaters, ila ginikanan kag coaches kag may duha man ka Chinese citizens.
english: In addition to the three soldiers killed, the notable casualties included the pilot who was getting married, a student who was returning to school after attending a funeral, a lawyer who was about to return home for his birthday, a group of teenage figure skaters, their parents and coaches and two Chinese citizens.

english: Also on the flight were Police Col.

text: Pergentino Malabed Jr., chief sang PNP Supply Management Division.
english: Pergentino Malabed Jr., chief of the PNP Supply Management Division.

text: Ang 51-anyos nga pulis ang yara sa official travel sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The 51-year-old policeman was on official travel when the incident occurred.

text: May yara ini sang foreign travel authority para magkadto sa India para sa inspection sang 2,675 nga armored vests nga pagabaklon sang PNP.
english: He has foreign travel authority to travel to India for the inspection of 2,675 armored vests to be purchased by the PNP.

text: Nakaabot ini sa India sang January 22 kag nagkadto sa US shop para sa final testing kuntani sang vests.
english: It arrived in India on January 22 and went to the US shop for final testing of the vests.

english: From Kansas, he was scheduled to make a courtesy call to Police Attache Colonel Moises Villaceran Jr.

sa Washington D.C.

english:
in Washington D.C.

english: Eli San Fernando announced that the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) will not release its past recordings of flood control projects to the public.

text: Ang kwestyon ni San Fernando, ngaa nabudlayan ang komisyon nga ipakita sa publiko ang ila proceedings.
english: San Fernando's question is why it is difficult for the commission to show their proceedings to the public.

text: “Una, sinabi nilang magla-livestream na sila.
english: “First, they said they were going to livestream.

text: Tapos biglang binawi, kailangan daw muna nila i-review ang guidelines.
english: Then suddenly withdrew, they said they need to review the guidelines first.

text: Ngayon naman, ayaw nilang ilabas ang records ng mga nagdaang proceedings.
english: Now, they don't want to release the records of the past proceedings.

text: Ano ba talaga ang itinatago nila?” pahayag sang kongresista.
english: What are they really hiding?” the congressman said.

text: “Enough with the excuses.
english: “Enough with the excuses.

text: Kung walang pinoprotektahan at pinagtatakpan, buksan na nila sa publiko ang mga records at proceedings,” dugang pa.
