english: Teodoro said the Philippines will support what happened in Myanmar, if the Armed Forces of the Philippines coup against the Marcos Administration.

text: Ayon kay Teodoro, anumang “extra-constitutional” na hakbang ay maaaring magdulot ng pagkawala ng pagkilala ng ibang bansa sa Pilipinas at magpahinto sa kalakalan.
english: According to Teodoro, any “extra-constitutional” step could lead to the loss of foreign recognition of the Philippines and stop trade.

text: Giit niya, tanging mga nais magpabagsak ng gobyerno ang makikinabang sa ganitong hakbang.
english: He insisted that only those who want to overthrow the government will benefit from such a move.

text: May dugo nga Ilonggo ang nagtaliwan nga aktres nga si Susan Roces, ang ginakilala nga “Queen of Philippine Movies”.
english: The late actress Susan Roces, known as the “Queen of Philippine Movies”, has Ilonggo blood.

text: Ginsaysay ini ni Nereo Luján, isa ka local historian, sa Bombo Radyo.
english: Nereo Luján, a local historian, told Bombo Radyo.

text: Frenchmen ang kalolohan ni Roces nga nag-abot sa Iloilo sang 1870s matapos nga nagpalagyo sa ila pungsod bangud sa natabo nga Franco-Prussian War.
english: Roces' grandparents were Frenchmen who arrived in Iloilo in the 1870s after fleeing their country due to the Franco-Prussian War.

text: Ini nga Frenchmen amo ang mag-utod nga sanday Adolf, Charles kag Rafael Levy nga amo ang ginakilala nga may daku nga kontribusyon sa jewelry kag retail business sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: These Frenchmen are the brothers Adolf, Charles and Rafael Levy who are recognized for their great contribution to the jewelry and retail business in Iloilo City.

text: Ang nasambit nga mag-utod amo ang founder sang La Estrella del Norte, isa ka shop nga nagabaligya sang mga malahalon nga mga items kaangay sang Swiss wristwatches, gramophones, jewelries, perfumes, kag imported nga mga bayo.
english: The brothers are the founders of La Estrella del Norte, a shop that sells expensive items such as Swiss wristwatches, gramophones, jewelries, perfumes, and imported clothes.

text: Nagbukas ini nga shop sa Calle Real sa syudad sang 1873.
english: This shop opened on Calle Real in the city in 1873.

text: Nangin popular ang negosyo sang mag-utod kag sang ulihi, ginbuksan ang dugang nga brances sini lakip na sa Manila kag sa iban pa nga mga pungsod.
english: The brothers' business became popular and later, more branches were opened in Manila and other countries.

text: Sang ulihi, mas ginpasangkad pa gid ini kag nagsulod sa car dealership kag cargo shipping sa idalom sang business name nga Levy Hermanos.
english: Later, it expanded even further and went into car dealership and cargo shipping under the business name Levy Hermanos.

text: Ang Levy Hermanos amo ang nagdala sang labing-una nga salakyan sa Pilipinas — ang 9-horsepower, 2-cylinder 1904 Richard Brasier roadster nga halin sa France kag na-ship sa Pilipinas sang 1904.
english: The Levy Hermanos brought the very first automobile to the Philippines — the 9-horsepower, 2-cylinder 1904 Richard Brasier roadster that came from France and was shipped to the Philippines in 1904.

text: Sa tatlo nga mag-utod, si Adolf lang ang nagtinir sa Pilipinas samtang nagbalik naman sanday Charles kag Rafael sa France.
english: Of the three brothers, only Adolf stayed in the Philippines while Charles and Rafael returned to France.

text: Nangasawa si Adolf kay Benita Enriquez sang Iloilo kag may anak sila nga si Francisco.
english: Adolf married Benita Enriquez of Iloilo and they have a son, Francisco.

text: Napatay si Adolf sa Manila sang 1888 sa edad nga 39.
english: Adolf died in Manila in 1888 at the age of 39.

text: Ang iya naman anak nga si Francisco Levy ang nangasawa kay Luisa Gallo sang Iloilo kag may siyam ka mga anak.
english: His son, Francisco Levy, married Luisa Gallo of Iloilo and has nine children.

text: Ang subang nga anak nga si Purificacion ang nagpamana naman kay Dr. Jesus Sonora sang Bacolod City.
english: The youngest daughter, Purificacion, married Dr. Jesus Sonora of Bacolod City.

text: Sila ang mga ginikanan nanday showbiz celebrities nga sanday Rosemarie Sonora, kag Jesusa Purificacion Sonora nga mas kilala nga si Susan Roces.
english: They are the parents of showbiz celebrities Rosemarie Sonora, and Jesusa Purificacion Sonora better known as Susan Roces.

text: Nangin popular sa Philippine movies si Roces.
english: Roces became popular in Philippine movies.

text: Napamana sini si Fernando Poe, Jr.
english: She married Fernando Poe, Jr.

text: nga amo naman ang ginbansagan nga King of Philippine movies.
english: which was dubbed the King of Philippine movies.

text: May adopted daughter sila nga si Senator Grace Poe nga ila man nga ginpadaku halin sang nakit-an ini sa isa ka simbahan sa Iloilo.
english: They have an adopted daughter, Senator Grace Poe, whom they also raised since she was found in a church in Iloilo.

text: Kagab-i, Mayo 20, sang ginkumpirma nga napatay si Roces sa edad nga 80.
english: It was last night, May 20, when Roces was confirmed dead at the age of 80.

text: Ginhangkat ni Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros ang Marcos Jr.
english: Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros challenged Marcos Jr.

text: administration nga i-kumpiskar ang tonelada sang gina-alegar smuggled sugar nga gin-import sang tatlo ka ginpahayag ginpaboran nga traders.
english: administration to confiscate tons of allegedly smuggled sugar imported by three allegedly favored traders.

text: Ini nga statement sang senador ang kasunod sang pag-approve ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The senator's statement follows the approval of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sang pagbaligya sang natipon nga smuggled sugar sa presyo nga P70 per kilo sa Kadiwa centers.
english: of selling the collected smuggled sugar at P70 per kilo at Kadiwa centers.

text: Suno kay Hontiveros, nalipay gid ang administrasyon sa 12,000 metric tons nga nakumpiskar sa Subic kag Batangas, apang kunmatuod nga seryoso ang gobyerno nga mahatag ang bastante kag barato nga suplay sang kalamay sa pungsod, dapat nga mag-umpisa ini paagi sa pagkumpiskar sang sugar stocks nga iligal nga gin-import sang tatlo ka ‘favored’ importers.
english: Hontiveros said the administration is pleased with the 12,000 metric tons seized in Subic and Batangas, but if the government is serious about providing sufficient and affordable sugarcane supply to the country, it should start by confiscating the sugar stocks illegally imported by the three favored importers.

text: Ang tatlo amo ang All Asian Countertrade, Edison Lee Marketing, kag Sucden Philippines.
english: The three are All Asian Countertrade, Edison Lee Marketing, and Sucden Philippines.

text: Ginpahayag pa dugang ni Hontiveros nga kun ibaligya ang smuggled sugar sa pinaka-pigado nga 30 percent sang populasyon, kinahanglan ang at least 300,000 metric tons bangud ang annual consumption sang Pilipinas ang yara sa 2.2 million metric tons.
english: Hontiveros added that if the smuggled sugar is sold to the poorest 30 percent of the population, at least 300,000 metric tons are needed because the annual consumption of the Philippines is 2.2 million metric tons.

text: Dugang pa sang opposition lawmaker, dapat ibaligya sang gobyernoa ng smuggled sugar sa regular profit rates nga P61 per kilogram kag indi P70.
english: The opposition lawmaker added that the government should sell smuggled sugar at regular profit rates of P61 per kilogram and not P70.

text: Indi komporme si Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron sa ginpresentar nga development sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) may kaangtanan sa ila mga on-going nga proyekto sa syudad.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron is not satisfied with the presented development of Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) regarding their on-going projects in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Duron, iya ginpahayag nga wala gid siya na-satisfy sa presentasyon sang MPIW, bangud suno sa iya mas damo pa ang istorya kaysa sa aktwal nga tikang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Duron said he was not satisfied with the presentation of the MPIW, because he said there were more stories than actual steps.

text: Pahayag pa sini, tuman ka hinay ang development sang ila mga proyekto sa diin sa subong, madamo na sang mga pumuluyo ang nagaantos bangud sa kulang kag mahina nga water supply.
english: He said the development of their projects is very slow where at present, many residents are suffering due to lack of and weak water supply.

text: Suno pa sa kagawad, wala siya kahibalo kun san-o siya pa ini mangin kuntento sa serbisyo sang MPIW nga ginkritiko niya bangud nagasalig pa sila Jalaur River project nga para sa iya, wala pa sang kasiguraduhan kun makahatag gid sang nagakaigo nga tubig sa syudad.
english: The kagawad said he does not know when he will be satisfied with the services of MPIW which he criticized because they are still relying on the Jalaur River project which for him, is not yet sure if it will provide adequate water to the city.

text: Ginklaro man ni Duron nga apisar pa may ginahimo nga mga tikang ang MPIW sa pag-ayo sang mga tubo kag pagpalapad sang water distribution system sa Iloilo City, nagapabilin sagihapon nga madamo ang palamangkutanon kag kabudlayan sa serbisyo sini.
english: Duron also clarified that although MPIW is taking steps to repair pipes and expand the water distribution system in Iloilo City, there are still many questions and difficulties in its services.

text: Sa sulod sang anom ka tuig nga operasyon sang MPIW sa Iloilo, ginpahayag ni Duron nga mga 30% pa lang sang syudad ang ila maserbisyuhan.
english: In the six years of MPIW's operation in Iloilo, Duron said they have only served about 30% of the city.

text: Isa pa gid sa ginbuyagyag sang konsehal amo ang ginahimo sang MPIW nga paghatag sang water tanker sa mga negosyante, nga para sa iya daw ginabawi ang kakulangan sa serbisyo pinaagi sa mas mahal nga delivery kun ikumparar sa P20/cubic meter nga bayad sang mga regular nga konsumidor.
english: Another thing the councilor revealed was the MPIW's provision of water tankers to businessmen, which for him seems to compensate for the lack of service through more expensive delivery compared to the P20/cubic meter paid by regular consumers.

text: Ginapanawagan ni Duron sa MPIW nga seryosohon ang ila serbisyo kag tagaan atensyon ang matuod-tuod nga problema sang tubig sa Iloilo City.
english: Duron called on the MPIW to take their services seriously and pay attention to the real water problem in Iloilo City.

text: Lima ka gold medals ang natipon sang Pilipinas kahapon, Mayo 15, kag nagapabilin nga pang-lima sa 2023 Southeast Asian Games.
english: The Philippines collected five gold medals yesterday, May 15, and remains fifth in the 2023 Southeast Asian Games.

text: Sa weightlifting, gindominar sang Pinay weightlifter nga si Vanessa Sarno ang Women’s 71kg weightlifting competition kag nadepensahan ang iya nga gold medal sang gindala sini ang 225 kg.
english: In weightlifting, Filipino weightlifter Vanessa Sarno dominated the Women’s 71kg weightlifting competition and defended her gold medal with 225 kg.

text: Ginsundan ini sang 44-anyos nga playing coach sang Philippine Wrestling team nga si Cristina Vergara nga nakakuha sang gold medal sa Women’s Freestyle Wrestling -65kg competition.
english: This was followed by 44-year-old playing coach of the Philippine Wrestling team Cristina Vergara who won a gold medal in the Women’s Freestyle Wrestling -65kg competition.

text: Nangibabaw man ang Pinay arnisador nga si Maria Ella Alcoseba sa Women’s Full Contact Live Stick (Bantamweight) competition.
english: Filipino arnisador Maria Ella Alcoseba also won the Women's Full Contact Live Stick (Bantamweight) competition.

text: Sa arnis sa gihapon, nakuha ni Dexler Bolambao ang iya ikaduha nga gold medal sa Arnis Men’s Full Contact Live Stick (Bantamweight) competition!
english: In arnis, Dexler Bolambao won his second gold medal in the Arnis Men's Full Contact Live Stick (Bantamweight) competition!

text: Ang ika-51 naman nga gold medal ang courtesy sang kickboxer nga si Jean Claude Saclag nga nagdominar sa Men’s Lowkick -63.5kg event.
english: The 51st gold medal was courtesy of kickboxer Jean Claude Saclag who dominated the Men’s Lowkick -63.5kg event.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga SEA Games gold medal ni Saclag.
english: This is Saclag's third consecutive SEA Games gold medal.

text: Nagreklamo ang driver kag passenger assistant officer sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative agud ireklamo nga duha na ka bulan nga wala gihapon nila nabaton ang service contracting.
english: The driver and passenger assistant officer of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative complained that they have not received the service contracting for two months.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kanday “Alyas Toto” kag “Alyas Nonoy,” ginpahayag nila nga bisan nakabaton na ang iban nga kooperatiba, tanan nga miyembro sang MITSCOOP wala pa sa gihapon na-releasan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, “Alyas Toto” and “Alyas Nonoy” said that although other cooperatives have received, all members of MITSCOOP have not yet been released.

text: Gina-kwestyon man nila ang kakulang sa benepisyo pareho sang SSS, PhilHealth kag Pag-IBIG bisan may kaltas sa sweldo.
english: They also question the lack of benefits such as SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG despite the salary cut.

text: Suno kay Alyas Toto, makapila na sila nagreklamo sa ila chairwoman nga si Annabelle Falle, apang wala sang aksyon.
english: Toto said they have complained to their chairwoman Annabelle Falle several times, but no action has been taken.

text: Dugang pa ni Alyas Nonoy, ginpahibalo siya nga ang tunga sang service contracting ara na, apang ang nabilin gin-gamit sang motorpool para sa maintenance sang modernized jeepney.
english: Nonoy said he was informed that half of the service contracting was already there, but the rest was used by the motorpool for the maintenance of the modernized jeepney.

text: Plano subong sang Office of the Ombudsman nga magamit sang artificial intelligence para batuan ang korapsyon sa pungsod.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman now plans to use artificial intelligence to fight corruption in the country.

text: Suno kay Ombudsman Crispin Remulla nga bilang kabahin sang digitalization possible nga mangayo sila sang bulig sa mga ekspersto para makabulig sa pagkuha sang impormasyon.
english: Ombudsman Crispin Remulla said that as part of digitalization it is possible that they will seek the help of experts to help obtain information.

text: Pahayag pa niya, sa madamo sang mga dokumento kag transaction sa ila opisina, importante ang bulig sang AI.
english: He said that in many of the documents and transactions in their office, the help of AI is important.

text: Pagatun-an man nila sang mayo kag magakonsulta sila sa mga eksperto kun paano ini magamit sang insakto.
english: They will also study it carefully and consult experts on how to use it properly.

text: Malapit na sa 40 ang patay matapos natabo ang stampede sa Maha Kumbh Mela sa India kadungan sang pagtilipun sang minilyon ka mga tawo agud nga magpaligo sa ginakabig balaan nga suba.
english: Nearly 40 people have been killed after a stampede broke out at the Maha Kumbh Mela in India as millions of people gathered to bathe in the holy river.

text: Ginpahayag nga pila sa mga napatay ang nagsuprer sang atake sa korason kag may mga comorbidities kaangay sang diabetes.
english: Some of the dead reportedly suffered heart attacks and had comorbidities such as diabetes.

text: Base sa police sources, amat-amat na nga ginatugyan sa ila tagsa ka pamilya ang mga bangkay.
english: According to police sources, the bodies are being handed over to their respective families.

text: Wala pa sang official numbers nga ginpaguwa ang otoridad kaangot sa casualties bangud tuman pa subong kasako sa crowd management.
english: The authorities have not yet released official numbers regarding the casualties as they are still busy with crowd management.

text: Gin-alegar nga nagsugod ang stampede ang ginluksuhan kag ginsalakay sang mga deboto ang mga barikada sang ala una tubtub alas dos sang kaagahon.
english: The stampede allegedly started when devotees jumped and attacked the barricades from 1:00 am to 2:00 am.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga Hindu festival amo ang ginakabig nga pinakadaku nga pagtilipon sang mga tawo nga ginalauman nga magalab-ot sa 400-million sa masobra anum ka semana.
english: It is known that this Hindu festival is considered the largest gathering of people which is expected to reach 400-million in more than six weeks.

text: Mas madamo pa ini ipaanggid sa Haj pilgrimage sa Saudi Arabia nga ginkadtuan sang 1.8 million ka mga tawo sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is even more compare to the Haj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia which was visited by 1.8 million people last year.

text: Sa sulod pa lamang sang duha ka semana, lapit na sa 200-million ang nagtambong sa festival sa India suno sa mga opisyal kag masobra na sa 50-million ang nakapapatigayon sang holy dip.
english: In just two weeks, nearly 200-million people have attended the festival in India, according to officials, and more than 50-million have taken the holy dip.

text: Nagapati ang deboto nga mga Hindu nga ang pagpaligo sa tatlo ka balaan nga suba ukon sa Ganga, Yamuna, kag Saraswati amo ang nagadula sang ila nga mga sala kag nagaluwas man sa ila sa siklo sang kabuhi kag kamatayon.
english: Devout Hindus believe that bathing in the three holy rivers or the Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati removes their sins and also saves them from the cycle of life and death.

text: Antes ini nga trahedya subong nga 2025, may kaangay man nga stampede sang 2013 sa amo man nga festival kun sa diin 36 ang napatay.
english: Before this tragedy in 2025, there was a similar stampede in 2013 at the same festival where 36 people were killed.

text: Ibinunyag ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla na nanguna si dating Ako Bico Representative Zaldy Co at ilang mga kongresista sa unang batch ng flood control cases na isasampa sa Sandiganbayan sa buwan ng Nobyenbre.
english: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla revealed that former Ako Bico Representative Zaldy Co and some congressmen led the first batch of flood control cases to be filed with the Sandiganbayan in November.

text: Ayon kay Remulla na malaki ang paniniwala nito kasama ang pangalan ni Co sa unang batch ng kaso.
english: Remulla said he believes that Co's name was included in the first batch of cases.

text: Maraming mga pangalan ng kongresista ang nasa listahan na sasampahan ng kaso.
english: Many names of congressmen are on the list to be charged.

text: Si Co ang idinawit ng mga dating district at assistant engineers na tumestigo sa budget insertions na P35-bilyon mula 2022 at 2025 ganun din ang anomalya sa flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: Co was cited by former district and assistant engineers to testify to the budget insertions of P35-billion from 2022 and 2025 as well as anomalies in flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Ginklaro sang Korte Suprema nga wala pa nagsugod ang Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) sa formal vetting process para sa mga aplikante sa pagka-Ombudsman.
english: The Supreme Court clarified that the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) has not yet started the formal vetting process for applicants for the post of Ombudsman.

text: Ginpaguwa sang spokesperson sang Supreme Court nga si Atty. Camille Ting ini nga statement matapos ang nagalagaw nga mga espekulasyon nga gin-disqualify sang council si Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla para sa amo nga posisyon.
english: Supreme Court spokesperson Atty. Camille Ting made this statement after circulating speculation that the council had disqualified Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla for the position.

text: Suno kay Ting, premature ang reports nga may disqualification nga natabo; bangud sa subong, wala pa gani nabalhag ang official list of applicants nga ginakonsiderar.
english: According to Ting, reports of disqualification are premature; because as of now, the official list of applicants under consideration has not even been published.

text: “In response to some of your queries on whether the JBC disqualified SOJ Remulla from the Ombudsman position, the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) has not yet commenced the vetting process, as the official list of applicants under consideration has yet to be published,” suno kay Atty. Ting.
english: “In response to some of your queries on whether the JBC disqualified SOJ Remulla from the Ombudsman position, the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) has not yet commenced the vetting process, as the official list of applicants under consideration has yet to be published,” according to Atty. Ting.

text: Ang JBC isa ka body sa idalom sang Supreme Court nga amo ang may mandato sa pagsala sa mga aplikante sa Judiciary kag mataas nga mga posisyon sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: The JBC is a body under the Supreme Court which is mandated to filter applicants to the Judiciary and senior positions in the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Bilang kabahin sang proseso, gina-publish sini ang pinal nga lista sang applicants sa mga pwesto sa judiciary kag Ombudsman.
english: As part of the process, it publishes the final list of applicants for judiciary and Ombudsman positions.

text: Kun mabalhag na, iga-evaluate na ang mga candidates lakip na ang paghatag sang examinations kag pag-conduct sang interviews antes ang deliberation ukon disqualification.
english: Once published, the candidates will be evaluated including giving examinations and conducting interviews before deliberation or disqualification.

text: Kun matapos ang screening, may yara na sang shortlist sang candidates nga amo ang ipasa sa presidente nga amo ang may gahum nga maghimo sang final appointment.
english: After the screening, there will be a shortlist of candidates that will be submitted to the president who has the power to make the final appointment.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Remulla nga indi siya mag-“give up” sa iya ang application.
english: Earlier, Remulla said he would not give up the application.

text: Sa nagaguwa nga reports, gin-disqualify si Remulla bangud sa pending case nga naaangot sa ginaalegar nga violations nga na-commit bangud sang pagtugyan kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: According to reports, Remulla was disqualified due to a pending case related to alleged violations committed due to the extradition of former President Rodrigo Duterte to the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Nahibaluan nga bakante ang posisyon sang Ombudsman matapos nga nagtakop na sang Hulyo 27 ang pito ka tuig nga termino ni Samuel Martires nga appointee ni Duterte.#
english: The position of Ombudsman is vacant after the seven-year term of Samuel Martires, Duterte's appointee, expired on July

text: Nagpaandam ang Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECoP) nga mapilitan ang micro and small enterprises nga magpasaka sa presyo ukon magbuhin sang ila trabahador kun magpasar ang Kongreso sang layi para sa P750 nga wage hike.
english: The Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECoP) has warned that micro and small enterprises will be forced to raise prices or lay off their workers if Congress passes a law for a P750 wage hike.

text: Suno kay ECoP President Sergio Ortiz-Luis, 90% gid sang mga enterprises sa pungsod ang makabig nga micro samtang 8% naman ang small businesses.
english: According to ECoP President Sergio Ortiz-Luis, 90% of the enterprises in the country are considered micro while 8% are small businesses.

text: Kun pwersahon ini nga mga negosyo nga magpasaka sang sweldo suno kay Luis, ipasa man nila ini sa market ukon kakasan ang ila workforce.
english: If these businesses are forced to raise wages, Luis said, they will pass it on to the market or lay off their workforce.

text: “90% of our enterprises are micro, 8% are small, 1% are medium, and 1% are large.
english: “90% of our enterprises are micro, 8% are small, 1% are medium, and 1% are large.

text: Any untoward increase would push the company to either pass it on to the market or downsize its workforce,” pahayag sang presidente sang grupo.
english: Any untoward increase would push the company to either pass it on to the market or downsize its workforce,” the group’s president said.

text: Pat-od suno kay Luis nga ang dalagku lamang nga mga negosyo ang maka-afford sang wage hike.
english: Luis said it is certain that only large businesses can afford the wage hike.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-file sang minority bloc ang House Bill No.
english: The minority bloc filed House Bill No.

text: 7568 nga nagaduso sang wage increase nga P750 para sa tanan nga private-sector workers.
english: 7568 proposing a wage increase of P750 for all private-sector workers.

text: Lakip na diri ang naga-trabaho sa special economic zones, freeports, kag sa agricultural sector.
english: This includes those working in special economic zones, freeports, and the agricultural sector.

text: Ini nga hagna ang baliskad sa abiso sang economic managers nga una na nagpaandam nga kun iduso gid ang wage increase, maapektuhan ang competitiveness sang Pilipinas.
english: This bill is contrary to the warning of economic managers who earlier warned that if the wage increase is pushed, the competitiveness of the Philippines will be affected.

text: Wala na-satisfy si Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron sa ginpresentar sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water nga tikang sa pag-ayo sang problema sang tubig sa siyudad; ini matapos magpatawag ini sang public hearing bilang Chairman sang Committee on Energy and Public Utilities kaupod ang MIWD kag iban pa nga konsehal agud hibaluon ang progreso sang mga proyekto.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Romel Duron is not satisfied with the measures presented by Metro Pacific Iloilo Water to solve the city's water problem; This is after he called a public hearing as Chairman of the Committee on Energy and Public Utilities with MIWD and other councilors to know the progress of the projects.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Duron nga bisan may ginahimo na ang MPIW, madamo gihapon sang nagareklamo sa kakulangan sang tubig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Duron said that although the MPIW is doing something, many people are still complaining about the lack of water.

text: Luyag man sini masiguro kon matuod nga naga-P2,000 ang sukot sang water delivery tanker nga ginabakal sang mga establisyemento kag konsumidor bangud wala sang iban nga choice.
english: He also wanted to make sure that the water delivery tanker fee that is bought by establishments and consumers is really going up to P2,000 because there is no other choice.

text: Ginpangabay man sini nga tumanon sang MPIW ang promisa nga mangin fully operational ang bag-o nga mga tubo sa 2027 kag himuon ang excavation sa gab-i agud indi makadala sang traffic.
english: He also asked the MPIW to fulfill its promise to make the new pipes fully operational by 2027 and to do the excavation at night to avoid traffic.

text: Pagaestoryahan pa sang mga miyembro sang gabinete ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Members of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s cabinet will also discuss the issue.

text: ang posibilidad sang pagsapubliko sang ila Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).
english: the possibility of publishing their Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).

text: Ginpahayag ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro nga magasapol pa ang Marcos Cabinet agud desisyunan kun sundon man nila ang kaangay nga ginhimo sang nagligad nga administrasyon.
english: Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro said the Marcos Cabinet will meet to decide whether to follow the same pattern as the previous administration.

text: Suno kay Castro, ginalantaw pa sang Palasyo ang nagakaigo nga tikang may kaangtanan sa pagsapubliko man sang SALN sang Presidente.
english: Castro said the Palace is still considering the appropriate steps regarding the publication of the President's SALN.

text: Matandaan nga sang Oktubre 15, ginsiling mismo ni Marcos nga ma-access ang iya SALN sang bisan sin-o nga nagakinahanglan sini, lakip na ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).
english: It can be recalled that on October 15, Marcos himself said that his SALN is accessible to anyone who needs it, including the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).

text: Samtang, sang damlag lang, nagpagwa sang memorandum circular si Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla nga nagahatag sang access sa publiko sa SALN sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: Meanwhile, recently, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla issued a memorandum circular providing public access to the SALN of government officials.

text: Suno sa nasambit nga polisa, indi na kinahanglan ang permiso sang tag-iya sang SALN para maisapubliko ini, apang magapadayon nga protektado ang pila ka personal nga impormasyon.
english: According to the policy, the permission of the owner of the SALN is no longer required for its publication, but some personal information will remain protected.

text: Ang bag-o nga pagsulundan nga ini ang kabaliktaran sang memo sang 2020 nga ginpagwa sang anay Ombudsman nga si Samuel Martires.
english: This new rule is the opposite of a 2020 memo issued by former Ombudsman Samuel Martires.

text: Bastante ang isda sa Pilipinas para sa ginalauman nga pagsaka sang demand sa nagahilapit nga Holy Week.
english: There is enough fish in the Philippines for the expected increase in demand during the upcoming Holy Week.

text: Suno kay Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) spokesperson Nazario Briguera, kumpyansa ang ahensya sa sufficient production bangud nagbukas na liwat ang fishing grounds sa pungsod matapos ang periodic closure nga amo ang nagpahanugot sa fish species nga mag-reproduce.
english: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) spokesperson Nazario Briguera said the agency is confident of sufficient production as fishing grounds in the country have reopened after the periodic closure that allowed the fish species to reproduce.

text: Apang ginpahayag sini nga may pila man ka factors nga posible mag-apekto sa local production sang isda kaangay sang oil spill sa Oriental Mindoro nga nakaapekto pati sa kaiping nga mga probinsya.
english: However, he said there are also some factors that may affect the local production of fish such as the oil spill in Oriental Mindoro that affected neighboring provinces.

text: Posible suno kay Briguera nga napanubo sini ang fish output sa pila ka apektado nga mga lugar.
english: Briguera said it is possible that this has reduced fish output in some affected areas.

text: Magluwas diri, nagapabilin man nga pagpanghangkat sa fishing industry ang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo kag ang post-harvest losses.
english: In addition, the price of petroleum products and post-harvest losses remain a challenge for the fishing industry.

text: Bilang sabat, may subsidy program kag payao technology ang ahensya ilabi na para sa small-scale fisherfolk.
english: In response, the agency has a subsidy program and payao technology especially for small-scale fisherfolk.

text: Naga-initiate man ang ahensya sang post-harvest interventions agud ma-address ang fish spoilage.
english: The agency is also initiating post-harvest interventions to address fish spoilage.

text: Matapos ang makahalanusbo nga trahedya sang nagligad nga Disyembre sang natabo nga Jeju air crash sa South Korea nga ginkamatay sang 179 ka mga tawo, isa na naman ka eroplano nga sakay ang 176 ka tawo ang nasunog sa Busan airport.
english: After the tragic tragedy last December of the Jeju air crash in South Korea that killed 179 people, another plane carrying 176 people caught fire at Busan airport.

text: Ini amo ang Airbus A321 nga gina- operate sang South Korean carrier Air Busan.
english: It is an Airbus A321 operated by South Korean carrier Air Busan.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagapreparar na sa paglupad sa Gimhae International Airport sa Busan padakto sa Hong Kong sang nag-aso ini kag nagkalayo.
english: It was reportedly preparing to fly from Gimhae International Airport in Busan to Hong Kong when it caught fire.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginpagwa ang 169 ka mga pasahero kag pito ka crew members.
english: The 169 passengers and seven crew members were immediately evacuated.

text: Apat naman ang nag-angkon sang minor injuries sang ginpatigayon ang emergency evacuation.
english: Four others sustained minor injuries during the emergency evacuation.

text: Nagsugod ang kalayo sa likod nga bahin sang aircraft.
english: The fire started in the rear of the aircraft.

text: Ang Airbus A321, isa ka 17-year-old model, ang nag-angkon sang tuman ka dako nga damage.
english: The Airbus A321, a 17-year-old model, sustained extreme damage.

text: Naglunsar na ang otoridad sang imbestigasyon sa kabangdanan sang sunog.
english: Authorities have launched an investigation into the cause of the fire.

text: ILOILO CITY — Natumod na ang mga lugar nga pagahiwatan sang ‘community service’ sang mga pamatan-on nga na-involve sa kinagamo sa siyudad sang Iloilo, matapos ang natabo nga rumble sa Gaisano ICC Grounds sang nagligad nga semana.
english: ILOILO CITY — The venues for the community service of the youths involved in the violence in Iloilo City have been identified, after the rumble at the Gaisano ICC Grounds last week.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay City Councilor Nene Dela Llana, Chairman sang Committee on Social Services, posible nga patinluon ang mga menor-de-edad sa mga plaza pareho sang Plaza Libertad, Esplanade, mga public CR, kag iban pa nga pampubliko nga lugar.
english: City Councilor Nene Dela Llana, Chairman of the Committee on Social Services, said it is possible to clean up minors in plazas such as Plaza Libertad, Esplanade, public CRs, and other public places.

text: Ginalantaw man nga himuon ini sa ila tagsa ka barangay, pwede sa barangay hall, pagpanghilamon o pag-declogging, depende sa schedule nga igahatag sang barangay officials.
english: It is also expected to be done in their respective barangays, either at the barangay hall, weeding or declogging, depending on the schedule given by the barangay officials.

text: Ginpatawag na ni Mayor Raisa Treñas ang mga ginikanan kag stakeholders agud mahambalan ang masunod nga tikang, samtang ginpahibalo naman ni Dela Llana nga kun indi magbag-o ang kabataan, mahimo sila ibutang sa Balay Dalayunan.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas has already summoned parents and stakeholders to discuss the next step, while Dela Llana announced that if the children do not change, they can be placed in the Balay Dalayunan.

text: Natalana nga buy-an sang Hamas ang apat ka iban pa nga mga bihag subong nga weekend kasunod sang nakasugtan sini nga ceasefire sa Israel.
english: Hamas is scheduled to release four other hostages this weekend following a ceasefire agreement with Israel.

text: Ang ginhingadlan nga papaulion amo ang apat ka mga babaye nga soldado nga taga-Israel nga amo sanday Liri Albag, 19; Karina Ariev, 20; Daniella Gilboa, 20; kag Naama Levy, 20.
english: The four Israeli female soldiers named Liri Albag, 19; Karina Ariev, 20; Daniella Gilboa, 20; and Naama Levy, 20.

text: Tanan sila ang gindala sa Gaza Strip bilang hostages sang Oct.
english: They were all taken to the Gaza Strip as hostages on Oct.

text: Ginkuha sila sang militante nga grupo halin sa Nahal Oz army base sa border sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: They were recruited by a militant group from the Nahal Oz army base on the Israeli border with Gaza.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang opisina ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga nabaton nila ang lista sang pangalan sang female hostages nga hilwayon sang rebelde.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office also confirmed that it had received a list of names of female hostages to be released by the rebels.

text: Kun mahatag na sila sang Hamas, ginalauman nga ibaylo sang Israel ang 200 ka Palestinian nga prisoners ukon detainees.
english: Once Hamas hands them over, Israel is expected to exchange 200 Palestinian prisoners or detainees.

text: Base ini sa kalkulasyon nga nakasaad sa agreement nga 50 detainees ang pagguwaon sang Israel sa kada isa ka babaye nga soldado nga buy-an sang militante nga grupo halin sa Palestine.
english: This is based on the calculation stipulated in the agreement that Israel will release 50 detainees for every female soldier released by the militant group from Palestine.

text: Kun matuman ini nga plano, pito na ang mahilway nga hostages lakip ang tatlo nga una na gin-release sang nagligad nga Domingo.
english: If this plan is implemented, seven hostages will be released including three who were first released last Sunday.

text: 33 tanan ka hostages ang paguwaon halin sa Gaza Strip sa sulod sang una nga anum ka semana sang ceasefire sa giyera.
english: 33 total hostages will be released from the Gaza Strip during the first six weeks of the ceasefire in the war.

text: Siyam na ka mga boksidor halin sa Pilipinas ang may sigurado na nga silver medals apang posible manghakot sang bulawan nga medalya kun makasabak na sa gold medal round sang 32nd Southeast Asian Games.
english: Nine boxers from the Philippines have already secured silver medals but are likely to win the gold medal if they qualify for the gold medal round of the 32nd Southeast Asian Games.

text: Kwalipikado na sa final match ang Tokyo Olympian nga si Carlo Paalam matapos ginlutos ang Timor Leste via unanimous decision sa semifinals sa men’s 54kg class; kag nagsaka naman sa gold medal match si Paul Bascon matapos gintumba ang kasumpong halin sa Cambodia sa second round sang men’s 60kg semifinals.
english: Tokyo Olympian Carlo Paalam qualified for the final match after beating Timor Leste via unanimous decision in the semifinals in the men's 54kg class; and Paul Bascon advanced to the gold medal match after knocking out his opponent from Cambodia in the second round of the men’s 60kg semifinals.

text: Magluwas kanday Paalam kag Bascon, una na nga na-qualify para sa gold medal match sanday Rogen Ladon (flyweight), Ian Clark Bautista (featherweight), John Marvin (light heavyweight), Ilongga boxer Irish Magno (flyweight), Riza Pasuit (lightweight) kag mag-utod nga Petecio nga sanday Nesthy (featherweight) kag Norlan (lightweight).
english: Besides Paalam and Bascon, Rogen Ladon (flyweight), Ian Clark Bautista (featherweight), John Marvin (light heavyweight), Ilongga boxer Irish Magno (flyweight), Riza Pasuit (lightweight) and brothers Petecio (Neweather) and Netherland (featherweight) have already qualified for the gold medal match.

text: Nagkabos naman sa kadalag-an si Marcus Tongco matapos nga ginlutos ini sang Vietnam sa men’s 92kg semis kag nag-settle lamang sa bronze.
english: Marcus Tongco fell short after being defeated by Vietnam in the men's 92kg semis and settled for bronze.

text: Tuyo sang boxing squad sang Pilipinas nga lampasan ang rekord sini sa SEA Games sa Vietnam kun sa diin nakadaog ang team sang tatlo ka gold medals, isa ka silver, kag lima ka bronze.
english: The Philippine boxing squad aims to break its record at the SEA Games in Vietnam where the team won three gold medals, one silver, and five bronze.

text: Ginakwestyon sang isa ka passenger assistant officer sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative nga ginkilala kay “Alyas Nonoy” ang indi patas nga pagtrato sang mga traffic enforcer sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office sa mga modernized jeepney.
english: A passenger assistant officer of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative identified as “Alyas Nonoy” questioned the unfair treatment of the traffic enforcers of the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office to the modernized jeepneys.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Nonoy, ginpahayag sini nga kada mag-drop sila sang pasahero sa loading kag unloading area, ginasita kag ginaticketan sila, samtang ang mga traditional jeepney nga nakapundo sa amo man nga lugar ginapabayaan lang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nonoy said that every time they drop passengers in the loading and unloading area, they are arrested and ticketed, while the traditional jeepneys parked in the same area are left alone.

text: Gintudlo pa sini nga sa area sa tubang sang shopping mall sa Tagbak, Jaro, permi may traffic bangud sa pagpundo sang traditional jeep kag private car sa duha ka kilid sang dalan, apang wala sang tikang ang mga enforcer.
english: He pointed out that in the area in front of the shopping mall in Tagbak, Jaro, there is always traffic due to the parking of traditional jeeps and private cars on both sides of the road, but the enforcers have not taken any action.

text: Ginpanawagan sini nga patas nga ipatuman ang trapiko sa tanan nga motorista kag hatagan sang solusyon gilayon ang ICTTMO.
english: He called for fair traffic enforcement for all motorists and for the ICTTMO to provide an immediate solution.

text: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza/Via Bombo Reports Afternoon Edition, Hosted by Bombo Hannah Andasa
english: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Melliza/Via Bombo Reports Afternoon Edition, Hosted by Bombo Hannah Andasa

text: Ginatos na ka migrants ang naaresto sa Estados Unidos Unidos sang Amerika kag ang iban ginlupad na sang helicopter paguwa sa pungsod kasunod sang promisa ni US President Donald Trump nga mass deportation operation.
english: Hundreds of migrants have been arrested in the United States of America and some have been flown out of the country by helicopter following US President Donald Trump's promise of a mass deportation operation.

text: Suno kay White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, “538 illegal immigrant criminals” ang nadakpan sang Trump administration kag ginatos suno sa iya ang gin-deport paagi sa military aircraft.
english: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said “538 illegal immigrant criminals” have been arrested by the Trump administration and hundreds she said have been deported by military aircraft.

text: Ini man suno sa press secretary ang largest massive deportation operation sa maragtas sang Estados Unidos.
english: This is also, according to the press secretary, the largest massive deportation operation in the history of the United States.

text: Matandaan nga sa election campaign pa lamang, nagpasalig na si Trump sa crackdown sa illegal immigration.
english: Earlier in the election campaign, Trump promised a crackdown on illegal immigration.

text:
Sa una nga adlaw sa pagpungko bilang presidente, nagpirma man ini sang order nga nagadeklarar sang “national emergency” sa southern border kag gin-anunsyo ang deployment sang dugang nga tropa sa area dala ang pasalig nga i-deport sini ang “criminal aliens.”

Nahibaluan nga may ginabanta nga may 11 million undocumented migrants sa bilog nga United States.
english:
On his first day as president, he also signed an order declaring a “national emergency” on the southern border and announced the deployment of additional troops to the area with the assurance that he would deport “criminal aliens.”

There are an estimated 11 million undocumented migrants in the United States.

text: Lakip sa kontrobersiya nga nag-alsa matapos sini amo ang pahayag sang Democratic mayor sang Neward, New Jersey nga nag-raid ang Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents sa local establishment kag gin-detain ang undocumented residents kag mga residente bisan nga wala man sila sang gina-uyatan nga warrant.
english: Among the controversies that arose after this was the statement of the Democratic mayor of Neward, New Jersey that Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents raided the local establishment and detained undocumented residents and residents even though they did not have a warrant.

text: Ginsiling pa sang mayor nga nalakip sa gin-detain sa raid amo ang isa ka US military veteran.
english: The mayor said among those detained in the raid was a US military veteran.

text: Wala gintugutan sang gymnast nga si Carlos Yulo kag pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena nga maagaw ang ila tagsa ka gold medal nga ginauyatan sa Southeast Asian Games.
english: Gymnast Carlos Yulo and pole vaulter EJ Obiena did not let their respective gold medal holds at the Southeast Asian Games be snatched away.

text: Sa bahin sang two-time world champion nga si Yulo, nangibabaw ini sa men’s individual all-around matapos naka-tally sang 84.000 points sa Olympic Stadium.
english: As for two-time world champion Yulo, he dominated the men’s individual all-around after tallying 84.000 points at the Olympic Stadium.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga individual all-around gold medal ni Yulo sa SEA Games matapos nadag-an man ini sang 2019 kag sa Hanoi, Vietnam sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is Yulo's third individual all-around gold medal at the SEA Games after winning in 2019 and in Hanoi, Vietnam last year.

text: Subong nga adlaw, magapasundayag liwat si Yulo para sa finals sang individual apparatuses kag posible mag-compete sa vault kag parallel bars depende sa desisyon sang coaches.
english: Today, Yulo will perform again for the finals of the individual apparatuses and may compete in the vault and parallel bars depending on the decision of the coaches.

text: Nahibaluan nga may restriction nga ginbutang ang Cambodian organizers kag tubtub lamang sa apat ka medalya ang mahimo mabulsa ni Yulo.
english: It is known that there is a restriction imposed by the Cambodian organizers and only up to four medals can be pocketed by Yulo.

text: Ang nasambit nga Pinoy gymnast ang ginkilala nga most bemedalled Filipino athlete sa Hanoi SEA Games sang 2022 nga may lima ka gold medals.
english: The Filipino gymnast was recognized as the most bemedalled Filipino athlete at the Hanoi SEA Games in 2022 with five gold medals.

text:
‘STILL THE POLE VAULT KING IN SOUTHEAST ASIA’

Samtang sa bahin sang isa pa ka Olympian nga siObiena, wala lang ini nagdaog sang gold medal kundi ginguba kag ginlapawan pa ang kaugalingon nga SEA Games record!
english:
‘STILL THE POLE VAULT KING IN SOUTHEAST ASIA’

Meanwhile, another Olympian, Obiena, not only won the gold medal but also broke and surpassed her own SEA Games record!

text: Apisar sang ulan, natigayon nga na-clear ni Obiena ang 5.65-meters sa men’s pole vault sa Morodok National Stadium kag ginbulsa ang iya ikatatlo nga gold medal sa SEA Games.
english: Despite the rain, Obiena managed to clear 5.65-meters in the men’s pole vault at the Morodok National Stadium and pocketed his third gold medal of the SEA Games.

text: Plano man sang nasambit nga World No.
english: The World No. 1 also plans to

text: 3 pole vaulter nga ipa-auction ang gingamit nga sapatos sa amo nga event agud nga makadugang sang pondo para sa pole vault facility sa Tuguegarao City.
english: 3 pole vaulter to auction the used shoes in the event to raise funds for the pole vault facility in Tuguegarao City.

text: Ini nga pasilidad ang ginalantaw ang lugar kun sa diin makahanas ang mga bata para sa pole vault.#
english: This facility is expected to be the place where children can train for the pole vault.

text: Gin-athag sang Ajuy Municipal Police Station nga daan na ang naglapta nga video kun sa diin makit-an nga nagagamit sang iligal nga druga ang isa ka manunudlo.
english: The Ajuy Municipal Police Station explained that the video showing a teacher using illegal drugs has already circulated.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Corporal John Floyd Valencia, imbestigador sang Ajuy Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga tuig 2023 pa ginkuha ang video sang amo nga maestro.
english: Police Corporal John Floyd Valencia, investigator of the Ajuy Municipal Police Station, said the video of the teacher was taken in 2023.

text: Suno kay Valencia, magapakig-istorya man sila sa principal sang eskwelahan kun sa diin nagatulod ang maestro.
english: Valencia said they will also talk to the principal of the school where the teacher is pushing.

text: Gintuad naman ni Valencia nga under monitoring subong ang manunudlo bangud sa pagtuhaw liwat sang video.
english: Valencia admitted that the teacher is currently under monitoring due to the resurfacing of the video.

text: QUEEN THINGS!
english: QUEEN THINGS!

text: Ini ang ginpakita sang beauty queen nga si Michelle Dee apisar nga wala sini nakuha ang Miss Universe Philippines crown subong nga tuig.
english: This was shown by beauty queen Michelle Dee despite not winning the Miss Universe Philippines crown this year.

text: Sa isa ka Instagram post, gin-dayaw ni Michelle si Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi, kag nag-ako nga pareho sila nga nag-manifest para sa amo nga crowning moment.
english: In an Instagram post, Michelle praised Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi, and admitted that they both manifested for such a crowning moment.

text: Apang suno kay Michelle, pareho sila nga nakahibalo nga isa lang sa ila ang magadaog.
english: But Michelle says they both knew only one of them would win.

text: “No one can take her destiny away from her because she is queen well-deserved and a true friend for that matter as well.
english: “No one can take her destiny away from her because she is queen well-deserved and a true friend for that matter as well.

text: Glad to have shared this moment with you just like we manifested,” pahayag ni Michelle.
english: Glad to have shared this moment with you just like we manifested,” stated Michelle.

text: Sa coronation night sang nagligad nga Abril 30, nakuha ni Michelle ang Miss Universe Philippines Tourism award.
english: At the coronation night last April 30, Michelle won the Miss Universe Philippines Tourism award.

text: Antes sang pageant, pareho na sila nga titleholders ni Celeste.
english: Before the pageant, she and Celeste were both titleholders.

text: Si Michelle ang Miss World Philippines 2019 samtang si Celeste naman ang Miss Earth Philippines 2018.
english: Michelle is Miss World Philippines 2019 while Celeste is Miss Earth Philippines 2018.

text: Nag-komento naman si Celeste nga tuman man ang iya nga kalipay nga nakakita siya sang abyan sa persona ni Michelle, kag gintawag sini si Michelle nga amazing and truly a queen.
english: Celeste commented that she was very happy that she found a friend in the person of Michelle, and she called Michelle amazing and truly a queen.

text: “More than anything else, I’ve found a friend and couldn’t be happier to share this experience with you and Kat.
english: “More than anything else, I’ve found a friend and couldn’t be happier to share this experience with you and Kat.

text: You are amazing and truly a queen,” pahayag sang newly-crowned Miss Universe Philippines.
english: You are amazing and truly a queen,” said the newly-crowned Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Iloilo – Target sang gobyerno nga padasigon ang pagpanagtag sang masobra 134,000 ka mga titulo sang duta para sa linibo ka mga benepisyaro subong nga tuig.
english: Iloilo – The government targets to expedite the distribution of more than 134,000 land titles for thousands of beneficiaries this year.

text: Sa pagbisita sang Department of Agrarian Reform sa Western Visayas, nagpanagtag ini sang 1,300 ka mga titulo sang duta sa mga benepisyaryo sa Passi City.
english: During the visit of the Department of Agrarian Reform to Western Visayas, it distributed 1,300 land titles to beneficiaries in Passi City.

text: Magluwas sa pagpanagtag sang titulo sang duta, ginturn-over man sang Department of Agrarian Reform ang farm-to-market roads project nga nagdangat sa P100 million, farm machineries and equipment nga nagdangat sa P14,357,636.50 pinaagi sa Sustainable and Resilient Agrarian Reform Communities project sa mga pili nga Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries Organizations sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Besides the distribution of land titles, the Department of Agrarian Reform also turned over the farm-to-market roads project amounting to P100 million, farm machineries and equipment amounting to P14,357,636.50 through the Sustainable and Resilient Communities Agrarian Reform project to the selected Agrarian Reform projects. Beneficiaries Organizations in the province of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado M. Estrella III, iya ginpahayag nga paagi sa House Bill No.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado M. Estrella III said that through House Bill No.

text: 6336 kag Senate Bill No.
english: 6336 and Senate Bill No.

text: 1853 ukon ang New Agrarian Emancipation Act, indi na kinahanglan nga baydan pa sang mga benepisyaryo ang amortization, interest payments, surcharges kag penalties sang existing loan sang ila tagsa ka mga duta.
english: 1853 or the New Agrarian Emancipation Act, the beneficiaries are no longer required to pay the amortization, interest payments, surcharges and penalties of the existing loan of their respective lands.

text: Suno kay Estrella, ginadebatehan na sa senado ang pagpasa sang amo nga hagna.
english: Estrella said the bill is already being debated in the Senate.

text: Samtang, ginalauman nga maaprubahan sa senado ang New Agrarian Emancipation Act nga mahimo makabulig sa mga agrarian reform beneficiaries nga indi pa bayad kag may bilin nga amilyar kag interes ang duta nga gina-istaran.
english: Meanwhile, the Senate is expected to approve the New Agrarian Emancipation Act which may help agrarian reform beneficiaries who have not yet paid and have interest on land.

text: Ginbasura sang Fourth Division sang Sandiganbayan ang kaso nga ginpasaka batok sa tatlo ka mga anay opisyal sang Roxas, Capiz.
english: The Fourth Division of the Sandiganbayan has dismissed the case filed against three former officials of Roxas, Capiz.

text: Lakip sa mga napasakaan sang reklamo amo sanday, Former Capiz Governor Esteban Evan B. Contreras, Former Capiz Administrator Edwin C. Monares, kag Former Roxas Memorial Provincial Hospital (RMPH) OIC Dr. Edmarie Tormon.
english: Among those who filed complaints were Former Capiz Governor Esteban Evan B. Contreras, Former Capiz Administrator Edwin C. Monares, and Former Roxas Memorial Provincial Hospital (RMPH) OIC Dr. Edmarie Tormon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Kaiser Cordero, CEO kag founding partner sang Cordero and Associates, ginpahayag sini nga nabaton na nila ang desisyon sang Sandiganbayan kahapon nga nagadeklarar sang pagbasura sang kaso batok sa ila mga kliyente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Kaiser Cordero, CEO and founding partner of Cordero and Associates, said they have received the decision of the Sandiganbayan yesterday declaring the dismissal of the case against their clients.

text: Suno kay Atty. Cordero, una na sila nga nagpasa sang Motion to Dismiss base sa rason nga insufficient prosecution evidence.
english: According to Atty. Cordero, they have already filed a Motion to Dismiss based on insufficient prosecution evidence.

text: Ginpabutyag pa niya nga isa sa mga rason sang dismissal amo ang kapaslawan sang Prosecution nga mapamatud-an “beyond reasonable doubt” ang mga alegasyon.
english: He further stated that one of the reasons for the dismissal was the failure of the Prosecution to prove “beyond reasonable doubt” the allegations.

text: Ginpaburan sang korte ang “Demurrers to Evidence” nga gin-file sang mga akusado.
english: The court favored the “Demurrers to Evidence” filed by the defendants.

text: Sa pihak sang ini nga kadalag-an, ginpahayag ni Contreras nga halos tatlo man ka tuig ila pakigbato sa pagdepensa sang ila kliyente.
english: Despite this victory, Contreras said they have been fighting for almost three years to defend their client.

text: Matandaan nga ginpasakaan sang reklamo ang nasambit nga mga akusado sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Capiz nga gin-representar sang pila ka mga opisyales sang nasambit nga lugar sadtong Nobyembre 24, 2021 bangud sa ginaalegar bayolasyon sang Republic Act 3019 ukon Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act; Republic Act 9184 ukon Government Procurement Reform Act; kag Malversation of Public Funds or Property sandig sa Revised Penal Code.
english: The accused were filed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Capiz represented by several officials of the said area on November 24, 2021 for alleged violation of Republic Act 3019 or Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act; Republic Act 9184 or Government Procurement Reform Act; and Malversation of Public Funds or Property under the Revised Penal Code.

text: May kahilabtanan ini sa natukiban sang Sanggunian sa ila committee hearings natuhoy sa request ni Contreras nga supplemental appropriation sang pondo nga nagabalor sang masobra P79 million kag pagbakal sang masobra P5 million, kag P1,499,000 nga medical supplies sa NGB Marketing gamit ang Small Value Procurement (SVP).
english: This is in connection with the findings of the Sanggunian in their committee hearings regarding Contreras' request for supplemental appropriation of funds worth more than P79 million and purchase of more than P5 million, and P1,499,000 of medical supplies from NGB Marketing using Small Value Procurement (SVP).

text: Masobra sa 60 ang patay kag kapin 50 ang pilason matapos nasunog ang isa ka ski resort hotel sa northwestern Turkey.
english: More than 60 people have been killed and more than 50 injured after a ski resort hotel in northwestern Turkey caught fire.

text: Suno sa Interior Minister sang Turkey, natabo ang trahedya sa Kartalkaya resort sa Bolu province.
english: According to Turkey's Interior Minister, the tragedy occurred at the Kartalkaya resort in Bolu province.

text: Ang iban nga mga tawo ang napilitan nga maglumpat sa bintana sang 12 ka panalgan nga hotel agud makaluwas.
english: Some people were forced to jump from the window of the 12-story hotel to escape.

text: Ginpahayag nga wala man sang fire extinguishers sa hotel.
english: There were reportedly no fire extinguishers at the hotel.

text: Ang resort isa ka popular nga destinasyon para sa mga holiday-makers sa tion sang winter, ilabi na kun school holidays, humalin Enero tubtob Pebrero.
english: The resort is a popular destination for holiday-makers during the winter, especially during school holidays, from January to February.

text: Kalabanan sa mga tawo sa hotel ang halin sa Istanbul kag Ankara.
english: Most of the people in the hotel are from Istanbul and Ankara.

text: Ginabanta nga yara sa 234 guests ang nagatinir sa hotel sang natabo ang sunog.
english: An estimated 234 guests were staying at the hotel when the fire broke out.

text: Indi magnubo sa 30 ka mga fire trucks kag 28 ka ambulansiya ang nagresponde sa nasunog nga hotel.
english: At least 30 fire trucks and 28 ambulances responded to the burning hotel.
